Description: AccuWeather has the Superior Accuracy™, custom views, and weather animations you love! It is fun-to-use, reliable, and will make all the difference in your day. This award winning app is available in 27 languages. We designed it with you in mind because so many decisions are made based on the weather. You get a quick look at current weather conditions for the next 72 hours with an easy swipe to a calendar view of the forecasted conditions for each of the next 25 days – including the option to open up any of the 25 days for more weather detail! You also get: • Severe weather notices to keep you ahead of the storm. • A Local Forecast Summary that gives you a quick brief of the most significant weather event forecasted for your location over the next several days. A Windows® app designed using Microsoft’s Windows® 8.1 Interface with fluid screen resizing to the snap view, and large, medium, small and wide Live Tile support for all your favorite locations. The Tiles automatically peek and refresh with current forecasts and weather maps. • Current weather conditions update every 15 minutes with the very latest humidity percentages, visibility, UV index, wind speed, direction and wind gusts, and RealFeel® – AccuWeather’s exclusive weather forecasting system that analyzes multiple weather conditions to determine how the local temperature actually feels. • Fully interactive, full-screen Bing Maps overlaid with AccuWeather’s precise weather data, including U.S., Canadian, European, and Japanese radar. Download AccuWeather for free and take advantage of the Superior Accuracy™ and local weather information for your PC and tablet!

Name: Where's My Water
Description: Get the GAME OF THE YEAR award-winning puzzler! Help Swampy by guiding water to his broken shower. Each level is a challenging physics-based puzzle with amazing life-like mechanics. Cut through dirt to guide fresh water, dirty water, toxic water, steam, and ooze through increasingly challenging scenarios! Every drop counts! • Original Stories & Characters – Play through 4 unique stories featuring Swampy, Allie, Cranky and Mystery Duck. That’s over 500 amazing puzzles! • Innovative Mechanic – See water in various forms and use your creativity to solve the puzzles – totally stimulating! • Collectibles, Challenges, and Bonus Levels – Collect special items uniquely designed for each character and complete cool challenges to unlock bonus levels! “Tri-Duck” each level for ultimate bragging rights! SWAMPY’S STORY Swampy the Alligator lives in the sewers under the city. He’s a little different from the other alligators – he’s curious, friendly, and loves taking a nice long shower after a hard day at work. But there’s trouble with the pipes and Swampy needs your help getting water to his shower! ALLIE’S STORY Allie is the sewer's most creative alligator. Her quirky spirit and artistic talents made her a star. Now, the gators have crafted a one-of-a-kind steam-powered musical instrument, and can't wait to hear her play it! Help Allie get the steam she needs and enjoy her take on classic Disney tunes. CRANKY’S STORY Cranky, a real gator’s gator, has a big appetite and will eat anything, from tires to old fish bones. But he refuses to eat his greens! Use the dirty purple water to clear the algae on Cranky’s plate so he can gobble up his “food”. MYSTERY DUCK Catch this fancy teleporting Mystery Duck in this special chapter and hint hint - timing is everything! Some stories may require a small additional price but try the FREE levels today!

The cloud saving functionality means games can be paused on one device and resumed on another, offering convenience for users on the go. User-Friendly Experience The straightforward interface makes jumping into the action quick and effortless. Vibrant graphics and lively audio cues contribute to the overall appeal while maintaining a smooth user experience on most Windows PCs.

Cloud Integration: The ability to save photos to OneDrive (formerly SkyDrive), with options to make them available offline. Declaration of data protection: The app does not store or send any data of the users because they do not have to register in order to be able to use the app. However, the user can come into contact with me for help either through my web site or my email address I provided. I declare herewith that I handle the users' email addresses with care. In general the user do not have to provide personalised information to access and use my app. Users' personal data, such as usernames, email addresses, phone numbers, skypenames, etc., are not stored only if the users provide me with this information so that I can help them with any of the tests or any page of the app. This data will only be used to be able to perform the requested helpdesk. In addition, this data will not be processed and used for supplying any third party with usernames, email addresses, phone numbers, skypenames, etc., to send spams not even with the user's advance consent to do so. Users have the right to receive a copy of their stored personal data at any time. Protecting the privacy of minors: This app is particularly addressed to people at the age of 12 and over. Children and young people under the age of 14 may not transmit any personal data over the Internet without the consent of their parent or guardian. I ensure that I do not knowingly store any personal data relating to minors.

But to get that much you’ll have to make some wise investments! Maybe you’ll invest in venture capital, loan sharking, or offshore drilling. Description: Mother Nature has done a number on an island paradise and the people need a hero! Saving the day won't be easy, as you'll have to stop wildfires in their tracks, rebuild towns hit by devastating earthquakes, and do damage control in the wake of destructive hurricanes, but you can do it! The gameplay in 'Rescue Team' is intuitive. In each of the game's 60 levels, simply tap the screen to free workers trapped by debris, then repair damaged restaurants and sawmills to produce resources, and then patch up bridges, helicopter pads and boat docks to restore the infrastructure. Oh, and don't forget to collect gems, put out fires and save stranded swimmers! The challenge in 'Rescue Team' is found in figuring out the quickest way to complete your goals, earning the most money, and winning the best trophies. Players who prefer a relaxed experience can finish the levels without hurrying and still move forward. Rescue Team' is fun, addictive, and unlike any other game you've played, so grab your hard hat, strap on your tool belt, and become the hero you're called to be!

We believe that brilliant, creative ideas can come from anyone, anytime. It’s time to set your creativity free. Create original artwork, turn photos into beautiful paintings, or choose an activity pack to help you get started quickly. From whimsical pictures of your friends to amazing landscapes, Fresh Paint enables you to create anything.

Name: OpenTracks Desktop
Description: OpenTracks Desktop is here!! Discover music like never before with my Windows 8.1 music app, designed for fans of the latest hits. Featuring a library of over 100 tracks, the app brings together top charts and trending songs in one place. A powerful search function makes it easy to find your favorite artists or explore new genres. With seamless access to the newest top hits, this app transforms your device into a modern jukebox, keeping your playlists fresh and exciting every day.

Name: AccuWeather for Windows 8 x64
Description: AccuWeather has the Superior Accuracy™, custom views, and weather animations you love! It is fun-to-use, reliable, and will make all the difference in your day. This award winning app is available in 27 languages. We designed it with you in mind because so many decisions are made based on the weather. You get a quick look at current weather conditions for the next 72 hours with an easy swipe to a calendar view of the forecasted conditions for each of the next 25 days – including the option to open up any of the 25 days for more weather detail! You also get: Severe weather notices to keep you ahead of the storm. A Local Forecast Summary that gives you a quick brief of the most significant weather event forecasted for your location over the next several days. A Windows app designed using Microsoft's Windows 8.1 Interface with fluid screen resizing to the snap view, and large, medium, small and wide Live Tile support for all your favorite locations. The Tiles automatically peek and refresh with current forecasts and weather maps. Current weather conditions update every 15 minutes with the very latest humidity percentages, visibility, UV index, wind speed, direction and wind gusts, and RealFeel® – AccuWeather's exclusive weather forecasting system that analyzes multiple weather conditions to determine how the local temperature actually feels. Fully interactive, full-screen Bing Maps overlaid with AccuWeather's precise weather data, including U.S., Canadian, European, and Japanese radar. Download AccuWeather for free and take advantage of the Superior Accuracy™ and local weather information for your PC and tablet!

Name: Adobe Photoshop Express
Description: Download Photoshop Express and start exploring. Edit photos and videos, add creative effects, and more with Photoshop Express.

Name: AfterLight
Description: Afterlight is the perfect image editing app for quick and straightforward editing. Our simple design, paired with powerful and snappy tools, will give you the look you want in seconds. Take us with us on your next adventure. Download now and look forward to free content and app enhancements from time to time! ADJUSTMENT TOOLS Use any of our 8 uniquely made adjustment tools to enhance your images to perfection with ease. 57 FILTERS Afterlight has 27 fully adjustable Original Filters, 14 Guest Filters by various Instagram users, and the Seasons filter pack including 16 filters. 44+22 TEXTURES Afterlight includes a range of real and natural light leaks we created with 35mm film and instant film, including simplistic scratchy film textures. Note: 44 of these textures are included with the base version of the app 22 new textures are part of an expansion kit available via in-app purchase. CROPPING & TRANSFORMING TOOLS Crop your photos with our quick and easy cropping tool with 15 different presets. Transform your photos with our rotating tool, vertical and horizontal flipping tools. 72+7 FRAMES We provide a list of 79 different simplistic and adjustable frames, paired perfectly with Instagram. Note: 72 of these frames are included with the base version of the app. 7 new frames are part of an expansion kit available via in-app purchase. AVAILABLE IN-APP PURCHASES: 1) Instant Film Pack: This pack includes 22 new textures and 7 new frames, inspired by and created with instant film. This will be a growing pack and receive new content in future updates. 2) The wallpaper pack gives you access to 18 hand-drawn wallpapers you can apply to frames, for a unique look! This is a growing pack that will receive new content in future releases.

Name: BBC GoodFood
Description: Healthy food needn't be boring! This app has over 195 recipes for you to incorporate into your day-to-day cooking. More than 195 recipes to help tempt you to cook and eat healthily year-round, including Salmon & ginger fish cakes, Thai beef stir-fry and Indian butternut squash curry. Once you've downloaded the app, you can use and search the recipes at any time, even offline. There's something for everyone, and every meal (including breakfast). The app contains over 35 recipes that have less than 200 calories per portion, as well as healthy twists on classic dishes, like Chicken korma and Chocolate brownies - so you're sure to keep your friends and family happy too. Each recipe has full nutritional information, such as protein, fat carbs, sugar and kcals. You can switch between metric and imperial measurements. The app also has five helpful videos and details on eight healthy ingredients to add into your diet. Want more? Visit us at bbcgoodfood.com, for over 7,000 recipes all triple-tested by the in-house cookery team. This app is produced by BBC Worldwide, the commercial arm of the BBC. BBC Worldwide is self-funded and returns profits to the BBC to be reinvested in programmes and services to help keep the UK licence fee as low as possible. For those who wonder why our apps aren't free, BBC Worldwide has the responsibility of channelling funds back to the BBC, so the BBC can continue to create amazing content.

Name: Encyclopædia Britannica

Name: FhotoRoom
Description: Photo editing application

Name: Coca-Cola FM (newRetiled)
Description: Coca-Cola FM faz seu dia ser mais feliz. Com o aplicativo você pode ouvir os melhores sucessos na rádio e ainda pode mostrar para todos seus amigos as músicas que está ouvindo. Basta compartilhar nas redes sociais e espalhar felicidades. Baixe-o gratuitamente agora mesmo.

Name: Where's My Water
Description: Get the GAME OF THE YEAR award-winning puzzler! Help Swampy by guiding water to his broken shower. Each level is a challenging physics-based puzzle with amazing life-like mechanics. Cut through dirt to guide fresh water, dirty water, toxic water, steam, and ooze through increasingly challenging scenarios! Every drop counts! Original Stories & Characters – Play through 4 unique stories featuring Swampy, Allie, Cranky and Mystery Duck. That's over 500 amazing puzzles! Innovative Mechanic – See water in various forms and use your creativity to solve the puzzles – totally stimulating! Collectibles, Challenges, and Bonus Levels – Collect special items uniquely designed for each character and complete cool challenges to unlock bonus levels! Tri-Duck each level for ultimate bragging rights!

Name: Cut The Rope
Description: Cut the Rope is a physics-based puzzle video game developed by ZeptoLab and published by Chillingo for iOS, Android, Windows Phone, web browsers, Nintendo DSi, and Nintendo 3DS. The game was succeeded by Cut the Rope: Experiments in 2011 while a direct sequel, Cut the Rope 2, was released in 2013.

Name: MSN Health & Fitness (newRetiled)
Description: MSN Health & Fitness helps you keep track of your health, check activities, workouts, nutrition and others. Patched with newRetiled, credit to migbrunluz.

Name: Collection of Windows Startup Sounds
Description: Explore the collection of startup and shutdown sounds used in various versions of Windows operating systems. This application also has startup and shutdown sounds from unreleased versions of Windows, including Windows NT 5.0 beta and Windows Longhorn! Get great insight and fun facts on various sounds from the Did you Know boxes. Enjoy beautiful pictures, many of which show the packaging of the retail release of a particular Windows version. Note: Windows is a Trademark of Microsoft Corporation. The logos and sounds used in this application are own by Microsoft Corporation and are used for educational purposes only.

Name: Comix
Description: Comix is a comic reader supporting CBZ, CBR, CB7, ZIP, RAR, and 7z formats. For everyone who have a small or large collection, a library mode allows you to browse your books by cover, just select the folder / folders where you store your collections. It supports unlimited subfolders and switch the view between Books and Folders (sub collections) The reader allows pages to be maximised, fit to screen, rotated, joined and browse in thumbnail mode. You can also share individual pages using the Share Charm. Full support for landscape and portrait mode, when in landscape you can read in double page mode. You can switch the reading, and gestures. Left to Right - Right to Left You can mark your books as read in your local library and filter them in your collections. Please see the features below for help on usage. Thanks to everyone for your comments, requests and support. Please continue sending your emails at support.comix@objectspaces.info or in our facebook page http://www.facebook.com/comixwindows. In the unlikely event there is a bug please report them at the same email. NOTE: We cannot respond to reviews so please contact us directly for any request or issue.

Name: iCookbookSE
Description: The award-winning iCookbook™ is the first recipe and cooking app for Windows 8! iCookbook™ comes loaded with more than 2,000 hand-selected and kitchen-tested recipes—as many as found in 20 full-size cookbooks. All recipes can be displayed in an easy-to-read Prepare format for convenient use in the kitchen.

Name: Gateway Explorer
Description: Gateway Explorer makes it easy for you to take advantage of all your Gateway device has to offer. With Gateway Explorer, you'll explore beyond limits while learning about your Gateway device and your apps. Learn about preinstalled apps and features, access helpful tutorials for Gateway software and find support information.

Name: News Live Tiles
Description: Are you also missing a live tile for your favorite news site? With News Live Tiles you can easily create them yourselves within seconds! Name: Top Speed: Drag & Fast Racing
Description: BECOME A STREET RACING LEGEND Dominate your criminally insane rivals in extreme head-to-head drag races. Reach impossible speeds by expertly timing gear changes and bursts of nitro. Drive 69 cars, beat 20 criminal overlords and become the biggest fish in the city. Top Speed is setting the new standard within drag racing genre. Have you ever wanted to participate in underground races against unpredictable mafia mobs? Drive top class luxury cars and show everybody who's the boss? Jump right behind the wheel and get ready to have your breath taken away the moment you push that nitro button. In Top Speed you can tune and mod your ride to your liking. Increase the engine's power, upgrade your gear and nitro, repaint your car, slap on some decals if you need to. All of it will have a definite impact on the realistic driving simulation. When you unlock elite dragsters you can also reach for the most hardcore visual mods from the black market. All of the goods from the criminal nation are for your disposal - you just make sure to make good use of them in the race. Choose any car you want from an astounding selection of 69 rides - you can drive classic stock cars, new heavily modded dragsters and even national police vehicles from 5 different countries. Nothing will stop you from burning the rubber on the streets. All races take place off the grid, away from the traffic, so you can get crazy with burnout, plow the asphalt and race with no limits. Challenge the odds as a mafia underdog and make your way to the very top. On every step you'll have to race against each of the 20 criminal overlords that keep the city in their steel grasp. The city's asphalt will become a battleground and no limit will be placed upon you - let ambition and adrenaline be your guide in this race. You're the best new racer on these streets, but your rivals still don't know that. How about showing them that by leaving them behind in the smoke from burnout after you drop the nitro? Kids, don't try this at home! Drag race in 5 beautiful and distinctive city districts. From quaint Suburbs to teeming with high life Downtown, your need for sightseeing will be satisfied. Drive for glory and adrenaline in the Little Asia district, a fusion of China and the western world. Reach incredible velocities on the scenic Highway. As a professional arcade racer you'll have plenty of opportunities to show off your ride in nice and realistic surroundings. Your skills will be tested, so get ready for the most intense arcade racing game of 2015! Download for free now. Turn on, tune it, race out!Let your creativity flow through a ton of tuning and customization optionsPick from 69 cars: stock rides, dragsters and police vehicles

Escute podcasts dos comentaristas a qualquer hora do dia e os siga no Twitter. Acompanhe os blogs da emissora, em uma plataforma intuitiva e prazerosa. Leia notícias do mundo todo no Portal CBN. Name: RemindMe For Windows
Description: RemindMe is a simple, but powerful, reminders application for Windows. RemindMe lets you quickly create reminders for relative (ex: in 10 minutes) or absolute (ex: 3:00PM on 5/9/2013) times. Watch your reminders count down in real time. RemindMe integrates deeply with Windows 8. Get toast notifications for reminders, see your next reminders on the live tile, sync your reminders across your Windows 8.1 devices, and stay up to date on the lock screen. You can even pin the compose screen to Start to quickly create new reminders. With an amazing, easy-to-use UI and features like live countdowns, RemindMe is the Windows 8 reminder (or task manger, or to do list, or countdown) app to beat. Oh, and it is completely free with no ads or upsell. What's not to like? NEW: Pause reminders, customize RemindMe's theme, a new color, new settings, and more.

Name: Microsoft Jigsaw
Description: Piece together the FUN in Microsoft Jigsaw! Discover hundreds of puzzles across three (3) winning game modes: Classic, Jigsaw Jam, & Daily Challenges. Pick a favorite puzzle, create your own, or unlock NEW puzzle collections as you play. Find relaxation and joy as you exercise your mind. Classic Jigsaw: Complete traditional jigsaw puzzles with endless themes and images to choose from. Select the number of pieces to make it easy, moderate or difficult. Zoom-in, auto-arrange, or use special in-game trays to get organized. If you enjoy real jigsaw puzzling, Classic Mode is the experience for you! Jigsaw Jam: Looking for an energy boost, complete puzzles as you race against the clock. Place each piece quickly to earn bonus multipliers and build a high score! Jigsaw Jam is easy to play but challenging to master. Daily Challenges: Discover new challenges every day! Complete fresh jigsaw puzzles and game modes to earn badges throughout the month. Custom Puzzles: Turn a favorite memory or photo into a jigsaw puzzle! Upload a picture to easily transform into playable pieces. Share your custom puzzles with friends and family. Sign In: Create a Microsoft Account to save your progress, track your game stats or play on multiple devices. Play Microsoft Jigsaw today!

Name: Network Speed Test
Description: How fast is your Internet connection? Network Speed Test measures your network delay, download speed and upload speed. Using servers all over the world, Network Speed Test measures your network connection's latency and throughput. Based on your connection's speed, Network Speed Test will tell you what activities you might be able to do, such as stream music or video calls. Slide to the right to see a history of your previous tests for easy comparisons. When you test your network using the Network Speed Test, certain characteristics of your device and the network connection will be sent to Microsoft to help improve our understanding of network quality and availability. If you consent, we may also collect information about your location at the time of the test. The data we collect is not associated with you, and will not be used to identify or contact you or for other purposes like targeted marketing. For additional information, see our privacy statement.

The world of ilomilo is made of cubes, and ilo and milo can walk any side of the cubes, as well as move cubes around. The player controls both ilo and milo, and will have to make them cooperate to unite them. ilomilo also allows players to control one character each, and play through the game cooperatively Features: ilomilo plus challenges players with out of the ordinary puzzles in an odyssey through a twisted and surrealistic world. • Singleplayer story taking you through 6 different environments in the world of ilomilo • Cooperative gameplay mode for two players, each player controlling a character! • Famous cameo characters from other games are hidden in the world for players to find • Online Leaderboards: Compare online who has completed the levels in the most clever way • Unlockable mini game: Play the ingenious retro 2D mini game ilomilo shuffle with its own competitive leaderboard

Name: Rescue Team
Description: The Rescue Team is on standby when it starts receiving reports of strange phenomenon taking place around the globe. At first, wacky weather patterns seem to the worst of the planet's worries, but then strange robotic creatures begin to emerge from oceans and caverns and spark catastrophic calamities! Known as Power Eaters, the robot forces unleash unimaginable power surges wherever they appear! As the leader of the Rescue Team, you will use your courageous crew to investigate their origin and shut them down before they turn Earth into a huge ball of lightning! As you tackle this exhilarating quest, you'll plan out the best path through each level and the race to gather resources, repair damage, save victims and defeat an ever-growing variety of bizarre robots. Can you find a way to reprogram the machines and use them for good? Will you be able to locate the devious mind behind their appearance? And can you grill enough hamburgers to keep your crew happy? It's all in a day's work as you command the Rescue Team through another epic escapade! Download and play Rescue Team: Power Eaters today!

Use strategy to figure out the quickest way to complete your goals, and then race against the clock to remove debris, repair bridges, put out fires, restore communications and save victims. Easy to play and challenging to master, Rescue Team 2 proves you can't have too much of a good thing!

Name: Crash Course Go!
Description: Get ready to run, jump, and dodge your way through outrageous obstacle courses in Doritos Crash Course GO, the fast-paced platformer that brings the thrill of a game show right to your screen! Race Against the Clock: Test your reflexes across wild tracks filled with swinging hammers, slippery slides, and explosive traps. Pick Up & Play: Easy-to-learn controls make it fun for anyone, but mastering every level takes skill and precision. Compete & Conquer: Beat your best times, climb the leaderboards, and prove you're the ultimate crash course champion. Whether you're chasing high scores or just looking for quick bursts of fun, Doritos Crash Course GO delivers addictive action in bite-sized runs. Strap in—it's time to crash, dash, and laugh your way to victory!

CalcForce operates both as a standard scientific calculator and as a multi operation, multi variable calculator. You can open multiple calculations and switch between calculations. Drag and drop the result of one calculation into another calculation. Results are stored in history and you can undo and redo calculation input. Calculation data is automatically saved so you can use the next time you open CalcForce. CalcForce is ideal for engineers, scientists, students, programmers or anyone that needs a robust computer calculator. Use CalcForce to solve math and engineering problems; analyze loans; calculate budgets; determine BMI; and more...

Name: Flappy Bird
Description: Flappy Bird is a 2013 casual mobile game developed by Vietnamese video game artist and programmer Dong Nguyen (Vietnamese: Nguyễn Hà Đông), under his game development company .Gears.[1] The game is a side-scroller where the player controls a bird, Faby, attempting to fly between columns of green pipes without hitting them. The player's score is determined by the number of pipes they pass. Nguyen created the game over a period of several days, using the bird from a cancelled game made in 2012.

It is similar in structure and features to the iOS and Android Camera apps.

Name: 哔哩MetroUI焕新版
Description: 哔哩哔哩（Bilibili）是中国知名的视频分享与互动平台，常被称为“B站”。它起源于二次元文化，最初以动画、漫画、游戏内容为核心，逐渐扩展到音乐、舞蹈、科技、生活、教育等多元领域。用户不仅可以观看视频，还能通过弹幕与其他观众实时互动，形成独特的社区氛围。Bilibili 在 Windows 8 平台上也曾推出客户端，支持高清视频播放、弹幕功能以及账号同步，让用户在 PC 上享受与移动端一致的体验。它不仅是娱乐平台，更是年轻人交流与创作的聚集地。

Name: SkyDrive Metro
Description: SkyDrive 是 Windows 8 系统中一款重要的云存储应用。它为用户提供便捷的文件同步与共享功能，让文档、照片、视频可以随时随地访问。通过与操作系统深度整合，用户能够在桌面、平板和手机之间无缝切换，保持数据一致。SkyDrive 支持自动备份，确保资料安全可靠，同时还能轻松与朋友或同事分享文件，提升协作效率。界面简洁直观，操作流畅，符合 Windows 8 的现代风格。它不仅是存储工具，更是连接工作与生活的桥梁，带来高效与便利。

Name: 狂野飙车8：极速凌云
Description: 《狂野飙车8：极速凌云》是 Windows 8 平台上一款极具人气的赛车游戏。它以高速竞速和炫酷特技为核心玩法，玩家可以驾驶多种豪华跑车，在全球各地的赛道上体验极速快感。游戏画面精美，物理效果逼真，支持漂移、跳跃和空中特技动作，带来震撼的视觉与操作体验。通过多人模式，玩家还能与好友或全球玩家实时对战，增加竞技乐趣。Asphalt 8 不仅是赛车游戏，更是速度与激情的象征，充分展现 Windows 8 平台的娱乐魅力。

Name: Melegram Web
Description: 这是一个基于mpgram的Windows 8.1版Telegram网页应用！Telegram（也称为Telegram Messenger）是一款基于云端的跨平台社交媒体和即时通讯（IM）服务。它于2013年8月14日发布iOS版本，并于2013年10月20日发布Android版本。用户可以通过Telegram交换消息、分享媒体和文件，进行私人和群组语音或视频通话，以及公开直播。Telegram支持Android、iOS、Windows、macOS、Linux、Wear OS、watchOS和网页浏览器。Telegram在语音和视频通话中提供端到端加密，如果双方都使用移动设备，则在私人聊天中也可以选择加密。 Telegram还具备社交网络功能，允许用户发布动态、创建最多可容纳20万成员的公共群组，并在所谓的“频道”中向无限数量的受众单向分享更新。

Name: IT之家
Description: ITHome 应用是 Windows 8 平台上一款专注于 IT 新闻与科技资讯的客户端。它为用户提供最新的行业动态、产品评测、技术文章以及热门话题，让科技爱好者能够第一时间掌握信息。应用界面采用 Windows 8 的现代风格，支持磁贴显示，用户可以在开始屏幕上快速浏览新闻摘要。通过分类浏览与搜索功能，用户能够轻松找到感兴趣的内容。ITHome 不仅是新闻阅读工具，更是连接开发者、用户与行业的桥梁，帮助大家在信息时代保持前沿视角与高效获取资讯。

Name: 微软寻宝游戏
Description: Microsoft Treasure Hunt（微软寻宝）是一款由微软工作室开发的免费解谜冒险游戏，其核心玩法建立在经典的扫雷基础之上。在游戏中，玩家将扮演一位探险家，深入地下迷宫寻找财富。游戏融合了经典的扫雷逻辑与角色扮演元素：玩家需要根据数字标记可疑地形，小心规划每一步以避开陷阱，同时收集金币、工具和武器。利用收集到的金币，还可以在商店购买补给品和永久升级，为深入地球中心的探险之旅提供助力。游戏支持Xbox Live集成，玩家可以获取成就并与好友在排行榜上一较高下，进度也会保存在云端。

Name: 简单单人纸牌
Description: 《Simple Solitaire》是 Random Salad Games 开发的一款经典纸牌游戏，主打纯粹的克朗代克玩法。游戏提供翻一张或三张牌两种模式，并支持标准计分和维加斯计分规则。操作轻松，提供无限次的提示和撤销功能。此外，玩家还可以自定义背景和卡面图案。游戏无需注册账号，也没有强制内购，完全免费下载，力求还原当年电脑自带纸牌的纯粹乐趣。

Name: Dailymotion
Description: ailymotion 是一款全球流行的视频分享应用，提供海量原创内容，涵盖新闻、音乐、体育、娱乐等多元领域。与追求播放量的算法不同，它更注重营造社群互动氛围，让用户围绕视频进行实时交流。应用提供个性化推荐、书签收藏和离线观看功能，方便随时随地欣赏视频。此外，创作者还能使用绿幕、分层剪辑等专业工具编辑和上传内容。App支持跨平台使用（iOS 16.0及以上、Android 5.0及以上），并提供订阅服务Dailymotion Pass以解锁更多权益。

Name: 简单蜘蛛纸牌

Name: 德州扑克
Description: 《Texas Holdem Poker》是一款由 HytoGame 开发的在线德州扑克游戏，曾在 Windows 10 和 Windows Phone 平台发布。 游戏主打高质量的界面设计和精品多人对战体验，玩家可以与全球用户一同竞技，并支持玩家间实时在线聊天。除了核心玩法，游戏还设计了丰富的个性化系统，包含多款高清头像和数百种娱乐道具。 该游戏采用免费下载加内购的模式，内购价格从 $1.99 到 $99.99 不等。应用支持中英文等多种语言，其版权标注为 © 2013 HytoGame

Name: 3rd Floor 二十一点游戏
Description: 《3rd Floor Blackjack》是 3rd Floor Games 开发的一款免费二十一点游戏 游戏主打以下特色： 四种独特主题牌桌：每种牌桌都有自己的风格和玩法。 刺激的边注玩法：提供多种边注选择，为牌局增加更多策略和趣味。 成就收集系统：通过完成不同挑战来获得成就，提升技巧。 赢取代币解锁内容：玩家可通过获胜代币解锁新的边注和牌桌，提高重玩性。 完全免费：游戏免费下载和游玩。 在线排行榜：与全球玩家比拼分数。 该游戏由 3rd Floor Games 于 2013 年 9 月发布，是一款为 Windows 平台打造的免费单机休闲游戏。

Name: 德州扑克 (高级版)
Description: 《Texas Holdem Poker Plus》是一款由 HytoGame 开发的在线德州扑克游戏，曾在 Windows 10 和 Windows Phone 平台发布。 游戏主打高质量的界面设计和精品多人对战体验，玩家可以与全球用户一同竞技，并支持玩家间实时在线聊天。除了核心玩法，游戏还设计了丰富的个性化系统，包含多款高清头像和数百种娱乐道具。 该游戏采用免费下载加内购的模式，内购价格从 $1.99 到 $99.99 不等。应用支持中英文等多种语言，其版权标注为 © 2013 HytoGame

Id: 黑手党之城大犯罪任务
Name: 黑手党之城大犯罪任务
Description: Mafia City Grand Crime Mission 或 Mafia City Grand Theft Mission，由 UK Arts Games 开发。 这是一款免费的 3D 动作冒险游戏，风格类似《GTA》，玩家扮演黑帮分子在迈阿密、拉斯维加斯和圣安地列斯等城市中完成各种犯罪任务，如街头火并、抢劫银行、躲避警察追捕等

Name: 开心农场2：乡村度假
Description: 《FarmVille 2: Country Escape》是由 Zynga 开发的一款免费模拟经营类手游，也是经典农场游戏《FarmVille》系列的移动端作品。游戏于2014年发布，支持 iOS 和 Android 平台，并包含中文在内的多种语言。 游戏的核心玩法围绕经营农场展开：玩家通过种植作物、饲养动物（如奶牛、鸡、马等），收获原料后在乳品厂、烤箱等加工设施中制作各类商品，完成订单来赚取金币和经验，逐步升级并解锁新内容。游戏还设有“爹爹池塘”、“梅里韦瑟矿洞”等特殊区域供玩家探索，收集稀有材料。 在社交方面，玩家可以加入“农场合作社”，与好友或其他玩家交易、互助完成任务，也可以选择“匿名模式”独自游玩。游戏支持离线模式，没有网络也能进行种植、收获等核心操作。游戏免费下载，包含内购项目，但玩家反馈无需付费也能获得良好体验

Name: Monster Go!
Description: 《Monster Go!》是由 Game Troopers 发行的一款结合了RPG元素的横版无尽奔跑游戏。游戏最早于2015年5月独家登陆Windows Phone平台，之后也计划发布iOS和Android版本。 游戏的核心玩法是控制小怪兽奔跑闯关，过程中可以不断成长和强化角色。主要特色包括： 选择初始怪兽：提供三种不同技能和风格的怪兽供玩家选择。 丰富的养成系统：支持升级超过10种主动和被动技能，并能让怪兽进化到更强的形态。 海量装备搭配：拥有超过150种武器、盔甲和饰品供收集和装扮。 多种游戏模式：玩家可以挑战5个不同的关卡和5个强大的Boss，通关后可解锁无尽模式。 Xbox Live集成：游戏包含大量Xbox成就，总计可获得300G的成就点数

Name: Imperia Online: The Great People
Description: 《Imperia Online: The Great People》是由开发商 Game Troopers 发行的一款大型多人在线策略游戏（MMO），原版游戏由保加利亚工作室 Imperia Online Ltd 开发，最早于2005年推出，后在2015年由 Game Troopers 将其引入 Windows 平台并与 Xbox Live 集成。 游戏设定在火药发明前的冷兵器时代，玩家将扮演一位皇帝，从管理一个行省开始，通过建造资源建筑、研发科技、招募军队来逐步扩张领土，最终建立强大的帝国。 游戏的核心特色包括： “伟大之人”系统：玩家可以建立自己的皇家王朝，管理王室成员，任命他们担任总督或将军等职位，并获得对应的管理或军事加成。 深度策略与社交玩法：玩家可以攻击其他玩家的行省来掠夺资源，也可以建立或加入联盟，进行军事和经济合作。 Xbox Live 支持：游戏包含多项 Xbox 成就供玩家解锁。在 Windows 10 版本中，还拥有独占的 3D 战斗画面和优化的用户界面。

Name: 亿贝 (eBay)
Description: eBay 官方曾为 Windows 8 推出过一款 Metro 风格应用，利用动态磁贴和分享功能提供便捷的购物体验。然而，该应用已于 2016 年停止服务并从商店下架，官方建议用户改用移动浏览器访问网站。此后，微软商店再未推出新版 eBay 客户端。如今，Windows 用户只能通过网页使用 eBay，虽然功能完整，但缺少了原生应用的流畅感和系统集成体验。这款应用的消失，也反映了 Windows Phone 生态衰落的大背景，以及 eBay 对移动端策略的重新调整。

Name: 超级照片免费版
Description: SuperPhoto 是由开发商 Moonlighting 推出的一款照片编辑应用，其 Windows 8 版本曾可在 Windows Store 下载。 这款软件以丰富的特效库为卖点，免费版本内置超过300种效果，付费升级后可解锁多达1500余种滤镜和特效。功能涵盖艺术风格转换（如绘画、铅笔画、卡通效果）、趣味画框（可将照片嵌入T恤、电视、纸币中）、以及形状叠加、马赛克和3D旋转等创意编辑。 应用兼容 Windows 8、8.1

Name: Fhotoroom 照片编辑软件
Description: Fhotoroom 是由 Supporting Computers Inc 开发的一款照片编辑与分享应用，专为 Windows 8 平板和手机设计。它被 PCMag 评价为在 Instagram 模式基础上加入了强大的编辑工具，甚至在某些方面超越了它。 该应用提供丰富的滤镜和特效，并拥有一个活跃的、用户达数百万的照片分享社区。与手机版不同，Windows 8 平板版的 Fhotoroom 没有内置相机功能，但支持处理专业相机的 RAW 格式文件，并提供更强大的“Pro Tools”专业编辑工具，如降噪、局部调整笔刷等。应用免费，且无需注册即可用作照片编辑器。

Name: 旋转轮
Description: 由波兰开发商制作的旋转轮盘游戏

Name: 推特 Tweetium
Description: Tweetium 是由 B-side Software 开发的一款第三方 Twitter 客户端，曾被誉为 Windows 8.1 和 Windows Phone 平台上最优秀的 Twitter 应用之一。它以界面流畅、功能丰富和多账户管理著称，支持实时推文流、推送通知和 TweetMarker 同步。应用采用免费试用加 Pro 订阅的模式。然而，2018年 Twitter 调整 API 策略，停用用户流 API，导致推送通知失效，B-side 随即停止 Pro 订阅服务。2023年初，Twitter 基本关闭第三方 API 访问，Tweetium 彻底无法使用，成为平台生态变迁中的一个经典遗憾。

Name: 微软拼图
Description: Microsoft Jigsaw 是微软官方出品的拼图游戏，在 2014 年正式登陆了 Windows 8.1 应用商店，也可在 Windows RT 和 Windows 10 上运行。它是一款免费应用，支持键鼠与触摸屏两种操作方式。 这款游戏为玩家提供了三种核心玩法： 经典拼图 (Classic Jigsaw)：传统的拼图模式，内置上百张高清图片，并支持选择 4 种难度等级，最多可达 216 块碎片。 竞速模式 (Jigsaw Jam)：限时挑战模式，要求玩家在倒计时内快速找到正确位置，以获取分数加成。 每日挑战 (Daily Challenges)：每天都更新新的拼图任务，积攒月度徽章。 游戏的一大特色是支持自定义拼图，玩家可以从设备上传自己的照片来生成独一无二的拼图。此外，它还整合了 Xbox Live 功能，玩家可以登录账号获取成就、参与排行榜，并将游戏进度保存在云端。 值得一提的是，该应用在发布初期曾短暂上架后又迅速下架，不过很快就重新上线了。根据玩家反馈，在 Windows 8 系统上运行时，也出现过因系统更新导致应用无法正常打开的情况。

Name: 欢乐屋 House of Fun
Description: 《House of Fun》是 Playtika UK – House of Fun Limited 开发的一款免费赌场风格老虎机游戏。它曾登陆 Windows 8 平台，但目前其主要平台为 iOS 和 Android，需通过模拟器才能在电脑上游玩。 游戏提供了海量的老虎机选择与深度系统： 丰富的老虎机库：内置超过400款老虎机，涵盖复古三轴经典款和带有百搭、散落符号及多阶段奖励回合的现代视频老虎机。 深度的收藏系统：每次旋转可收集卡包，包含不同稀有度的卡片。集齐主题相册可兑换金币奖励，重复卡片可通过星光市场交易，不断获取收益。 多样的奖励机制：每日登录可领取免费金币礼包并转动“欢乐轮盘”，游戏内还有频繁的累积奖金机会和特殊挑战活动。 Playtika Rewards 计划：游戏与更广泛的 Playtika 忠诚度计划相连，游玩获得的积分可在多款旗下游戏中兑换福利与金币奖励。 该游戏面向21岁及以上成年人，仅为免费娱乐应用，不涉及真钱赌博或现实奖品。

Name: 微软扫雷
Description: 在 Windows 8 时代，经典的《扫雷》迎来了一次重要的革新。它不再是系统自带游戏，而是变成了一款需要从 Windows 应用商店免费下载的应用，由 Arkadium 与微软合作开发，Microsoft Studios 发行。 这款名为 Microsoft Minesweeper 的新版游戏，在保留经典逻辑玩法的同时，进行了全面升级。主要带来了以下几个变化： 全新的视觉与操作：游戏画面和音效都得到了改进，并针对触屏操作进行了优化，让它在平板等设备上玩起来更顺手。 增加了新的游戏模式：除了我们熟悉的“经典模式”，还加入了“冒险模式”和“每日挑战”。在冒险模式中，你需要控制角色，运用扫雷的规则进行探索和寻宝。 集成了Xbox Live功能：支持登录Xbox账号以获得成就、查看排行榜，并将游戏进度保存在云端。

Id: 微软纸牌合集 Solitaire collection
Name: 微软纸牌合集 Solitaire collection
Description: 《微软纸牌合集》是微软于2012年随Windows 8推出的经典纸牌游戏，由Arkadium开发。它将克朗代克、蜘蛛纸牌、空当接龙、金字塔和远古纸牌五种玩法整合于一体，首次将金字塔和TriPeaks纳入主线合集。游戏采用免费加广告模式，并深度整合Xbox Live，支持成就、排行榜与云端进度同步。新增的每日挑战和星光俱乐部系统提升了耐玩性，丰富主题与背景也允许个性化定制。这款应用取代了系统内置纸牌，成为Windows平台纸牌游戏的新标杆，至今仍在持续更新。

Name: Croc's 世界
Description: 《Croc's World》是一款由 Sprakelsoft GmbH 开发的平台跳跃游戏，于2014年左右登陆 Windows 8 和 Windows Phone 平台。游戏采用类似《超级马里奥》的复古画风，讲述一只小鳄鱼的冒险之旅。其内容包含60个关卡，跨越四个不同主题世界，玩家需躲避刺猬、蜜蜂等敌人并收集钻石以获取额外生命。游戏针对Windows 8和8.1系统设计，后来也推出了《Croc's World Construction Kit》等衍生作品。

Name: 十字路口 Crossy Road
Description: 《Crossy Road》是由 Hipster Whale 开发的经典无尽跑酷游戏，其 Windows 8 版本于 2015 年发布。游戏采用复古像素风格，玩法简单但令人上瘾——玩家需操控角色不断穿过繁忙道路、铁轨和河流，躲避车辆等障碍物，争取走得更远。 该游戏在 Windows 平台还有一个独特的版本，即《Disney Crossy Road》，由迪士尼与 Hipster Whale 合作推出，同样支持 Windows 8 和 8.1。该版本提供了超过 100 个来自迪士尼和皮克斯的角色，并包含《玩具总动员》《狮子王》等经典主题的像素世界。

Name: QQ
Description: QQ是腾讯专为Windows 8 Metro界面开发的QQ客户端，采用UWP架构，于2012年2月29日作为国内首款Win8应用上线应用商店。它采用动态背景和左右式布局，适配触控与键鼠操作。核心功能包括文字表情收发、语音消息、离线文件传输及QQ空间动态预览，并支持分屏视图。初期版本Bug较多，曾多次优化登录稳定性与闪退问题。该版本不支持多账号同时登录，且与PC版QQ存在互斥。

Name: 红迪客户端 (Charming Reddit)
Description: “Charming Reddit”是Windows 8上一款专注于图片浏览的Reddit客户端，界面类似画廊应用，用户能清晰看到缩略图、描述、评论数和投票数。它深度整合了Windows 8的超级按钮（Charms Bar）：用户可通过“设置”超级按钮登录账户，通过“分享”超级按钮将内容分享给他人。应用默认打开/r/pics/版块，可切换查看其它热门子版块，并支持按热度、得分或最新进行排序。

Name: 天氣預報 AccuWeather
Description: AccuWeather for Windows 8 是一款由 AccuWeather 官方推出的沉浸式天气应用，于 2012 年 10 月随 Windows 8 上线。该应用采用全新的 Windows UI 设计，拥有丰富的动态天气动画，能直观展示当前天气状况。应用支持超过 270 万个全球地点的精准预报，提供每小时、未来 72 小时及 25 天的详细预报。其核心功能包括：实时更新的天气数据（含 RealFeel 体感温度）、交互式 Bing 地图雷达图层、以及 My AccuWeather 生活方式预报，可显示天气对健康与户外活动的影响。应用完全免费下载，并支持动态磁贴自动刷新。2014 年更新加入了 MinuteCast 分钟级降水预报，并向通用应用转型。

Name: 联想 Power DVD
Description: PowerDVD for Windows 8由讯连科技（CyberLink）推出，包含PowerDVD 12和PowerDVD Mobile两个版本。此应用主要填补了Windows 8系统移除DVD原生播放支持后的空白，使用户能继续播放DVD、蓝光光盘及多种视频文件。PowerDVD Mobile针对Windows 8平板优化，界面适配触控，支持播放视频、音乐和照片。应用界面以媒体库形式展示内容，功能强大，被视为Windows 8上的必备播放软件之一。

Id: 你的摄像头 YouCam Metro 联想
Name: 你的摄像头 YouCam Metro 联想
Description: YouCam for Windows 8是由讯连科技（CyberLink）推出的相机应用，专为触控设备优化。该应用主要包括两个版本：YouCam Metro Beta作为早期Metro版本，支持实时趣味特效与TrueTheater Lighting一键增强功能；YouCam Mobile则为移动设备提供面部识别、自动分组管理、变形动画特效及降噪等高级功能。应用深度整合Windows 8触控特性，拍摄内容可直接分享至YouTube或Facebook。该应用支持Windows 8及8.1系统，后期虽已从商店下架，但讯连科技仍为Windows 10用户提供桌面版YouCam软件。

Name: 韦氏词典
Description: Merriam-Webster 官方词典应用于 2012 年 10 月随 Windows 8 同步上线，被视为“Windows 8 的重要参考工具”。该应用整合了《韦氏大学词典》的全部权威释义，并内置同义词库、例句、音频发音及超过 1000 幅图解和 2 万条传记地理词条。应用针对触控界面进行了特别优化，支持语音搜索、每日一词、收藏与查询历史等功能。该应用免费下载，由广告支持，可离线查词

Name: 联想服务 (OEM)
Description: 联想的OEM应用程序

Name: 联想公司
Description: 联想的OEM应用程序

Name: 快乐渔夫
Description: 《Fishing Joy》（捕鱼达人）在Windows 8时代有多个相关版本。 一款名为《快乐渔夫》的捕鱼游戏于2013年登陆Win8应用商店，操作简单、界面华丽，支持联网排名和成就系统。 此外，由Dong Tran开发的《Fishing Diary, Fishing Joy》也兼容Windows 8.1/8系统，属于免费射击捕鱼类游戏，玩家通过猎鱼获取金币和奖励。另一个名为《捕鱼达人2017版》的游戏同样支持Win8系统。

Name: 森林探险
Description: 一款适合儿童的解谜游戏

Name: 魔法换装
Description: 一款适合儿童的游戏

Name: 大英百科全书
Description: Encyclopaedia Britannica 官方在 2012 年 10 月 26 日，也就是 Windows 8 系统发布当天，同步推出了 Windows 8 应用 。 这款应用为大英百科全书的数字化版本，收录了超过 80,000 篇文章和数万张高清图片，内容由专家和学者撰写 。应用针对 Windows 8 的触控操作进行了优化，并拥有一个独特的可视化关联浏览功能——Link Map，可以通过节点图谱形式展示相关条目之间的联系 。应用支持搜索、书签、保存文章以及固定到开始屏幕 。 该应用免费下载，免费版可阅读“热门文章”和每日特色文章，但大多数文章仅能预览前 100 个单词。如需解锁全部内容，需支付每年 $14.99 美元的年费订阅 。

Name: 联想免费游乐游戏
Description: 联想专属应用程序

Name: 免费在线影免费版
Description: 该应用程序提取自联想OEM Windows 8笔记本电脑，但已过时。

Name: McAfee 安全顾问
Description: McAfee Security Advisor 是专为 Windows 8 设计的一款应用，它会以一个独立的动态磁贴出现在开始屏幕上。它的主要作用是提供一个进入 McAfee 安全系统的入口，让你能快速查看电脑的安全状态。 这个应用与 McAfee 杀毒软件本身是分开的，它本身并不提供病毒或恶意软件防护功能。你可以把它看作是一个 状态显示器：磁贴会通过绿色（受保护）、红色（存在风险）或灰色（未激活）来直观展示当前的安全等级，点击后还能看到更详细的状态说明，并方便地打开主程序来修复问题。 不过，这个应用在 Windows 8 上口碑不算太好，常被用户抱怨存在无法正常显示状态信息等问题，有些人甚至将其视为不需要的“捆绑软件”

Name: 红色卡拉OK
Description: Red Karaoke 是 Windows 8 上一款备受欢迎的免费在线卡拉OK应用，它提供了一个随时随地在电脑上唱歌和展示自我的平台。 该应用最大的亮点是拥有超过 45,000 首海量歌曲库，涵盖从经典老歌到现代流行、摇滚、R&B 等多种音乐类型。你可以通过歌手名或歌曲标题进行搜索。应用内置了实用的歌唱辅助功能，例如在播放音乐的同时滚动显示带节拍提示的歌词，并且支持调整音调以匹配你的嗓音。 Red Karaoke 不仅仅是一个歌唱应用，它还鼓励用户录制并分享自己的表演视频，形成了一个活跃的全球社区。社区内拥有超过300万用户，你可以观看、评论他人的作品并参与视频评分。应用免费提供10首每月更新的歌曲体验，通过购买或VIP订阅可解锁完整曲库

Name: 你发送它
Description: 联想OEM app

Name: Zinio
Description: Zinio for Windows 8 是一款数字杂志阅读应用，曾被看作Windows 8的最佳杂志阅读软件之一，提供超过5000种杂志的访问权限，包含《国家地理》《Vogue》和《经济学人》等著名刊物。 应用针对Win8优化，支持高分辨率阅读、触控缩放、离线下载以及将内容固定到开始屏幕。 该应用免费下载，但阅读完整内容需付费订阅或购买单本杂志。然而该应用官方已停止支持，不再提供新杂志更新

Name: 余光 After light
Description: Afterlight 是一款备受欢迎的照片编辑应用，其 Windows 8.1 版本于 2015 年上线。 它并非游戏，而是提供专业级修图工具。应用内置57种滤镜、66种纹理、79种相框，以及亮度、饱和度等8种基础调整工具，并集成了相机与裁切功能。应用为付费下载，售价约 $0.99/€0.99，并提供试用版。

Name: VK
Description: VK（即Vkontakte）的官方Windows 8应用曾在Windows Store上架，为俄罗斯等俄语地区用户提供社交服务。应用针对触控优化，支持多种尺寸的动态磁贴和分屏视图。2013年Windows 8.1推出后，应用经过改版，新增了反馈功能、英语和乌克兰语支持，并集成了必应地图和Yandex地图。不过该应用功能相对基础，消息功能需另外下载独立应用。随着VK放弃对Windows 8系统的支持，该版本已停止更新，用户需使用网页版或升级系统

Name: PhotoFunia
Description: PhotoFunia 曾推出一款免费的 Windows 8 应用，让用户能轻松制作趣味照片合成图。它利用云端技术自动识别人脸，将照片融入广告牌、杂志封面等数百种特效场景中，操作简单，效果逼真。 这款应用针对 Windows 8 触控界面优化，使用流畅。在当时的杂志评测中，它获得了 4.5 星（满分 5 星）的高度评价。

Name: 京东
Description: 京东商城在2012年11月推出了Windows 8专用客户端，是首批支持Win8系统的国内电商应用之一。 该应用采用“Windows 8 Style”（Metro）设计风格，针对触屏设备进行了优化。核心功能包括商品浏览、下单购买、订单跟踪、商品分类搜索，以及特色的“掌上秒杀”和“随便逛逛”（根据购物习惯智能推荐商品）。 应用支持将“我的京东”、“订单跟踪”等页面固定到开始屏幕，方便快速访问。据当时的评测，该应用商品信息较为丰富，但在界面设计细节和购物流程体验上仍有改进空间，且支付仍需跳转网页端完成。

Name: Windows 93 (非官方)
Description: Windows 93 并不是微软官方发布的操作系统，而是一个著名的网络艺术作品和恶搞项目。它是一个网页桌面（Web Desktop），通过浏览器访问 windows93.net 即可体验。该项目由两位法国音乐人兼程序员 jankenpopp 和 Zombectro 于 2014 年创作，是对 Windows 9x 系列的趣味戏仿。 这个网页操作系统充满了对 90 年代末和 21 世纪初网络迷因及流行文化的引用。启动时它会播放一段模仿经典操作系统的开机音效（实际采样自 PlayStation）。内部包含大量可交互的应用程序，例如： 恶搞游戏：戏仿《德军总部3D》的《Castle GAFA 3D》和模仿《街头霸王》的《KOF '93》。 经典与创意工具：文本编辑器、像素画编辑器、ASCII 艺术画廊、MIDI 音乐播放器，甚至还有一个能在当前窗口内再开一个 Windows 93 的“虚拟机”。 Windows 93 诞生后迅速走红，仅用两周就吸引了数百万用户。它被法国文化机构纳入展览，被视为数字文化领域的代表作品。

Name: 我的世界 Windows 8
Description: 该游戏主要面向Windows 8，包含生存和创造模式。该版本在2015年已停止更新支持，原因是Windows 8的玩家活跃度过低。有用户反馈该游戏在Windows 8系统上存在兼容性问题，建议升级系统或安装特定驱动解决。

Name: Windows Central
Description: Windows Central官方Windows 8应用是一款第三方新闻客户端，用于阅读Windows Central网站（原WPCentral）的内容。应用免费下载，含广告支持。它针对触控操作优化，支持动态磁贴显示最新文章、评论互动和离线阅读。应用提供可调字体样式与大小、多色主题等个性化选项。开发团队曾积极收集用户反馈，持续更新修复Bug和改善体验。该应用后期也推出了适配Windows 10的版本。

Name: 爱图网络浏览器
Description: AITO Web Browser 的开发者 chockingnetdude 是一位专门为旧款电子设备（如 Windows 8/8.1 和 Windows Phone 7/8/10 等）开发应用的社区开发者。该浏览器是他多个项目中的一个，这些项目共同致力于复兴这些老旧平台的应用生态。

Name: Google Search 复兴版
Description: Google Search 是谷歌官方为 Windows 8 推出的首款应用，于 2012 年 10 月上线。该应用深度整合了谷歌搜索核心服务，提供语音搜索、图片搜索和即时预览模式，并支持通过 Charm 栏快速调用。应用支持将 Gmail、YouTube 等 Google 服务快捷入口集成于一体。应用免费下载，但当时不适用于 Windows RT 设备。

Name: 亚马逊
Description: 亚马逊曾在Windows 8系统发布时，推出过一款官方购物应用，支持在Modern界面下直接搜索、浏览和购买商品。该应用兼容x86/x64架构的Windows 8以及Windows RT设备，并支持动态磁贴和心愿单等功能。 这款应用当时与Kindle for Windows 8阅读应用共同构成了亚马逊在Win8平台的主要产品。不过，亚马逊后来调整了策略。他们在2016年将Kindle for Windows 8应用从商店下架，集中精力维护传统的Win32版Kindle for PC应用。目前，微软商店已不再提供官方的Amazon Shopping应用，用户只能通过浏览器访问亚马逊网站。

Name: 路透社
Description: 路透社曾在2014年为Windows 8和8.1推出过一款官方新闻应用，用户可免费从Windows商店下载。这款应用提供来自这家全球顶尖通讯社的专业级新闻内容，涵盖国际、商业、政治、科技、娱乐等多个领域，并包含高质量图片和视频。 应用界面采用Windows 8典型的横向布局，设计清晰简洁，并支持将文章分享到社交网络。其主要局限是初期仅提供美国和英国两个版本，不过存在面向中文用户的“路透掌上通”版本，提供中文财经资讯。应用也支持文章的离线阅读。

Name: ING Bankiren
Description: ING曾在2013年6月为Windows 8和Windows Phone平台推出了一款官方的移动银行应用（Mobiel Bankieren App）。该应用的开发由ING与Capgemini、微软合作完成，采用全新的多平台架构，使其在触屏设备上也能流畅运行。 这款应用具备基础的银行功能，包括查看账户余额、进行转账等。应用采用Windows 8的Modern设计风格，界面简约清爽，并支持“分屏视图”（Snap View）特性，方便用户在多任务时使用。用户可从Windows应用商店免费下载。

Name: 卡拉OK One (Karaoke One)
Description: Karaoke One 是一款由意大利公司 Lisari s.r.l. 开发的免费卡拉OK应用，它曾被描述为第一个“移动人才秀”。它是一款UWP应用，最初在Windows 8和Windows Phone上非常受欢迎，后来也推出了Xbox One版本，让用户可以在客厅里和朋友们一起唱歌。 这款应用的核心是让用户演唱成千上万首带同步歌词的高质量歌曲，可以录制并分享自己的表演视频和音频到社交网络或应用内的社区。它的歌曲目录非常国际化，涵盖从流行、摇滚到嘻哈等各种流派，并每周更新，既有Adele、Ed Sheeran这样的当代热门，也有Queen、Michael Jackson等传奇巨星的经典曲目。 在社区互动方面，用户可以为别人的表演点赞、评论，也可以建立自己的粉丝群，甚至冲击周榜或月榜，成为“本周卡拉OK之王或女王”。应用内的社交反馈功能如“You Rock”反应，进一步增强了互动乐趣。 应用本身免费下载，但其核心商业模式是应用内购买和订阅服务。用户可以通过订阅解锁整个歌曲目录，并可享受无广告和高清体验，且时常有促销折扣。这款应用至今仍在更新，最新版本为2026年2月发布的6.6.11.0。

Id: 战争风暴-神圣家园 (Storm of wars)
Name: 战争风暴-神圣家园 (Storm of wars)
Description: 《Storm of Wars - Sacred Homeland》是由开发商 Ocous 推出的一款免费大型多人在线即时战略游戏（MMORTS）。 平台与系统要求：游戏最初为 Windows 8.1 / Windows Phone 8.1 及以上版本设计，并曾获得过Windows商店独立游戏策略类第一的排名。此外，它也发布了 Android 和 iOS 版本，因此也可通过安卓模拟器在PC上游玩。 核心玩法：游戏融合了王国建设和即时战略玩法，包括城市中的快节奏战斗和世界地图上的史诗级战争。玩家可以选择四大阵营之一，建设城市、召唤英雄，并与其他玩家结成公会，在广阔的全球地图上争霸。

Id: 滚动式老虎机 Rolling Slots (Pro)
Name: 滚动式老虎机 Rolling Slots (Pro)
Description: Slots Pro 是由开发商 Rolling Donut Apps 推出的一款免费老虎机游戏。它针对 Windows 8.1 及以上版本设计，旨在提供拉斯维加斯风格的老虎机娱乐体验。 该游戏提供了三台拥有独特迷你游戏的特色老虎机，并包含了每日奖励、累积大奖以及全球排行榜等玩法。这款游戏和开发商旗下的《Jewel Star》等作品，曾通过视频广告等方式来提升广告收入与用户参与度。

Name: IM+
Description: IM+ for Windows 8 是由 SHAPE GmbH 开发的一款免费即时通讯聚合应用，曾与 Windows 8 系统同步推出，被誉为当时的最佳 IM 软件之一。 它最大的亮点是能在一个界面内集成多达19种不同的聊天服务，包括 Windows Live Messenger、Skype、Facebook、Google Talk、AOL、Yahoo!、ICQ、VKontakte 等。 应用针对触控优化，支持分屏视图、锁屏通知和自定义背景。它提供去广告的 Pro 付费版（$4.99），免费版即可满足多数需求。

Name: 皇家起义2 (Royal Revolt)
Description: 《皇家起义2》（Royal Revolt 2）确实有Windows 8版本，由德国游戏公司 flaregames 开发。该游戏于2014年登陆Windows 8和Windows Phone 8平台，是一款免费下载、含内购的“反塔防”策略游戏，玩家需要建造城堡并攻击其他玩家。 关于这款游戏的Win8版本，有几个关键信息值得留意： 曾是开发商的重要收入来源：在2015年左右，Windows平台（包括Win8和WP8.1）为该游戏贡献了超过三分之一的收入，移动端收入更是实现了翻倍。 系统要求和后续支持：游戏官方支持Windows 8.1及以上系统。不过，Windows 8.1版本的商店支持已经终止，官方已于2023年宣布不再对该版本提供更新，内购功能也会逐步停用，并建议玩家将账号迁移至Windows 10或更高版本。

Name: Foreca天气
Description: Foreca Weather 是 Foreca Ltd. 开发的一款免费天气应用，曾推出过适用于 Windows 8 和 8.1 的版本。 该应用提供全球超过14万个地点的10日天气预报，并包含动态天气地图。它的一大特点是精度较高，Foreca本身也是微软Windows自带天气应用的数据提供商之一。不过，这款应用的旧版本后来出现了无法在Windows 8.1上打开的情况，现在官方更推荐使用其网页版或为Windows 10/11设计的UWP版本。

Name: 脸书 Facebook Touch
Description: Windows 8 曾有官方的 Facebook 应用。它在2013年10月与 Windows 8.1 更新同步上线，当时被看作是填补了平台的一个重要空缺。 这款应用是 Facebook 自己开发的，界面类似 iPad 版的三栏布局，左侧导航、中间是动态消息、右侧是聊天列表。它针对触控优化，并支持 Share Charm 快速分享及 Windows 8.1 的 Snap View 分屏模式。 应用要求系统为 Windows 8.1。免费下载，但需从 Windows 应用商店获取。 好景不长，Facebook 官方在2017年3月宣布停止对 Windows 8/8.1 版本的支持，并于2019年底正式结束了服务。因此，现在已无法在 Windows 8 上正常使用官方 Facebook 应用，只能通过网页浏览器访问。

Name: 红迪 ReddHub Client
Description: ReddHub 是 Windows 8 系统上一款知名的第三方 Reddit 客户端，由开发者 Feras Moussa 打造。它因流畅高效的双栏浏览体验而广受好评，一度被评价为“最美的 Reddit 客户端”。 这款应用充分融入了 Windows 8 的特性，支持将子版块固定到开始屏幕，并深度集成了分享超级按钮。在 Windows 8.1 更新时，开发者也及时跟进，增加了对分屏视图更多尺寸的支持、全新的超大动态磁贴以及应用内网页导航等功能。

Name: Expedia
Description: Expedia 曾在 Windows 8 系统发布初期，推出了一款官方酒店预订应用。该应用于 2012 年 12 月正式上架，是 Expedia 多平台战略的一部分。 这款 Windows 8 应用主要功能集中在酒店搜索与预订，支持用户浏览全球超过 14 万家酒店的实时价格与库存。它采用了简洁的触控界面，可以按价格、评分或星级筛选结果，并提供地图视图、图片和用户评价。应用还提供了一些专属的“移动端特惠折扣”。不过，初期版本并不支持预订机票或租车服务。 该应用目前很可能已停止更新，无法在 Windows 8 上正常使用。通常建议用户通过官网或支持新系统的其他客户端进行预订。

Name: 亚马逊 Kindle
Description: 亚马逊曾为Windows 8推出过官方Kindle应用，但这段历史已成过去。 当时，这款应用充分利用了Windows 8的触控特性，提供了一个完整的阅读环境。你不仅可以阅读电子书，还能直接访问Kindle商店购买新书。它支持Whispersync技术，能在所有设备上同步你的阅读进度、书签和笔记。你还可以把喜欢的书固定在“开始”屏幕，或者利用分屏功能实现多任务操作。 然而，亚马逊在2016年将此应用从商店下架，以专注于维护更传统的“Kindle for PC”软件。因此，对于如今的Windows 8系统用户而言，Kindle应用的历史篇章已经翻过。

Name: 必胜客
Description: 必胜客在2013年正式推出了Windows 8官方应用，由必胜客、Altaine和微软三方合作开发。

Name: 奈飞 Netflix
Description: Netflix 官方在 2012 年 10 月为 Windows 8 推出了专属应用，并于系统发布日同步上架。该应用为免费下载，专为触屏和键鼠操作优化。 这款应用融入了 Windows 8 的 Modern UI 风格，支持侧边栏滑动浏览和 Semantic Zoom 智能缩放，以便概览影片目录。它能调用系统的图形加速能力，提升播放效率并降低能耗。应用还支持分屏快照（Snap View）功能，实现多任务处理。 随着 Windows 8.1 停止支持，目前该旧版应用已无法保证正常使用。现在通常建议通过网页浏览器使用 Netflix，或为 Windows 10/11 系统安装新版应用。在 Windows 8 系统上播放，视频清晰度最高也仅能达到标清（SD）级别。

Name: CNN
Description: CNN 曾在 2013 年初为 Windows 8 推出了官方应用。这款应用在 Windows 8 的 Modern 界面下，提供了一个免费且体验流畅的新闻阅读平台。 应用功能 应用的设计很直观，首页会同时展示重要头条和最新消息，用户也可以按照“科技”、“政治”等不同版块来筛选阅读。右侧的“视频”区域可以观看新闻视频。其iReport功能也很有特色，用户可以借此直接上传自己的文章、照片和视频来分享见闻。 操作与体验 这款应用在交互上很好地融入了 Windows 8 的特色。例如，文章支持通过 Charm 栏分享，主界面右上角也提供了收藏和查看阅读历史的功能。它的动态磁贴会实时刷新，让你在不打开应用的情况下也能看到最新头条。其运行流畅，在设计上也获得了不错的评价。 最终停运 遗憾的是，这个 Windows 8 版本和它的 Windows Phone 版本一样，都已停止支持。官方目前建议用户通过浏览器访问其移动版网站来获取新闻内容。因此，如果想在电脑上看 CNN，现在最稳定可靠的方式就是直接使用网页浏览器了。

Name: 搜狐視頻
Description: 搜狐视频曾在 Windows 8 上线初期推出官方客户端，是首批入驻微软应用商店的视频平台之一。 这款应用完全基于 Win8 Modern 界面开发，采用与系统高度融合的色块布局，主页按新闻、电视剧、电影等七大版块分类展示，焦点图占据主要屏幕区域。播放界面将视频窗口与影片信息同屏呈现，操作直观流畅。 2014年，搜狐视频与微软进一步合作推出新版客户端，取消了片头广告，支持超清、原画画质，并新增剧集订阅提醒和一屏多用等特性。该版本曾在 Windows 应用商店获得较高评价。

Name: 翻转板 (Flipboard)
Description: Flipboard是一款曾在Windows 8.1系统上备受好评的个人杂志阅读应用。它于2013年11月随Windows 8.1更新正式上架，是当时平台上最受期待的重量级应用之一。 该应用充分融入了Windows 8的特性，支持动态磁贴和分屏视图，可以方便地将特定杂志或内容订阅固定到开始屏幕。用户可以连接Twitter、Facebook、Instagram等社交网络，在统一的界面中浏览新闻、文章和好友分享的内容，并创建属于自己的主题杂志。应用针对触控操作进行了专门优化，提供了流畅的翻页和手势交互体验。

Name: Hulu+
Description: Hulu 在 2012 年 10 月 26 日 Windows 8 系统发布时，同步推出了官方的 Hulu Plus 应用。这款应用专为触控操作优化，采用了契合 Windows 8 风格的磁贴式界面设计，支持将喜爱的节目“固定”到开始屏幕实现一键访问。它还充分利用了系统的“分屏视图”（Snap View）功能，允许用户将视频缩小至屏幕一侧观看，同时进行其他操作。订阅费用为每月 7.99 美元。该应用后来也以通用应用（UWP）形式登陆了 Windows 10。

Name: 火媒体 Mediafire for windows 8
Description: MediaFire Desktop for Windows 8 软件概述：MediaFire Desktop 是 MediaFire 官方于 2013 年 11 月推出的桌面同步客户端，提供文件上传、同步和分享功能。 系统兼容：该软件明确支持 Windows 8 系统运行。 免费存储空间：注册免费账户可获得 10GB 初始存储空间，通过推荐等方式最多可扩展至 50GB。 主要功能：支持拖拽上传、屏幕截图与标注、文件链接分享，以及将文件分享到 Facebook、Twitter 等社交平台。 后续支持：MediaFire 桌面同步服务已于 2016 年 7 月 30 日 停止功能，后续如需在电脑上使用，官方建议改用网页版。2016 年 3 月，MediaFire 发布了面向 Windows 10 和 Windows 8.1 的通用应用（UWP）版本，为较新系统提供了替代方案。

Name: Surface
Description: Surface hub for windows 8

Name: Newser
Description: Newser 是一款由 Newser, LLC 推出的免费新闻应用，曾在2013年8月登陆Windows 8应用商店。该应用的核心特色是“阅读更少，知晓更多”：编辑团队从全球新闻中精选最重要、最吸引人的内容，并压缩成精炼的段落呈现给用户。应用界面采用独特的视觉网格布局，可以快速浏览头条新闻。Newser还支持动态磁贴，可在开始屏幕实时显示未读故事数量和最新头条。应用内设有“最新”、“热门”、“头条”、“绝佳发现”、“政治”等分类频道，方便用户筛选阅读。用户可对故事进行投票并选择情绪标签，也可以通过Charm栏将内容分享到社交网络。应用还支持分屏视图（Snap View）与搜索功能。该应用免费下载，安装包仅约1.75 MB，对系统资源占用较小。

Name: 《纽约时报》
Description: 《纽约时报》(The New York Times) 官方曾为 Windows 8 推出过一款专属应用。 该应用于2012年10月26日随 Windows 8 系统同步上线。它针对触控操作进行了专门优化，采用了动态磁贴（可固定版块）、边缘滑动导航和分屏视图等Win8特色功能。订阅用户可以阅读文章、视频、博客等全部内容，非订阅者则只能免费访问“头条新闻”版块。应用也支持离线阅读和云同步。 遗憾的是，该应用已在2016年停止支持。官方当时建议用户通过网页浏览器访问 nytimes.com 获取更完整的阅读体验。

Name: 旅行者 Trip advisor
Description: TripAdvisor 官方曾在 2013 年推出过 Windows 8.1 应用。这款应用针对触控操作优化，可以浏览超过1.25亿条全球旅行者点评，覆盖酒店、餐厅和景点。 深度整合 Bing 搜索 这是它最大的特色之一。应用与 Windows 8.1 的 Bing 智能搜索深度整合，当用户搜索相关旅行内容时，搜索结果可直接显示 TripAdvisor 的酒店价格、评分和点评，点击就能跳转到应用内查看详情，无需再打开浏览器。 实用功能完整 应用集成了酒店价格比对、地图定位、查看“旅行者之选”获奖酒店等功能，也支持登录账户撰写点评和保存地点。

Name: The Weather Channel
Description: The Weather Channel 官方应用曾于2012年底登陆Windows 8。它在2013年3月经历了一次重大改版，全面更新了用户界面，并加入了恶劣天气警报、更多实时天气详情（如湿度、风力）以及Bing地图集成。应用也充分利用了Windows 8特性，支持动态磁贴显示天气信息和锁屏通知。 遗憾的是，随着Windows 8官方支持于2018年1月结束，该应用也在当年7月从商店下架，最终于2020年停止服务。如今已无法在Windows 8系统上正常使用。

Name: VLC 媒体播放器
Description: VLC 官方为 Windows 8 推出过专门的版本。它于 2014年3月上架 Windows 应用商店，是一款针对触屏优化的 Modern 风格应用。 这款应用延续了桌面版跨格式播放的强大能力，支持 MKV、FLAC 等多种主流音视频格式。它还利用了 Windows 8 的动态磁贴和后台播放等特性，并可从外部存储设备读取文件。 不过初版有一些限制：仅支持 x86/x64 架构的 Windows 8 和 8.1，不支持 Windows RT 设备，且早期版本在 Win8.1 上可能不太稳定

《2048 for Windows》是由开发者 oneAssist 于2014年4月22日发布的一款经典数字益智游戏。它的安装包仅约201.57 KB，体积非常小巧。游戏支持4x4至7x7可调棋盘，目标数字最高可设为8192，并包含无尽模式。操作方式灵活，支持键盘、鼠标及触屏滑动。与NuonSoft的《2048 Pro》不同，这款由oneAssist开发的版本是一款Windows 8原生应用，凭借其高度自定义和极简设计，在当时获得了不少用户的喜爱。

Name: ESPN
Description: ESPN 官方曾为 Windows 8 推出过新闻综合应用以及 WatchESPN 直播应用。新闻应用支持实时比分、myESPN 个性化同步和动态磁贴功能，2013 年 7 月曾进行重大更新。WatchESPN 于 2014 年 2 月上架，需有线电视订阅登录后才能解锁直播频道。此外还有 ESPN FC 和 ESPNcricinfo 等专项应用。遗憾的是，这些官方应用早已停止更新和支持，如今在 Windows 设备上只能通过网页浏览器访问 ESPN 官网来获取新闻和直播内容。

Name: 登山赛车
Description: 《Hill Climb Racing》（爬坡赛车）确实有过 Windows 8 版本，由芬兰开发商 Fingersoft 制作。这是一款基于物理引擎的 2D 赛车游戏，玩家需要控制车辆在各种起伏地形中前进，同时保持平衡、避免翻车或耗尽燃油。

Name: 愤怒的小鸟-太空
Description: 《Angry Birds Space》是Rovio官方在2012年10月26日随Windows 8系统同步推出的首批Xbox Live游戏之一。这款游戏让玩家在零重力星球环境下弹射小鸟对抗太空猪，包含超过130个星际关卡和全新的鸟类能力。 Windows 8版本深度整合了Xbox Live功能，支持成就系统和在线排行榜。定价为$4.99美元，同时也提供免费试玩版。该游戏在Windows Store上线后曾进入付费应用前列。 遗憾的是，Rovio已于2025年12月停止了对微软商店版本的支持，如今在Windows设备上已无法通过官方渠道获取和游玩此游戏。

Name: Talking Ben
Description: 《Talking Ben》是由 Outfit7 开发的经典互动宠物类应用。在Windows 8平台上，该作于2015年6月8日作为官方移植版发布。 游戏中，玩家需要先点击报纸引起退休化学教授Ben的注意，随后即可与他对话、挠痒或进行各种有趣的互动。特色玩法包括实验室模式，可混合试管观察化学反应。应用支持录制并分享视频。 遗憾的是，该版本已于2018年底从商店下架，如今在Windows设备上已无法通过官方渠道获取。

Name: Disney 天天过马路
Description: 《Disney Crossy Road》是一款由 Hipster Whale 开发、迪士尼发行的8-bit风格无尽跑酷游戏，于2016年4月发布，并正式登陆过 Windows 8 平台。 游戏延续了《天天过马路》的经典玩法，玩家需操控角色不断穿越马路、铁路和河流，躲避车辆和火车等障碍。最大特色是收录了超过100个迪士尼与皮克斯角色，并呈现《玩具总动员》、《狮子王》等主题的像素世界。该游戏如今已在iOS、Android等主流平台正式停运，不再推出更新。

Name: 同花顺炒股
Description: 同花顺炒股（300033），专为windows8用户设计的炒股软件。 同花顺炒股软件是目前国内用户使用量最高、性能最稳定的、支持券商最多并支持在线交易的免费炒股（财经）软件。同花顺炒股让您随时随地掌握市场热点，轻松炒股决策，投资下单先人一步!
Developer: 浙江核新同花顺网络信息股份有限公司

Name: 天涯社区
Description: 天涯社区Windows 8.1 Metro版本客户端融合天涯社区的重要特色，为广大华人用户提供全方位的服务，网友可以快捷关注时下网络热点聚焦，随时获知关注楼主动态，好文绝帖重磅围观，随手抢沙发敲板砖，同时更方便地查阅自己发表和回复的论坛帖子，跟踪精彩动态。
Developer: 海南天涯社区网络科技股份有限公司

Description: 腾讯平板管家(For Windows 8)是专为Windows 8用户打造的完全免费的安全与管理软件，我们秉承“安自心，简随行”的理念，提供在Windows 8上的系统清理、文件加密、系统信息查看等功能，是您贴心的Windows 8设备管家。
Developer: 深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司

Name: 迅雷看看播放器
Description: 迅雷看看播放器支持RM、RMVB、XV、MKV、FLV等众多主流的视频格式。 作为专门为Windows应用商店重新设计开发的一款新产品，它沿袭了原播放器桌面版本的格式支持全、播放画质好、播放流畅、耗用资源少等众多特点。 完美的格式支持，精致的产品设计，迅雷看看播放器致力于给您完美的观影体验。
Developer: 深圳市迅雷网络技术有限公司

Name: 招商银行
Description: 招商银行全新推出Win8平板银行，完美支持Windows 8.0及8.1，带给您全新的操作体验。 为您量身打造招商银行Win8平板银行，为您提供以下特色服务： ★转账汇款0费用：即日起至2015年底，享受每日高达20万元的转账汇款额度(不含协议账户转账)，费用全免！ ★专属高收益理财产品，专享尊贵礼遇！ ★完美支持Windows 8.0及8.1，大屏使用更加清晰流畅 ★四大频道设计，简洁易用，全面覆盖您的金融生活 ★多重机制保安全，Win8平板银行更安心

Name: 携程旅游
Description: 更优惠的价格：不收取任何形式的隐性服务费用， 确保为您提供最优惠的房价。 更多酒店： 覆盖全国3000多个大中型城市。 真实住客点评：200万真实入住客人的体验点评， 5000万忠诚会员沉淀的用户信赖。 精益服务保障： 8000名预订专家随时为您待命， 7x24小时全天候的无间断服务。 到店有房保证： 到店无房赔付首晚房费的保障承诺 。 优势机票预定：每天100万张低价机票供您选择，100%出票 安全可靠 。 无论在旅途中，还是在办公桌前。无论是使用平板，还是PC，携程旅行应用都是您随身的“旅行助手”!
Developer: 携程计算机技术（上海）有限公司

Name: 优酷HD
Description: 优酷网专为Windows 8.1订制的视频娱乐客户端产品。 操作简易，符合用户使用习惯。优酷客户端具有视频在线播放，快捷搜索，全屏播放，记录播放历史等功能，为用户提供能了更便捷的客户端视频播放体验。
Developer: 合一信息技术北京有限公司

Name: 中国国家地理
Description: 本客户端应用为中国国家地理官方客户端，汇聚《中国国家地理》、《博物》、《中华遗产》、《行天下》四刊精华内容及中国国家地理出版的系列图书，我们秉承中国国家地理“推开自然之门，昭示人文精华”的办刊理念，基于LBS位置定位功能提供全方位随行读随心读服务，使未及之地不再陌生，让您足不出户也可饱览天下美景。我们将致力于打造最权威、最实用、最具深度的高端媒体应用。
Developer: 北京全景国家地理新媒体科技有限公司

Name: Cut the Rope
Description: Cut the Rope 是一款由 ZeptoLab 官方推出的物理解谜游戏，于 2012 年 11 月登陆 Windows 8 应用商店。该应用采用全新的 Windows UI 设计，拥有生动可爱的卡通动画，能直观展示趣味闯关画面。应用支持海量关卡游玩，提供多样机关道具，其核心功能包括切割绳索、收集星星，引导糖果送达小怪兽奥姆口中。可体验真实物理碰撞效果，解锁全新主题关卡，应用支持触控操作，部分关卡免费下载，适配 Windows8 触控设备，带来轻松有趣的解谜游戏体验。

Name: Where's My Water?
Description: Where's My Water 是一款由 Disney 官方推出的物理解谜游戏，于 2012 年 12 月登陆 Windows 8 应用商店。该应用采用全新的 Windows UI 设计，拥有生动流畅的水流动画，能直观展示地下管道闯关场景。应用支持数百个趣味关卡，提供泥浆、毒水、蒸汽等多样元素，其核心功能包括挖开土层引导水流，避开各类危险物质，将清水送到小鳄鱼洗澡的浴缸。可解锁隐藏关卡与额外剧情，应用完美适配触控操作，支持 Windows8 触控设备，带来烧脑又充满乐趣的解谜游戏体验。

Name: Adobe Photoshop Express
Description: Adobe Photoshop Express 是由 Adobe 官方推出的简易修图应用，2013 年 5 月登陆 Windows 8 应用商店。采用 Windows UI 界面，适配鼠标与触屏操作。支持图片裁剪、摆正旋转，自带一键自动优化，可以手动调节曝光、对比度、色温饱和度，能够去除照片红眼瑕疵。内置多款免费滤镜与边框，编辑操作支持撤销，保存图片不会直接覆盖原图，编辑完成后可以直接保存导出，用来完成日常简单的相片调整处理。

Name: Flow Free: Bridges
Description:
From the makers of the #1 hit app Flow Free®, comes a fun and challenging new twist: Bridges!
If you like Flow Free, you'll love Flow Free: Bridges®!
Connect matching colors with pipe to create a Flow®. Pair all colors and cover the entire board. Use the new Bridges to cross two pipes and solve each puzzle!

Free play through hundreds of levels, or race against the clock in Time Trial mode. Gameplay ranges from simple and relaxed, to challenging and 
frenetic, and everywhere in between. How you play is up to you. So, give Flow Free: Bridges a try, and experience "mind like water"!

*** Flow Free: Bridges features ***

* Content
- Over 1,500 levels available in Free Play mode
- 10 different board sizes
- Starter, Challenge, Bonus, Classic, Mania, and Jumbo level packs
- Bridges!

* Challenge
- Track your completion of each level in Free Play mode
- Strive for accuracy in Free Play using the fewest, most efficient moves
- Strive for speed in Time Trial for the most and fastest solves
- 20 scored Time Trial variants to choose from by board size and duration

* Look & Feel
- Smooth, polished touch interaction
- Colorful UI
- Fun sound effects
- Clean vector graphics and animations
- Labels available for color impaired players

Enjoy.

Name: Rayman Fiesta Run
Description:
***Pocket Gamer - 9/10 - “A spunky, joyous, addictive gem [...] Another giddy and breathless mix of memory and reflexes” 

Join legendary platforming hero Rayman for a new adventure on your favorite mobile device! 

If you enjoyed Rayman Jungle Run, winner of the App Store’s BEST of 2012, you will love Rayman Fiesta Run and its new wacky Fiesta world! Lunge for cocktail umbrellas, leap on limes and punch those piñatas…the sky’s the limit! 

PARTY ALL NIGHT LONG 
* More than 75 levels welcome you for the Fiesta!
* Bounce on sausages and make your way through 4 new festive worlds 
* Beat all 3 new epic bosses to reach the dreaded Land of the Livid Dead Island! 
* Collect Lums to get awesome rewards and power-ups

DISCOVER RAYMAN'S AMAZING NEW POWERS 
* Rayman could jump, fly, punch and run up the walls… 
* …he can now slide, swim or shrink on the fly into a tiny hero 
* Unleash the power of the Super Punch! 

BEWARE OF THE INVASION! 
* Play all the levels you thought you knew in a totally different way 
* Avoid new traps and defeat even fiercer enemies 
* Get ready for more great challenges! 


ENJOY GORGEOUS GRAPHICS 
* Rayman Jungle Run was pretty… Rayman Fiesta Run looks absolutely delicious! 
* Immerse yourself into the Fiesta thanks to the increased depth of field 
* And if you like great lightings, Rayman has put a brand new disco ball up for you! 

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS 
Share your activities, post your achievements on Facebook, and follow your friends on the world map. 

This game can be downloaded over the air, no Wi-Fi needed to play! 

Game available in: English, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian.

Name: Adera
Description:
Adera is the best story-driven adventure game you've ever played!
#2 Top Free Game on Windows!
Jane Sinclaire has been on many dangerous adventures, but she’s never experienced anything like the mysterious city of Adera. Throughout her expedition, she’ll have to solve puzzles, collect artifacts, and explore the environments to reveal the mysteries of this new-found civilization.

This episodic story begins when Jane receives a desperate message from her long-missing grandfather. Using nothing but her wits and a strange stone orb to guide her, Jane sets out to find her grandfather before it’s too late.

Name: Reckless Racing Ultimate
Description:
The ultimate edition of the acclaimed Reckless Racing top-down racer series is here and exclusive to Windows 8. Now bigger and dirtier than ever! Download the free trial today! 
Race on a huge selection of road and dirt tracks, single and multi-player events, modded cars and trucks, and challenging game modes. Whether it's a muscle car in the dirt, a monster truck in gravel, or a dune buggy in the snow, if you can build it - you can race it. Tweak, upgrade and customize your car collection as you level up in your racing career. 

Earn your place on the Xbox Leaderboards in both Career and Arcade modes. Challenge your friends in a variety of multiplayer modes including 1 on 1 rally racing and fastest lap. Track your multi-player invites, and results on the go right on your Live Tile. 

Buckle your seatbelts and prepare to get Reckless!

Earn Xbox achievements and challenge your Xbox friends to races, battle arenas, and more with the newest addition to the TY universe.

Name: El Chavo Juego
Description:
UNA FERIA EN LA VECINDAD

Diviértete y juega en la vecindad más divertida del mundo. Hay una feria en la vecindad y tú podrás acompañar al Chavo y sus amigos a jugar espectaculares mini juegos.

Camina por la vecindad, enséñale a Don Ramón tú buen tino, juega al tiro al blanco con el Señor Barriga, sube al ring y derrota al Furioso Desesperado y descubre qué sorpresa te tiene cada habitante de la vecindad.

Participa y gana la mayor cantidad de tickets en los diferentes mini juegos para poder comprar artículos que te harán mejorar e incrementar puntos en los diferentes mini juegos.

La feria en la Vecindad es una aplicación basada en la exitosa serie animada el Chavo, con gráficos innovadores y coloridos que te harán disfrutar de la vecindad más famosa del mundo donde podrás conocer a sus habitantes y cada uno de sus rincones.

Watch out - if your head touches another snake, you will explode and then it's game over. But if you get other snakes to run into YOU, then THEY will explode and you can eat their remains!

Unlike other games, you have a fighting chance even if you're tiny! If you're a nimble navigator, you can swerve in front of a much larger snake to defeat them - no matter what size you are!

Touch input is not supported yet! Game need mouse and keyboard to play!

Name: Minecraft for Windows
Description:
Minecraft for Windows 
Explore randomly generated worlds and build amazing things from the simplest of homes to the grandest of castles. Play in creative mode with unlimited resources or mine deep into the world in survival mode, crafting weapons and armor to fend off the dangerous mobs. Scale craggy mountains, unearth elaborate caves, and mine large ore veins. Discover lush cave and dripstone cave biomes. Light up your world with candles to show what a savvy spelunker and master mountaineer you are!

FEATURES: 
-	If you can dream it, you can build it. Put your imagination and limitless resources to work with Creative Mode.
-	Battle mobs, construct shelter, and explore the landscape—it’s all in a day’s work when you try to survive and thrive in Survival Mode.
-	New tools, locations, and spaces are yours to explore, thanks to our regular updates. 
-	Cross-platform play for up to eight players across Windows, PlayStation, Nintendo, Xbox, and mobile devices. Minecraft for Windows also runs on Windows Mixed Reality and Oculus Rift devices and supports all features.
-	Slash commands: Tweak how the game plays- you can give items away, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more.
-	Discover skin, texture, and mash-up packs from the community! Find out more at minecraft.net/marketplace. 
-	Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of others! Discover gigantic community-run worlds, compete in unique mini-games and socialize in lobbies full of new friends.
-	Ray tracing for Windows brings a different graphics experience to Minecraft! Experience creator-built worlds with realistic lighting, vibrant colors, naturally reflective water and emissive textures that light up. 

REALMS PLUS:
Play with up to 10 friends cross-platform in worlds that exist anytime, anywhere- and get access to over 150 pieces of Marketplace content. Try a free 30-day trial in-app and learn more at minecraft.net/realms/bedrock. 

Also, you can also play Minecraft Bedrock Edition and Minecraft Java Edition with Xbox Game Pass- check it out at xbox.com/xbox-game-pass/pc-games. 
To buy Minecraft Java Edition to own, visit Minecraft.net/get-minecraft.

NOTE: 
Worlds/saves from the Java Edition of Minecraft are not compatible Minecraft for Windows. 

SUPPORT: https:///www.minecraft.net/help
LEARN MORE: https:///www.minecraft.net/

Name: Old Windows Versions
Description: This app is intended as a joke. Are your friends still not used to Windows 8? Tell them that's no problem: you can use any Windows version you want on your device. Amaze your colleagues when you tell them you can use Windows 3.11 on your tablet or let Windows Millennium show a blue screen to have a good laugh. Or maybe you are just a little nostalgic like me and you like to see how it was back in the day. Just to be clear: This app doesn't have any real Windows functionality!

Name: Music Maker Jam
Description:
With the new free music app MUSIC MAKER JAM for Windows you can make your own amazing tracks - it's fun and fast! Simply start the app, choose three free music styles and start combining sounds to make your own songs.
Choose from a wide range of professionally produced loops and arrange them any way you want on up to eight tracks. Change the tempo, adjust the pitch and mix your songs using cool realtime effects. Ready for a remix? Just shake your tablet to reorder the tracks and create a unique version of your song. It's a great way to find some inspiration for your next jam session!

MUSIC MAKER JAM offers intuitive control making music production even more fun and easy than you ever imagined. All of the sounds are perfectly synchronized to keep you on the beat every step of the way.
The app comes with four free styles. One of those is Dubstep, the other three are your choice and can be changed every month. This means that you have new loops on a monthly basis to keep your jams fresh and give you absolute freedom to experiment with your sound. And if that's not enough, you can also expand your studio with new premium styles like Hip Hop, Drum&Bass, Techno, Movie Score, House, Metal and many more. In fact, there's so much to mix and match you can take things to the next level and create your own new music genre!
Whether a quiet instrumental, a guitar-driven rocker for the radio or a pulsating dance track for the club, this app makes it all possible. Simply jam it out until you get the perfect sound or save your jams as projects so you can open them later for more editing. Record as many tracks as you want, share them as audio files and keep your listeners coming back from more! Music Maker Jam is available for free in the Windows App Store for all tablets.

Name: Eko-mapa pre Win 8
Description:
Eko-Mapa je interaktívny, vizuálny a komplexný mapový navigátor, slúžiaci ako praktický pomocník, ktorý pomáha identifikovať „eko-body“. Napríklad zberne obnoseného šatstva, miesta kde zaniesť staré batérie, alebo stavebný odpad, kde je najbližšie chránené miesto v prírode a mnoho iných. 
To znamená miesta a služby, ktoré pomáhajú žiť zdravšie a s ohľadom na životné prostredie a možnosť zistenia trasy, ako sa k nim dostať.

Name: Remote Desktop
Description: With the Remote Desktop app, you can connect to a remote PC and your work resources from almost anywhere. Experience rich interactivity with RemoteFX in a Remote Desktop client designed to help you get your work done wherever you are.

Name: Video Training for Windows ® 8
Description:
If you were a Windows 7, Vista or XP user, this app will show you everything you need to know in order to use Windows 8 efficiently.
Discover Modern UI, the new Windows 8 interface, talismans, touch gestures and keyboard shortcuts you need to know.
Learn to juggle effectively between Modern UI and the desktop, to reorganize the Start Screen, to install new apps, to synchronize your data via SkyDrive and many other things.
Two versions of Internet Explorer are included in Windows 8. Discover and learn their characteristics in order to get the maximum use from both of them.
Learn to use Photo Gallery, Movie Maker and VLC to effectively assist Windows when dealing with multimedia.
Finally, learn Windows 8 advanced features: history files, libraries, updating and resetting a computer, etc.

Name: Spy Pigeon - Secret Mission
Description:
In “Spy Pigeon – Secret Mission” your territorial borders are under threat by enemy armed forces which are deployed in border area of your country and they might attack your country anytime. You are unable to collect the deployment detail of enemy forces even with your aero planes and drones in order to plan combat strategy as they could be knocked down by enemy troops by shooting or hunting them down. Therefore, as you are part of intelligence agency of your country you have especially trained few SPY PIGEONS to perform the duties of undercover agent. Main role of this corpse is to spy & collect intelligence around the enemy lines across the border to conduct a highly sensitive secret spy mission in enemy territory. Your spy pigeon has to go through several deadly obstacles as he takes the high risk of flying in to the border area and dare to step in to dangerous zone where it has to collect highly sensitive information and report back to Alpha Base where it has started the mission for successful completion of the same. 
Your spy Pigeon is like a one man commando and its mission is to fly over multiple areas where your enemies Army Units are staying and those building / posts are marked with RED arrow sign. Your spy pigeon has to fly over all of those RED marked areas and then it has to return back to its base, for a mission to be successful. 
Among many other missions, one mission of your Spy Pigeon is to rescue its fellow pigeons which has been caught by enemy, your spy pigeon has to escape from the shooting or getting being hunt by enemy troops which are equipped with rifles and snipers.

Name: City Car Racing Rivals
Description:
City car racing rivals is one of the fastest cars racing game in car simulator 2015 new rock star game that you can play at this moment. In 3D models the best of cars 2015 classic cars type, City car racing is a free blast & thunder game on Windows games having different types of environment with beautiful HD Graphics and levels in all car simulator 2015 rock star games with beautiful models of popular fast racing cars.
Anyone who loves thunder racing games or super-fast racing cars then you are going to love playing: good luck Charlie “City Car Racing Rivals”. The most realistic environment, driving game physics that you can find in a thunder Racing Game in car racing games 3D the best of cars 2015. If you like Moto Racing, truck racing, Heavy Bike racing than you will surely love City car racing rivals but you have to be a good racing driver having fast racing experience and surely with full of passion & thrill to be at top winner in this fast and furious car racing game. Get your high performance vehicles and thunder speed up the breath taking speed of the track, you are going to compete against, car racing games, racing cars off the grid and win to top of the rank and unlock the next challenging level of this racing game better than police chase games, police sniper, military, motorcycle games and hummer race games. You could be one of the greatest racing champions in car racing game.

How to Play:- 
For Window PC:
Use Arrow Keys To Control Car.
Use Space Key To Apply Brake.
Use Key” To Reset.

Name: PK Cargo Transport
Description:
Boys & girls who love to drive the artistically designed trucks for Cargo transport gets ready to play PK Cargo Transport. In this game you try & prove your driving simulation skills by moving various kind of Cargo from one place to another successfully. While playing role of cargo truck driver you will also enjoy excellent background music i.e. The rubab which is known as "the lion of instruments" and is one of the two major music instruments being used in classical music in some parts of Asia. Cargo Truck used in the game displays the beautiful culture of Truck painting that is a popular form of indigenous art and featuring floral patterns and poetic calligraphy and we are sure that you will love to drive such decorative trucks and would accept the challenge.

How to play:
1.	Accelerator button is on the right bottom side of the screen.
2.	Gear is for forward and reverse. 
3.	Brake button is on the left side of the accelerator.
4.	Steering is on the left bottom side of the screen.

We are thankful to Phool Patti Pakistan's truck artwork team for their support.

Name: Real Ambulance Simulator
Description:
Real Ambulance Simulator game is an exciting game where you can drive ambulance in real environment to help needy humankind. In this game you are not playing a car racing or truck parking game but instead you trying to be savior by driving the ambulance to the patients who are in dire need of help. Do your job perfectly and rush to the patients on time to save them.You’re the on-duty ambulance driver and you’re reported about the accident. You need to get in your ambulance and drive to the injured ones as fast as you can, pick them up and rush them to the nearest hospital. Lives are at stake so drive with a purpose as you are on a rescue mission. Rush your ambulance around the city to get to the scene of accident in time or you’ll fail to save someone’s life. Reach to the patients on time pick them in ambulance and rush to hospital as it’s the best thing you can do to save them in this state of emergency. Turn on the sirens and push the throttle! Remember your duty comes first!

Are you able to afford stress & drive speedy through the city streets to rescue people and drive back to the hospital? Prove yourself worthy in this Real Ambulance Simulator. Real Ambulance Simulator is a realistic simulator. 18 Different levels in which you have to get to patient from town and take him to the hospital in required time as soon as possible. There is an arrow on above the ambulance which will guide you the position of patient and hospital.

How to Play:
- Multiple controls for ambulance movement
- Get the patient and go to hospital in required time
- Realistic Tilt and Steering Controls
-Use “Arrow Keys” to Control the Ambulance. 
- Follow the arrow to get patient to hospital

Name: Off Road Luxury Car
Description:

Une suggestion, une remarque, un problème…n’hésitez pas à nous contacter par mail :
applis@nrj.com ou en cliquant sur le lien « Support NRJ Music Awards » se trouvant dans le Windows Store.

Restrictions to all Windows 8 applications that affect My Explorer:
- The following folders are not accessible to any Windows 8 application: System folders (i.e. program files); hidden and protected folders and files; executable files (i.e. exe, js)
- It is not possible to launch files that depend on other files (i.e. complete webpages, the ones that save an html file and a folder with its images)

REINFORCE YOUR FRIENDS
Connect with Facebook friends, then help each other win and expand. Send Supply Crates back and forth for bonus starting cash. Visit friends' cities to check out their strategies and their city design skills, and while you're there root out any bloon spies to win a reward for both you and your friend.

SHOW OFF YOUR SKILLS
Build up the strongest lineup of monkey towers possible and compete with other players for the best score in weekly Contested Territory events. Use the latest in monkey science to send player vs. player bloon attacks, then see whose defenses are the strongest and earn extra rewards for victory.

Download for free and play Bloons Monkey City now!

Please Note:
Bloons Monkey City is free to download and play (aside from internet, carrier, data, device, and other services for which the player is financially responsible), but some in-game items can be purchased with real money. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device's settings, or reach us at support@ninjakiwi.com for help. City data is organized individually, so if you share multiple cities on one device through multiple accounts, do note that your IAP will only apply to the city active during purchase.

Name: Galaxy Bowling
Description:
Galaxy Bowl is a 3D bowling game with 11 modes, realistic physics, 4 player local multiplayer, dozens of balls, online leaderboards, and planet-loads of fun!

★ Fun pick up and play gameplay. Touch to position the ball, and then swipe your finger to roll it. Tilt or swipe your finger to add spin.
★ 100 pin challenge, iron pin, and spares mode!
★ Candlepin, Duckpin, Five Pin, Skittles, and Nine Pin bowling variations! These have new pin types, balls, rules, and challenges.
★ Beautiful 3D graphics. Reflective lanes and shiny bowling balls look great on any device.
★ Online leaderboards.

Unlock new planet-themed balls, conquer challenging achievements, and complete your voyage of the solar system.

Can you reach Pluto?

Galaxy Bowl includes:

TEN PIN BOWLING

One of the most popular bowling games in the world today. Score strikes, spares, and turkeys.

PICK UP SPARES

Practice challenging spares. Clear stages to unlock new balls.

ONE HUNDRED PINS

Knock down as many pins as you can in 5 throws at a rack of 100 pins!

CANDLEPIN BOWLING

Invented in 1880. Candlepin bowling offers a great challenge. Candlepins are thin skittles that bounce and spin unpredictably when struck. Pins aren't cleared between rounds allowing you to knock them into still upright pins.

FIVE PIN BOWLING

 Invented in 1904 in Canada. In 5 pin, each pin is worth different point values. Spares are strategic attempts to hit the most valuable pins. A perfect game is 450 points!

NINE PIN (GERMAN BOWLING)

Invented in medieval Germany, 9 pin is what most later bowling games are based on. Nine pins are arranged in a diamond shape with a "kingpin" in the middle. Knocking all the pins over earns 9 points. Knocking all the pins over but the kingpin earns 12!

LONG ALLEY SKITTLES

Knock over pins by throwing a barrel-shaped 'cheese'! To score points, you first have to knock over the kingpin. It's tricky to master when the ball bounces unpredictably!

DUCK PIN

Invented in 1904 in New England. Duck pin uses the nearly the same rules as 10 pin, but allows 3 rounds to knock over all the pins. The ball and pins are smaller making precision very important to score well!

IRON PIN

Iron pin is the same as normal bowling but one random pin is much heavier than the others. Careful consideration has to be made on how to knock over the heavy pin while also clearing the normal ones.

SHUFFLE BOWLING

Bowling on a shuffleboard table! Knock over the pins with a weighted puck.

WEST COUNTY SKITTLES

Traditional skittles game that has been played in British pubs for centuries.

Galaxy Bowling has an option to purchase Candlepin, Duck Pin, Five Pin, Nine Pin, 100 pin, and Iron Pin variants. Ten pin, and spares mode are included free.

Use your limited ammo wisely and kill the insane enemies at a distance before they get a chance to aim at you. Aim for head-shot to preserve your ammo. The enemy isn't aware of your presence so take your first shot carefully, to begin the onslaught, because the moment you fire, your gunshot will be heard and the enemy will be upon you before you know it. There’s no turning back, so let the onslaught begin. Make sure you keep yourself well focused and determined before firing your first shot.

Wish you all the good luck that you would surely need.

1. Touch and move the screen to aim the enemy.
2. The enemy will not attack with their Ak-47, until you fire your first shot.
3. Use your Sniper scope to aim at enemies from a distance.
4. Use fire button to shoot.
5. Aim for the head; shoot once and accurately, to stay away from their onslaught.
6. The gun reloads automatically.
7. Zoom in to kill the enemy and then zoom out if required.
