Name: Test 20 Zhuyin (Chinese Ruby)
Description: Zhuyin fuhao is a phonetic system for transcribing Chinese, especially Mandarin. It was introduced in the 1910s. Consisting of 37 characters and four tone marks, it transcribes all possible sounds in Mandarin. Although phased out in People's Republic of China in the 1950s, this system is still the most widely used educational tool and Chinese computer input method in Taiwan. Test your knowledge in this amazing chinese ruby quiz!

Name: Test 20 Hangul
Description: The Korean alphabet, also known as Hangul,  is the native alphabet of the Korean language. It was created during the Joseon Dynasty in 1443, and is now the official script of both North Korea and South Korea, and co-official in the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture of China's Jilin Province. This quiz will help you learning this Korean alphabet.

Name: Test 20 Hebrew
Description: The Hebrew alphabet used in the writing of the Hebrew language, as well as other Jewish languages, most notably Yiddish, Ladino, and Judeo-Arabic. The Hebrew alphabet has 22 letters, of which five have different forms when used at the end of a word. Hebrew is written from right to left. Originally, the alphabet was an abjad consisting only of consonants. Like other abjads, such as the Arabic alphabet, means were later devised to indicate vowels by separate vowel points, known in Hebrew as niqqud. This quiz will help you learning the Hebrew alphabet.

Name: Arranger - The beach
Description:
What's more relaxing than a warm spring day at the beach!

Arranger - the beach is a free, jigsaw style, picture puzzle game where you get to follow Patrica, a young beautiful women on a sunny day at the beach.

As this girl takes on different roles of events you will journey through a wonderful series of pictures,  delicately created to mediate joy and harmony. In combination with the empathetic background music you'll soon let your thoughts wander, wishing you were there to join her. 

Additional info:
This puzzle game belongs to the jigsaw genre and is best described as jigsaw puzzle with square shaped puzzle pieces. The shape of the pieces makes it very easy to overview and simple to play. The game consists of several puzzles, each with its own unique image.

As you progress, the puzzles will increase in difficulty, having more pieces to put together. To make it easier to overview you can simply pinch to zoom in/out and adjust the size of the piece holder to your liking. This game works great in both portrait and landscape view.
 
Don' think twice about it. You'll be surprised what a nice little puzzle game this is. :)

Name: T-Kara Puzzles
Description:
T-Kara Puzzles is a unique match-4 puzzle game, filled with fun variations and exciting challenges.

T-Kara Puzzles has three different main categories.
 
CAMPAIGN:  
Based on several intriguing goals, with solvable puzzles and increasing difficulty.  
 
SCORE MODE: 
Comes in three varieties where survival is in the essence. Choose between "Direct hit", "Limited Moves" and "Time Attack". Survive as long as possible and gather scores by beating challenging obstacles. 
 
PICTURE PUZZLE: 
Relax and try to create a specific image by getting the blocks in the right place. The game has several picture puzzles with increasing difficulty. This game mode is quite a challenge and takes some technique. Depending on personality, you will most likely either hate or love it! 
 
T-Kara Puzzles is the perfect game whenever you want to clear your mind or just pass some time. When leaving a game mode, your progress will be saved and you can easily resume wherever you left.

DLC:
The Free edition of T-Kara Puzzles has a lot of content, but for those wanting even more, there's a in-app store page. On the in-app store page you will find purchasable content, such as new planets (game modes) or more picture puzzles. When buying more content, the ads within the game will be removed at the same time.

Name: New Years Countdown
Description:
New year's countdown is a simple and elegant app with only one purpose, showing the time left to new year. Supports both Gregorian and Chinese new year.

As the countdown reaches 0, sparkling fireworks with empathetic sound effects fills up the screen. Once the firework has passed, the countdown will reset and keep counting down till next year. 

Live tiles makes it easy to keep track of the time outside the app, by updating every minute. New year's countdown supports Live tiles in three sizes with different appearance.

New year's countdown also has a "simulate new year" button so that you know what to expect when the time comes.

Name: Animated Puzzles
Description:
Jigsaw style puzzle game with a new and challenging twist! 

Animated Puzzles is a Jigsaw-style picture puzzle game with a challenging twist; animated puzzles! Try to get the right pieces into place while parts of the image is in motion. Different and extremely enjoyable! 
 
The soft animated motions combined with the beautiful photos and harmonic tunes makes it perfect for whenever you want to escape reality for a while.
 
It's relaxing, easy to play and yet challenging at the same time. 
Go ahead and try for yourself! It's free!

Additional info:
This puzzle game belongs to the jigsaw genre and is best described as a jigsaw puzzle with square shaped puzzle pieces. The shape of the pieces makes it very easy to overview and simple to play. The game consists of several puzzles, each with its own unique image.

As you progress, the puzzles will increase in difficulty by having more pieces. For easier overview, simply pinch to zoom in/out or you can adjust the size of the piece holder. The game works great in both portrait and landscape view.

Enjoy!

Description:
Add some light to your life by letting your phone generate beautiful light ambience.

This special multifunctional light application has a variety of modes suitable for different occasions. 

For Example:

- Turn up the brightness and project the beautiful colors on your wall/roof.



- Set the built in shutdown timer and use it as a relaxing nightlight.



- Put the device on the table during a romantic dinner and select an appropriate mode.



- Stroboscope for parties, choose speed and color.



- Select the clock mode and use it as an atmospheric glowing digital/analog clock.



- Use it as a selective colored pocket light by setting the basic RGB mode to glow in a constant color of your choice. 

Customize the selected mode easily by swiping your finger across the screen horizontally or vertically. Add Some Light will remember the most recent settings for each mode and which mode that was last used. That way you can easily prepare for upcoming events.

Name: Hungry Monsters Saga
Description:
Hungry Monsters Saga is a new addictive and mind-blowing puzzle game that combines color matching games, some sort of a tower defense and reaction games. Here you’ll have to reveal all your attention and concentration abilities, for it’s not another brain teaser. We bet you’ve got used to tile matching, brain twisters are kids’ riddles for you and getting concentrated and winning another level of a highly tense attention game is no problem for you.

It’s time to take it to the limit. Are you capable of solving a color matching puzzle in a form of a tower with monsters try to intervene, with parts of the puzzle exploding and destroying itself from within? Chasing the highest score and a new record with strict time limitation and ultimately concentrated mind is something hardly anybody is able to do. It’s time for you to test your skills. Prepare spare brains!

HOW TO PLAY
You’ll see a tower that consists of blocks of four different colors: pink, yellow, green and blue, and monsters of the same colors next to it. You should put together three blocks of the same color. To do so you may throw some blocks out of the tower. As you do it, they get united into one bronze bar. Three bronze bars make one silver bar, three silver bars – one gold bar, and three gold bars form a diamond one. You goal is to score as much as you can. You get coins for each bar you make.

You time is limited to 3 minutes. But this is not the only problem.

The monsters next to the tower get angry and will try to swing it. If they succeed and the tower falls down, you lose. To calm them down you have to feed them with bars made of blocks of the same colors as the monsters are. As a monster gets its bar, it releases its power.

- the pink flamingo should be fed with bars of pink blocks and falls asleep as it gets one. The time flows slower while it’s sleeping.
- the huge yellow chicken is fed with bars of yellow blocks and multiplies the player’s score by five.
- the green chameleon should get bars of green blocks only and doubles combos the player makes.
- the blue elephant that prefers bars of blue blocks makes the tower stable.

They may help you to win. Or they bring you down.

It depends on the bar, how long the monster’s power is active:
- with a bronze bar – for 4 seconds;
- with a silver bar – for 6 seconds;
- with a gold bar – for 8 seconds;
- with a diamond bar – for 10 seconds.

There are also bonus blocks with their effects:
- a clock block adds you 15 seconds;
- a safe block gives you additional coins.
To use them you have to get them into a row of blocks of the same color that turns into a bar (for example, you have a green block, then a bonus block, and two green blocks again. You’ll get a “green” bronze bar and a bonus effect).

And obstacle blocks:
- a concrete block may not be thrown out of the tower;
- a dynamite block has a timer, so that you know when it explodes. It rocks the tower and makes it more possible that it falls down.

To get rid of them you have to get them into a row of blocks of the same colors just like with bonus blocks.

Try this marvelous puzzle game and reaction test and show everybody what you’re up to! Hungry Monsters Saga will let you train your agility and concentration and have a lot of fun with its captivating gameplay and cute cheerful graphics.

Name: 你不知道的茶

Name: LIKE THAT by Ariane Dewey

My friends and family congratulated me on my marriage, expressing their overwhelming admiration for my selflessness… but behind my back they tapped their forefingers against their temples.

She didn’t understand what he was driving at, and he repeated the question, explaining very explicitly, “How much are you asking for convincing Miriam to leave the boys in my custody and how much will she settle for in order to leave the country?”

“Not everything can be bought or negotiated through money,” Gitty remarked, trying to stare him straight in the eyes. Bingo! He was the first to lower his gaze. It had been a gamble, she knew, a dangerous one.

“I don’t generally do business with women, but you can stay.” Was this a compliment

Name: Grief Sucks by Partilla
Description: A powerful guide for anyone who is battling grief! Forty seven years ago, a seventeen year old U.S.Marine, who volunteerd for Vietnam, was taught how to survive if he or his comrades were wounded in battle. He must remember (3) life saving steps and administer them immediately if they are to survive. Several years later, this father and marine has to fight a never ending war with grief! "Grief Sucks" is a survivor´s guide for every backpack,purse,briefcase,ipad or iphone. Throughout this book with the aid of John´s inspirational photographs, readers will follow him as he relates to friends,family,readings,memories,tears, music and faith. Written with sincerity,frankness and suffused with emotion, "Grief Sucks" will aid everyone to prepare for grief,deal with it and eventually triumph over it without leaving behind any beautiful memories.

Name: Freddy and Margewich
Description: "Would the Wicked Witch kidnap Freddy and force him to make pancakes just for her, or would Freddy escape from her clutches? The adventure began when Freddy became famous far and wide for his delishomposhus pancakes. Did the wicked witch have a name? Where was she from and what became of her? Find out in the sequel to Freddy and his pancakes."

Name: Pig Wisdom
Description: In Pig Wisdom, Mr. Pig applies anger management techniques, or alternatives to conflict and violence, in the barnyard, teaching the animals to solve their anger problems constructively, rather than to harm others. Wise Mr. Pig encourages the barnyard animals to use these techniques to discourage the ill behavior of Miss Goose who constantly irritates and heckles the barnyard animals, causing them to lose their cool. These techniques are emphasized in each anger-arousing situation and reiterated at the end of the book for memory application. In the end, the barnyard animals learn to manage their behavior, are much happier, and Miss Goose becomes more tolerable, even pleasant.

Name: Tea with the Turtles
Description: Little boy Cruz receives and invitation for tea from the T’s. He is very excited to go to his first tea party but who are the T’s? Join Cruz on his adventurous tea party with the Turtles.

Name: Turquie the Turkey
Description:
Esther was a mischievous and conniving little girl who craved attention.

She was very good at making up stories for her friends to cover up her shortcomings.

Esther had among other things a terrible fear of going to the dentist.

Before too long her teeth began turning a turquoise green from the decay.

She managed to convince her friends that green teeth were cool and they could be cool too if they coloured their teeth as well.

She even had them call her ‘Turquie’ after the new colour of her teeth.

That adventure became short-lived as she was forced to visit the dentist.

He managed to show her that visits to the Dentists could actually be pain-free and was great idea to maintain proper heath and maintain a big bright smile.

She now was able to attract attention not from her bizarre stories but from her winning personality that began with a big bright smile.

Name: Connies Christmas Dream
Description: It tells the story of a young fir tree dreaming to be chosen for the Christmas centerpiece at the Rockefeller Center, and her journey to ultimately seeing her dreams come true.

Name: If Santa Claus Wore Stubbies
Description: “If Santa Claus Wore Stubbies” is a unique Australian look at what it means to be Santa in Australia. Written by an Aussie mum in response to a series of postage stamps depicting Santa surfing, it explores how Santa should dress to cope with the traditionally warm Australian-summer Christmas. This book should bring a smile to the faces of young and old alike.

Name: Sofia y el regalo de las hadas
Description: Sofía y el regalo de las hadas es una aventura mágica para la imaginación ya que planta las semillas para hacernos concientes acerca de la naturaleza y de la forma como estamos conectados y nos relacionamos con todos los seres vivientes. Un mensaje maravilloso para dar y compartir.

Name: The Adventures of Shelley the Shuttlecock
Description: The Story has a main character Shelley the Shuttlecock who is a sports object, which is a Badminton Shuttlecock. She has been locked away in the attic of the Abbott family home for a long time. During the school holidays the two daughters in the Abbott family take her out of the attic to play with her in the garden. During the play Shelley the Shuttlecock is blown up into a tree where she starts an adventure, meeting several people and animals who help her along the way in returning her to the Abbott girls. The story is partly educational with life skills and morals throughout it, such as helping people in need and making new friends.

Name: The Tale of Tumeleng
Description: Will the baby elephant, Tumeleng listen to the warnings of her parents, Ayanna and Jabari? Or will her curious nature lead her into unexpected and dangerous situations?

Name: The Adventures of Matilda and Marty Mouse
Description: Matilda and Marty mouse have lots of adventures. Join them this time as they head to the seaside and meet all their friends along the way

Name: ANNIE POOH PRINCESS PUP MONKEY SHINES
Description: Annie Pooh, and MarLee have never seen a monkey before they meet Sangee. The two royal Lhasa apsos are outraged by the monkey’s very bad manners. Soon the badly behaved Sangee leads Annie Pooh and MarLee on a merry chase through the Palace as the pups look for lost and stolen items which belong to the princess.

Name: Busters Path
Description: Buster, a friendly Australian shepherd dog, developed a love for racing cars and trucks that travelled the busy road that went past our farm. He did not go intro the road but wore a path through our front yard, our garden, and our field with farm crops growing in it. He acquired many friends who encouraged him and enjoyed watching him race their vehicle.

Name: The Train to Conorika
Description: A story of family, adventure and a dash of fantasy. A spunky little girl named Camille, takes her first train trip with her grandmother to a fictitious town named Conorika. A snowstorm threatens to ruin the trip, but Camille finds an innovative way to save the day.

Name: Wonder-N-Wandering in a Zoo
Description: Annie Pooh, and MarLee have never seen a monkey before they meet Sangee. The two royal Lhasa apsos are outraged by the monkey’s very bad manners. Soon the badly behaved Sangee leads Annie Pooh and MarLee on a merry chase through the Palace as the pups look for lost and stolen items which belong to the princess.

Name: Buster and the Bull
Description: Buster was a loyal and a loving pet. He was an English Shepherd dog who followed us all over the farm. If one of my older brothers drove a team of horses to do some work in one of the fields, Buster would go with him. He loved being with us and liked playing with us. My brothers and I liked to wrestle with him. He enjoyed it too. Sometimes my brother Richard or I would get down on the ground and hug Buster close to our bodies to try to see if we could keep him from getting free as the other person called him. He always freed himself by wriggling and pushing against us with his feet. He never snapped or bit us in the process.

Name: Emily and George
Description: Emily and George belong in that fantasy land where anything is possible, where language is universal, sometimes without words but always with understanding. A time and place where pets can enter without question. A land and time of make-believe which lasts for a few precious years and returns only in dreams.

Name: Tilly the Toad to the Rescue
Description: Tilly the Toad is about the gift of giving and putting other's needs before one's own needs. It's about building lasting and meaningful friendships, and the sacrifices we sometimes must make for and in our relationships.

Name: Chester The Easter Chicken
Description:
The Easter bunny makes a big mistake and does not have enough eggs for all the kids.

Chester, an ordinary chicken who lays extraordinary eggs will help save easter.

Name: Winston and the Magpie
Description: Winston loves Rick’s car, especially when it is car-washing day, as he gets to go for a drive in it. Winston is very protective of Rick’s car and gets extremely upset when a Magpie is sitting on it and won’t get off. Just wait until you see what happens.

Name: Sade and The Golden Shoe
Description: Sade and The Shoe is a new Nigerian folktale. Sade, the heroine, saves her village from the curse of a golden shoe found by her father in a nearby magic lake. The story uses the influences of traditional West African storytelling, along with customary cadences to weave this tale of a little girl’s adventure and that of her unlikely best friend, the village mosquito. The story is similar to the famed Aesop’s fables and includes a moral that uses animals as significant figures to relate the message of the story.

Name: A Boy A Bear and A Bump in the Night
Description: A little boy named Dick was scared of nighttime noises. He could never fall asleep because of strange sounds he would hear, convinced it was a monster lurking in the dark. One night he decided he had had enough and, with his teddy bear named Fred, decided to find out what was making all the racket! What he discovered was someone not very scary at all and who was a lot like him. Someone just as scared of the noises in the night—someone who was looking for a safe place to stay and maybe a friend or two.

Name: Lucky Little Leaf
Description:
What makes one “little leaf” think he can outlast all others? Find out in this heartwarming story of a young leaf named “Lucky,” who learns that with determination and selfless acts toward others, maybe he could be the “Leaf of the Year.” 

“I was rooting for ‘Lucky’ from the very start.

Our favorite bedtime story.”

Name: Rio de Janeiro Travel Tips
Description:
Planning a visit to Rio de Janeiro? Download this app to view interesting travel tips about Rio and where to go, what to see. Enjoy from a selection of videos and images!

Privacy Policy: http://windotnet.blogspot.com/2013/11/app-privacy-policy.html

Name: Pontos Turisticos - Rio de Janeiro
Description: Aprenda mais sobre os pontos turísticos do Rio de Janeiro

Name: São Paulo F.C.
Description:
Aplicativo informacional sobre o clube São Paulo F.C.

NAVE – Núcleo Avançado em Educação
 
Idealizado pelo Oi Futuro, o NAVE pesquisa novas metodologias educacionais que dialogam com a cultura digital e os desafios do século XXI. Desenvolvido em parceria com a Secretaria de Educação do Estado de Pernambuco, o programa está construído sobre três pilares: um Centro de Pesquisa e Inovação, a Escola Técnica Cícero Dias e um Centro de Disseminação. Ao avaliar, sistematizar e difundir as experiências desenvolvidas, o NAVE traz para dentro da escola a linguagem do nosso tempo.
 
Este aplicativo foi desenvolvido no NAVE, por educandos da Escola Técnica Estadual Cícero Dias como
parte curricular do Curso Técnico de Nível Médio em Multimídia e Programação de Jogos Digitais.

Name: Jakes Moon
Description: This story is about a little boy named Jake who has always been curious about the world around him, especially the moon. He believes the moon follows only him and wants to know why. After convincing his parents of this amazing discovery, his parents give him an answer that will help him realize that he is someone special. Read this story and join Jake in realizing everyone has some very important decisions to make with lots of help.

Name: Sou São Paulo!
Description:
Adicione o Tricolor Paulista no seu Windows 8! 
Se você faz parte da nação de bravos torcedores e belas torcedoras do São Paulo, instale o aplicativo e fique por dentro de todos os jogos, assista aos melhores gols da rodada, acompanhe as últimas notícias e ainda encontre produtos oficiais do time para comprar.
Com o Sou São Paulo! você não perde nada do que acontece com seu time no campo e nem fora dele!
Developer: Studio Sol Comunicação Digital Ltda Epp

Name: Entretempos - Folha de São Paulo blog
Description: Fique por dentro dos últimos posts sobre fotografias, com  Cassiana Der Haroutiounian e Daigo Oliva colunistas da Folha de São Paulo.

Name: LANCE!
Description: O LANCE!Net deixa você por dentro do que acontece no mundo do esporte, com informações em texto, foto e vídeo. E aqui você acompanha de perto o seu time do coração!

Name: Bernardo Mello Franco - Folha de São Paulo blog
Description: Com este App você confere os últimos posts de Bernardo Mello Franco, colunista do jornal 'Folha de São Paulo'

Name: A Christmas Story
Description: I want everyone to enjoy this book and to learn about God's grace, love,and understanding for us all. I'm showing how a family who loves and walksin God's spirit, is a family who has their ups and downs just like everyone.By being strong in the spirit of the Lord, that no matter what happens inlife we can cope.

Name: Tudo sobre o São Paulo Futebol Clube
Description: Aplicativo que conta a historia gloriosa do nosso São Paulo Futebol Clube. O aplicativo tambem conta com fotos, hino, elenco e muito mais, ou seja tudo sobre o nosso Soberano!

Name: Rio de Janeiro Airport GIG + Flight Tracker
Description:
Rio de Janeiro Galeao International Airport (GIG) is the largest airport in Brazil. It is located 14 kilometers north of the city. The airport is a hub for Gol and TAM Airlines. This app provides complete information including airlines, car rentals, directions and more. 

No other app provides as much information --useful information you need. 

Rio de Janeiro Airport lets you know if your flights delayed or cancelled and gives you the tools needed to quickly find an alternate flight and rebook all in one place. 

Check-in, flight status, baggage, seats, for your flight all at your fingertips. 

In addition, you can access information on virtually every airport you fly to from Rio de Janeiro Galeao. We include Sao Paulo, Buenos Aires, Santiago, Lima, Mexico City and all the airports of the world.

Name: Datafolha - Folha de São Paulo blog
Description: Saiba mais sobre o cenário eleitoral brasileiro com o App do DataFolha blog.

Name: Shark Dash
Description: Discover the new benchmark for physics puzzle games! Shark Dash is a highly addictive game that takes the physics puzzler to fun new heights with a unique cartoonish style starring funny little bath toys!

Name: 1st4Fans São Paulo edition
Description:
Unashamedly São Paulo-centric live scores, commentary, news, fixtures, results and opinion. Because you just don't care that much about other teams :)

Why just get your São Paulo fix by trawling the web yourself when you can get all the news in one place, including the fan opinions that would never make it into an official app!

Some reviews from around the world:
"Fast and complete app for fans, includes next matches, news, opinions and competition tables as well as videos and some additional stuff."
"Great app bringing together all team news. Live tiles really liven up my start screen!"
"It's an awesome app for a fan."

Features:
- The latest news and opinion from around the web
- Live scores, commentary and news can be snapped to the side of your screen
- Live tile with latest news and next match info
- Match reports and stats
- Complete fixtures and results
- League tables updated live during matches
- Share interesting articles with your friends

Name: Turismo na cidade de São Paulo
Description: Conheça a cidade de São Paulo através de alguns pontos do turismo na cidade de São Paulo. Em breve mais pontos turísticos.

Name: Dj Mixer
Description:
Dj Mixer turns your tablet into a DJ mixer, ideal for playing your music in your party, easy to use and totally free, no advertising and no in-app purchases. Dj Mixer have two decks and allows you to create your playlist at the moment and add songs "on the fly" to your sessions, and mix with a cross fader. It also has a automix feature mixing your music automatically, so you never stop the party!. 
New features include load and save playlists, search song box, random sort queue play list button, spin/scrash directly touching the disk,  Pitch - velocity change control, pause with progressive disk stopping, progressive restarting in resume pause, and four band graphic equalizer, beat and EQ peaks viewer.

Note: This app don’t works with DRM protected songs .

Contact: ketoolabs.djmixer@gmail.com
Follow us in twitter: @KetoLabsDJMixer

Name: The Perfect Raisin
Description:
The Perfect Raisin and Pretzel Cousins Club is a tale of cousins who decide to form a club. They are part of a blended family and are all very different little ""raisins"" or ""pretzels."" The original club members face questions and concerns about allowing new members who are different from them to join their club.

They have to discover that being different is not only OK but also fun to add to the mix. You will love learning with these cute raisins and pretzels! You can be in the club too!

Enjoy the book and look for more adventures of the Raisin and Pretzel Cousins Club in the future.

Author's Book Video:
http://youtu.be/TAtK4h_bQ24

Name: The Adventures of Little Wave and Her Friends
Description: Little Wave never experiencing land, hooks up with a sailboat and albatross to find the illusive island of Nui Nui. They encounter many dangers and setbacks that forge their characters and create lasting friendships.

Name: Grandpops Shed
Description: Grandpop has an excuse for every weather. Will he ever get to see what's in his shed?

Name: Adventures of Boo and Koty
Description: Meet Boo and Koty Bear. These two little cubs are posed by the question, “What is snow?” Will they be able to forgo hibernation until it arrives? What will happen if they do get to experience snow? Remember back to your first snow and then put yourself in their paws. Enjoy this tale about two curious and adventurous little cubs.

Name: The Books That Did Not Get Read
Description: This story is about a little boy who was always told to read, but he really didn´t understand what the word read really meant or what his teachers and parents mean when they tell him to go and read a book. Come with Malik on his journey as he travels through his imagination while trying to understand what the word READ is all about. Let´s take this journey with Malik as he learns the true meaning of reading.

Name: O Bom de São Paulo
Description: Veja algumas informações sobre o Turismo em São Paulo. Confira também uma música e um vídeo que homenageiam a cidade e, além disso, fique por dentro de algumas curiosidades sobre a bandeira do estado e saiba qual é o Hino dos Bandeirantes. Você também poderá ver algumas fotos de pontos turísticos da cidade.

Name: Classificados São Paulo
Description: São Paulo oferece anúncios classificados locais para emprego, à venda, imóveis, serviços, comunidade e eventos. Acompanhe as noticias em tempo real...

Name: Rio de Janeiro Top 10
Description: Discover the Top 10 places to see in Rio de Janeiro. Navigate and read about each location in an interactive map. View beautiful pictures about each location. A beautiful city visualized in a beautiful app.

Name: Quiz São Paulo Plus
Paco The Crying Donkey
Description: Paco the donkey was looking forward to meeting and making friends with the other animals in the animal kingdom. He was very disappointed when he was not allowed to go to their ball and started to cry. His happy spirits could not stop him from crying, so they sent for their Queen who spoke on his behalf and he was allowed to go to the ball and there he made many friends.

Name: Whats In the Attic
Description: Books have a way of taking us somewhere else. This book will put you on the edge of your seat for a while, and then bring a soft spot in your heart. Read what’s in the attic to see what these two young boys find, and how they handle it.

Name: Help Town Rio de Janeiro
Description: Para aqueles que sempre estão viajando para novas cidades, help town belo horizonte estará ajudando com informações a respeito de números de telefones de taxi , aeroportos , rodoviária sem contar o mapa do metro e alguns pontos turisiticos.

Name: Rio de Janeiro Airport SDU + Flight Tracker
Description:
Rio de Janeiro Santos Dumont Airport (SDU) is the sixth largest airport in Brazil. The airport is near the city. This application provides complete information, including airlines, car rentals, directions and more.

No other app provides the most information - useful information you need.

Rio de Janeiro Airport lets you know if their flights delayed or canceled and gives you the tools necessary to quickly find a flight alternative and reschedule all in one place.

Check-in, flight status, baggage, seats for your flight all at your fingertips.

Additionally, you can access information on almost every airport to fly from Rio de Janeiro. We include Brasilia, Sao Paulo, Porto Alegre, Recife, Belo Horizonte, Salvador, Buenos Aires, Santiago, Lima, and all airports worldwide.

Name: Americana - Folha de São Paulo blog
Description: Com este App você confere os últimos posts de Luciana Coelho, colunista do jornal 'Folha de São Paulo'

Name: Rio de Janeiro BR
Description: Aplicativo destinado ao Rio de Janeiro.

Name: Hino do estado de São Paulo
Description: Aplicativo com o hino do estado de São Paulo, com a letra e a música.

Name: Puppies Share Day
Description: This book is a epilogue to the first book. After that cold, long winter, the puppies grew up and can't wait for spring and summer to do the exciting things they dreamed of doing all winter. They all have so many ideas and interests but are too young to go out on their own. So they all decide to partake in each other's interests.

Name: Restaurantes de São Paulo
Description:
Nesta App você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os meus restaurantes preferidos de São Paulo.

Há opções para quem gosta de Churrasco, Pizzas, Massas, Hamburguerias e até mesmo opções Vegetarianas. Espero que você também goste e envie suas sugestões por e-mail para incluirmos na App.

Name: Nana Horta - Folha de São Paulo blog
Description: Fique por dentro das últimas notícias sobre gastronomia com Nana Horta, colunista do jornal "Folha de São Paulo"

Name: Marcelo Katsuki - Folha de São Paulo blog
Description: Fique por dentro dos últimos posts sobre "Comes e Bebes", com Marcelo Katsuki colunista do jornal Folha de São Paulo.

Name: Viva São Paulo 24 Horas
Description:
O seu guia de tudo que fica aberto em São Paulo todas as horas do dia, ordenado sempre a partir local mais perto de onde você está.
Este aplicativo não coleta ativamente e não armazena informações pessoais de seus usuários.

Name: Gorgeous Rio De Janeiro
Description: Rio De Janeiro is the capital city of the State of Rio de Janeiro, the second largest city of Brazil, and the third largest metropolitan area and agglomeration in South America, boasting approximately 6.3 million people within the city proper, making it the 6th largest in the Americas, and 26th in the world. For More information about Rio De Janeiro download this app.

Name: Copa São Paulo de Futebol Jr.
Description: Conheça a história da maior competição de Futebol Júnior do Brasil.

Name: An Adventure with Doogleby
Description: Doogleby is a space alien who loves nothing more than taking his friend, Tom, on nighttime adventures. One night when Doogleby taps on Tom's window to wake him up, he knows that this adventure is going to be special. After Doogleby turns on the propeller on the top of his hat, he and Tom soar into the night sky. Soon, they pass Wispy Cloud and the Man in the Moon on their way to visit Doogleby's friends on Stardust Land where they eat glitter cakes, drink sparkling lemonade, and play tuneful whistles with the Sparklemus family. But when Doogleby's propeller fails to start, Tom cannot help but worry that he will not make it home before his mum discovers he is missing. An Adventure with Doogleby is the delightful tale of a space alien and a little boy as they embark on a spectacular journey through the clouds and past the stars-all with the promise of getting one of them home for breakfast.

Name: Quiz São Paulo
A Home for an Angel
Description: When I set out to write this story I thought How do you write a Dream, when I needed to some how draw that I feel Natalya did just that. My thanks to my boys Aaron and Zack. My editor Selena Thomason and my artist Natalya Willis-Knudson I could not have done with out. I tried looking at the world as one who did not Believe, did not dare Dream, did not dare to Hope, that someone would want them just as they were. With out. This is difficult to put into words, but this is where I tried to be in order to tell this story of Hope, Belief and that they come into this world with a very special gift ________ ( you have to read my story to find out). ~Ron Fulner

If you spend too much time looking at computer and feel, that your eyesight is getting worse every day, Eyes Health Program is just what you need! This useful application is a necessary guide for all busy people who take a good care about health. Become a master of eyes health analysis!

You can also read useful articles in reference books and track your results in the “History” tab.

Learn how to improve your vision and eyesight with the help of Eyes Health Program Pro! Start eye training and enjoy the results!

Try our new app “Shapes Toddler Game” by IT Top ©

To give the characters a new look, you can also change their hairstyle, pick up a fancy one from the ones available. Don't forget about the fashionable accessories and the shopping bag! Try our new app “Kawaii Dress Up” by IT Top ©

Amazing dressing games only for your little beauties!

To give her a new look, you can also change her hairstyle, pick up a fancy one from the ones available. Don't forget about the accessories and the shopping bag!

Description:
Everybody knows ‘bout Alice, she has a great trip in Wonderland. It was a very dangerous journey with many different unknown creatures like a Cheshire Cat! Do you know this cartoon character? Of course, you do! He’s very clever and crafty, but he’s also so kind! Catch the cat is your opportunity to know more ‘bout this dude! You must find him on your screen, but it seems that it so easy, try and you’ll understand what I mean! He’s so crafty, he’ll hide very nimbly! Use your intuition and catch him! He’ll open up very carefully! First part of his body which you’ll find score to you first points! Find all his body and you’ll win! Use your savvy, attentiveness and also strategy!     Catch The Cat is the best chance for young fans of Alice’s Adventure in

Name: Snail Rally
Description:
Snail Rally
Snail Rally is an exceptional app for all fans of exciting gameplay! Do you like nice garden snails? So, we have something special for you! Now your dream about snails adventure is closer than ever! Snail Rally is a new great adventure game for all action and platformer games fans! This snail is looking for food, so help her to find something to eat! It's time to get the highest score and help this tiny snail! Are you searching for something interesting? So, this amazing app is special for you! Snail Rally one of the best time killers ever! For the fans of adventures and nice garden snails! Snail Rally – awesome game for you! Play the Snail Rally and enjoy it! Improve your reaction skills! Try hard to get as much scores as you can! Name: Pro Chess
Description: Free Chess Game featuring great 3D graphics, sound and strong computer opponent as well as options to play in 2D and export games in Portable Game Notation (PGN)

Description: Aquarium Sim is an interactive virtual Aquarium for your phone & tablet. Sit back, relax and enjoy a variety of marine & freshwater fish swimming about in a colorful coral reef habitat. Description: Sail a realistic map of the Caribbean as you sink enemy ships and capture enemy towns.  Choose one of 4 nationalities and capture glory for your king, or simply become a pirate and plunder everyone.  Pirate Sim is a simple yet fun, featuring open ended game play and beautiful graphics. Dinosaur Sim allows you to play as one of the 20 popular Dinosaurs. Fight your way to the top of the food chain or play as a peaceful herbivore in a realistic 3D environment. Each Dinosaur is beatify animated and has realistic sounds. Dinosaur Sim is action packed but also has educational modes in a perfect mix to keep you playing and learning for hours.
Dinosaur Sim also contains 3 additional game modes including;

- Dino Safari mode, learn about each of the Dinosaurs in the game, 
- Dino Paint mode, color your favorite Dinosaurs 
- Dino Museum mode, learn about fossils and Dinosaur Bones

Name: Kids Train Sim
Description:
Kids Trains allows you to control a train as it goes around a track. Activate the horn or bell, control speed. Stop and stations, switch between passenger, steam and freight trains. Pan/Zoom around the train or enjoy the ride as one of the passengers.
From the creators of Train Sim; comes Kids Trains is a train simulator designed for kids. Kids Trains features many of the same features of our Train Simulator however it is a bit simpler to use and features cartoon & kid friendly graphics.

Description: Play the role of an Ant in an Ant Colony, collect food for your Queen, dig subterranean tunnels, customize and decorate your environment.  Call your friendly black ants to attack the red ant colony, and most importantly run away from the Spiders.  Ant Sim is a fun mix of simulation and sandbox type gameplay that will keep you entertained for hours.

L’application Formation Google Documents comprend 49 formations sur les fonctionnalités les plus utilisées ; elles sont organisées au sein des compétences suivantes :

	• Découvrir l'application 

	• Enregistrer et utiliser ses documents

	• Saisir et modifier du texte

	• Mettre en forme un texte

	• Rechercher à l'intérieur d'un document

	• Mettre en page un document

	• Illustrer et enrichir le document

	• Travailler à plusieurs sur un document

	• Dialoguer avec des contacts

Dans ce parcours de formation, vous verrez toutes les fonctionnalités de Google Documents. Cette application de traitement de texte en ligne vous permettra de créer et de mettre en page rapidement n'importe quel document texte. Vous verrez comment importer d'anciens documents, et comment en créer de nouveaux. Vous verrez aussi comment intégrer des éléments visuels et interactifs à vos documents textes. Car Google documents va plus loin que la simple mise en page de texte en proposant d'insérer des images, des liens hypertextes, des tableaux et même des graphiques. Vous saurez enfin toutes les fonctionnalités de partage d'un document. Vous pouvez envoyer par mail, publier sur interne, et travailler simultanément à plusieurs sur un même document. Vous pourrez même gérer des forums de discussion intégrés à vos documents.

Une formation correspond à une vidéo de quelques minutes présentant une problématique concrète (Importer des documents, Créer une table des matières, Participer à une discussion sur un document) et sa solution. Chaque formation Vodeclic est produite par un formateur spécialisé sur Google Documents selon une méthode pédagogique reconnue par ses pairs.

Name: OneNote 2010 Training
Description:
This Vodeclic app features 29 tutorials and more than 2 hours of training on OneNote 2010 Training. OneNote 2010 is part of the 2010 edition of Microsft's Office suite.

The OneNote 2010 Training app features 29 tutorials on the key OneNote 2010 tools and functionalities. They are organized as follows:

	• Getting to know the application
	• Searching within a document
	• Creating a diagram using shapes
	• Illustrating & enhancing your document
	• Formatting & shaping your document
	• Working on a document with someone else
	• Configuring & customizing the application

This series of video tutorials will introduce you to OneNote 2010, an organiser program produced by Microsoft which allows you to create notes and manage your projects. Over the course of these twenty-nine video tutorials, you will get to grips with the key functionalities of OneNote 2010, including tags, sections, a powerful search function, and collaborating with other users online.

A tutorial is a video lasting just a few minutes which demonstrates a particular tool or use (Creating video & audio recordings, Organising your items, Organising your sections within your notebook) and how to get the most out of it. Each Vodeclic tutorial is produced by a specialist subject trainer and adheres to a clearly defined learning method.

WinDrop is a new approach to data exchange between iPhone and Windows devices. The app lets you share website links, photos, notes, contacts, files, and even movie descriptions from IMDb.

The shared data is encrypted and passed on to the Windows app. The latter enables viewing, saving, and copying of shared elements. The user is automatically notified of an incoming share. The solution is the equivalent of AirDrop - a feature available on iOS devices.


With WinDrop, you can share:

- website links
- photos
- files
- contact
- notes
- descriptions from IMDb

Description:
Ce reader permet de découvrir le roman 'impressions de voyage en suisse tome 2'
Alexandre Dumas promène le lecteur à travers l’Helvétie du siècle passé, les montagnes - ce brigand de pays où l’on ne peut faire un pas sans risquer de se casser le cou ou de s’ensabler - et le plateau suisse. De Paris, Lyon, Genève et ses joailliers, jusqu’à Lausanne « dont les maisons blanches semblent, de loin, une troupe de cygnes qui se sèchent au soleil », il prend la direction du Valais, monte sur Chamonix, le Saint-Bernard, et nous raconte l’ ascension nocturne de la Dent du Chat et l’incendie qui s’ensuivit. Puis ce sont les Chartreux qui « mangent dans des encriers et dorment dans des armoires », Morat et l’histoire de Charles le Téméraire. Ses récits de batailles sont hallucinants, mêlant barbarie et sentiments, stratégie et courage. Du Lauterbrunnen, au Faulhorn il s’aventure sur la route du Mont Gemmi où il séjourne dans l’auberge qui inspira Werner pour son drame « 24 Février ». De Loèche-les-Bains et Münster où il rencontre Francesco, son jeune guide, ils découvrent Obergesteln et ses anthropophages, passent le col de la Furka pour arriver à Göschenen, son fameux pont du Diable et sa légende, puis enfin Altdorf où il nous conte l’histoire de Guillaume Tell. 1833-34

Name: Chien de Baskerville
Description:
Ce reader permet de découvrir le roman 'chien baskerville'
Le docteur Mortimer vient voir Sherlock Holmes et son ami le docteur Watson pour leur expliquer les circonstances étranges de la mort de son ami et patient, sir Charles Baskerville, dans le Devonshire. Celui-ci avait le cœur fragile et a succombé à une attaque cardiaque. C'est du moins ce que Mortimer a dit à la police. En effet, il présente à Sherlock Holmes une légende sur la famille des Baskerville. Celle-ci évoque Hugo de Baskerville, un ancêtre cruel et brutal qui a attiré sur lui les foudres de l'enfer, et qui a été tué par un chien démoniaque à la gueule en flammes, le Chien des Baskerville.

Bien entendu, Sherlock Holmes reste sceptique sur les explications surnaturelles mais l'affaire le passionne dès le début. Mortimer leur annonce qu'il est à Londres aussi pour venir chercher le dernier héritier qui est un neveu de Charles, Henry de Baskerville qui est revenu de l'Amérique sur son appel. Henry doit hériter du domaine et de la richesse considérable de Charles, cependant, Mortimer hésite à l'emmener connaissant le destin funeste de sa famille sur la Lande du Devonshire.

Holmes rencontre l'homme qui est d'âge mûr. Aventureux, énergique et volontaire, c'est un homme tout destiné à poursuivre les bonnes œuvres de Charles sur la région. Après quelques péripéties à Londres, Holmes et Watson sont certains qu'une influence humaine et bien réelle est présente dans cette affaire.

Holmes demande donc à Watson de protéger Sir Henry Baskerville dans son château puisque lui même est "trop occupé" à Londres. Il devra veiller sur le baron et faire des rapports très réguliers et détaillés à Holmes. Commence alors une aventure particulièrement intense qui mobilise toutes les capacités d'analyse de nos héros.

Name: ASUS Reader
Description:
A simple website reader based on RSS feeds in a simple reading environment.

Summary

Asus Reader groups the websites based on audiences’ RSS feeds from website selection. Unlike traditional RSS reader only provides a brief summary of the article. Audiences are forced to link to the feed website to read the entire content on a browser. Users need to go back and forth between RSS feeds and the website. In contrast, Asus Reader accesses the feeds’ websites and automatically parsed out the content from specified websites, and merge Individual feeds from the same website a group contains list of articles with only text and images related to RSS feeds. As a result, audiences can focus on the main articles instead of advertisements or other distractions on the website. Best of all, audiences can read articles effortlessly when Internet available or offline reading by pre-downloaded content.

Privacy Note: ASUS Reader requires Internet assessment in order to download RSS feeds content and its linked website from default RSS feed addresses. However, ASUS Reader does NOT and has no need to access user's personal information. 

Online Reading
Reading and use app regardless of power source or Internet type (WiFi or Cellular network). App will automatically save the articles download from website.
Open AppBar at first page and select “Default Reset” button to reload category groups.
Open AppBar at second page and select “Update All” button to get the latest Content from Internet. 
Content will NOT be reloaded unless “Update All” button is clicked. 
Content can be viewed in both “Reader” or “Web” mode by clicking the upper right button toggled between either “Reader” and “Web” at second Page. Web view might take significantly longer to load compares to Reader mode depends on Internet connection speed. 

Offline Reading
Saved content will be loaded for reading under Reader mode, but not Web view.
Content cannot be updated from website without Internet access.

Name: AirWatch - Content Locker
Description:
Please use our new Windows 10 Universal app! 
https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9nblggh4rxc4

AirWatch introduces an enterprise-grade Mobile Content Management (MCM) application for Windows that allows IT administrators to distribute public content and centrally manage mobile access to corporate documents through a web-based console.
The AirWatch Content Locker application enables mobile users to access corporate resources on-the-go from their Windows devices. To access content, the user’s Windows device must be enrolled in AirWatch and the native Content Locker application must be installed from the Windows Store. 
Users are prompted for a Group ID, username and password.  The Content Locker supports basic, LDAP and Proxy authentication.  Once logged in, content is presented in the way it was categorized by the administrator using document categories and metadata. Documents distribution and permissions is configurable at the document level. Capabilities supported include:
•Content Access Control: Can be set to enable offline viewing or online viewing only
•Transfer Method: Can be set to any (cellular) or Wi-Fi Only (no cellular)
•Download Type: Can be set to on-demand controlled by the user OR content can be pushed automatically by download date.  Automatic documents (mandatory documents) cannot be deleted by users
•Download Priority: Can be set as high, normal or low for queuing purposes
Once a document has been downloaded, it can be selected for viewing using e-Reader apps available on the device. If a device is compromised or MDM has been broken, AirWatch prevents access to the Content Locker application and performs a complete wipe of the content data on the device.
AirWatch provides administrators with detailed content visibility at the device level.  The system tracks current content status (unknown, installed, uninstalled), content priority (high, normal and low), deployment method (on demand or automatic), content version and size, when the document was downloaded and when it was last viewed.  
The following document types are supported by Windows Content Locker:
•MS Office: Excel, PowerPoint and Word
•Other: PDF, XML, HTML, Text, Rich text format and Rich text Format Dictionary
•Pictures: PNG and JPEG

The Windows Content Locker is available for Windows 8.1 and Windows 10 devices.

Name: AirWatch Inbox

Protected with AES-256 bit encryption, the AirWatch Inbox is configured with advanced data loss prevention policies to secure sensitive data. The AirWatch Inbox provides a seamless user experience for quick access to corporate email, calendar and contacts. Ideal for high regulation deployments and BYOD programs, the AirWatch Inbox can be deployed as a managed application on the device.

Enterprise administrators would be able to provide login credentials and email access to users via the AirWatch console. For more information, visit air-watch.com

AirWatch with the AirWatch Inbox enables enterprises to: 

•	Manage devices in one console 
•	Enroll devices over-the-air 
•	Configure email access and email policies remotely 
•	Enforce security restrictions and encryption

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW DE
Description:
"Hero Factory, hier Evo. Ich muss aus der Turret-Maschine aussteigen! Scheint, als kämen meine Angreifer aus dem Boden. Hero Factory -- hier muss etwas größeres als das, was ich zu bieten hab, her. Wir brauchen Kampfmaschinen!" 

Rücke mit dem Alpha Team aus, stürze dich in einer von neun mächtigen Kampfmaschinen mitten ins Gefecht und kämpfe gegen die 'Invasion von unten'. 

- Besiege fünf gigantische Beasts und ihre Jumper-Schwärme in neun zerstörerischen Levels 
- Erlebe die komplette Geschichte mit actiongeladenen Videos 
- Schließe umfangreiche Missionen ab, um über 45 Verbesserungslevels und Spezial-Moves freizuschalten 
- Stelle deine Kampfmaschine zusammen und verbessere sie in einer dualen Umgebung 
- Wähle deine Gegner, miss dich mit ihnen im Kampfmodus und sammle dabei insgesamt 75 Abzeichen ein 

Wir sind Hero Factory und wir beschützen die Galaxie vor jeglichen Bedrohungen! Schließe dich dem Team jetzt an! 

Hero Factory - 'Invasion von unten' beinhaltet ein neues Währungssystem, mit dem sämtliche Käufe auch durch Spielen freigeschaltet werden können. Mit dem Kauf von 'Hero-Punkten' kannst du deine Lieblings-Kampfmaschine oder besondere Fähigkeiten freischalten, um einen Vorsprung zu haben

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW DA
Description:
"Hero Factory, dette er Evo, jeg forlader min Turret Machine. Min angribere ser ud til at komme op af jorden. Hero Factory -- vi får brug for noget, der er større end mig. Vi har brug for Kampmaskiner!" 

Tag afsted med Alpha team og spring ud i den dybe ende med en af de ni seje Kampmaskiner for at besejre 'Invasionen nedefra'. 

- Besejr fem gigantiske beasts og deres springersværme gennem ni byniveauer 
- Oplev historien med actionspækket videoindhold 
- Gennemfør episke missioner for at opgradere over 45 niveauer med evner og specielle moves 
- Byg din Kampmaskine og Power Up i et unikt dobbeltskaleret miljø 
- Vælg din kamp og modstander i Kamptilstand med 75 emblemer, som indsamles og fuldendes 

Vi er Hero Factory, og vi beskytter galaksen mod alle trusler. Bliv en del af holdet nu! 

Hero Factory 'Invasionen nedefra' indeholder et pengebaseret valutasystem, hvor alle køb kan opnås udelukkende via spillet. Køb af 'Heltepoint' vil gøre det muligt at låse op for dine favorit Kampmaskiner eller brug dem på evner for at få et forspring.

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW FR
Description:
"Hero Factory, ici Evo, je sors de la tourelle. Mes attaquants ont l'air de sortir du sol. Hero Factory : on va avoir besoin de quelque chose de plus gros que moi. Il nous faut des machines de combat !" 

Sortez en mission avec l'équipe Alpha et sautez dans le grand bain avec l'une des neuf incroyables machines de combat pour repousser "L'invasion venue d'en bas". 

- Vainquez 5 gigantesques beasts et leurs essaims de jumpers à travers neuf niveaux dans des cités en ruine 
- Profitez de l'histoire grâce au contenu vidéo bourré d'action 
- Terminez des missions pour débloquer plus de 45 niveaux de capacités et de techniques 
- Construisez votre machine de combat et doublez de volume dans un environnement à double échelle 
- Choisissez votre adversaire en mode Bataille et remportez 75 insignes à collectionner 

Nous sommes la Hero Factory, nous protégeons la galaxie de tout ce qui la menace. Rejoignez l'équipe ! 

"L'invasion venue d'en bas" de Hero Factory comprend un système monétisé où tous les articles achetables sont aussi débloquables en jouant. Acheter des "points de héros" vous permettra de débloquer vos machines de combat favorites ou bien de vous procurer des capacités pour vous donner un avantage.

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW IT
Description:
"Hero Factory, qui Evo. Abbandono la torretta. I miei aggressori sembrano uscire da sottoterra. Hero Factory, abbiamo bisogno di qualcosa più grande di me. Ci servono macchine di battaglia!" 

Intervieni con l'Alpha team e affonda l'attacco con una delle mie macchine da battaglia per sconfiggere l'Invasione dal basso. 

- Sconfiggi 5 bestie giganti e le loro orde di saltatori attraverso 9 livelli esplosivi 
- Vivi una storia densa d'azione 
- Completa missioni epocali ed evolviti in più di 45 livelli di abilità e mosse speciali 
- Costruisci la tua macchina da battaglia e potenziala in un ambiente unico a doppia scala 
- Scegli il tuo avversario in modalità Battaglia con 75 distintivi da raccogliere e completare 

Non siamo la Hero Factory, proteggiamo la galassia da qualsiasi minaccia. Entra nel team! 

Hero Factory Invasione dal basso include un sistema di valuta monetizzabile per cui tutti gli acquisti si possono effettuare attraverso il gioco. Comprando Punti Hero potrai sbloccare le tue macchine da battaglia preferite o ottenere abilità che ti garantiranno un vantaggio.

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW CZ
Description:
„Hero Factory tady je Evo, vyskakuju z věžového stroje. Zdá se, že útočníci přicházejí z podzemí. Hero Factory -- budeme potřebovat něco většího, než jsem já. Budeme potřebovat bojové stroje!“
 
Vyrazte s Alfa týmem a skočte přímo do hlubin s jedním z devíti úžasných bojových strojů a porazte „Invazi z hlubin“.
 
- Porazte pět obřích monster a jejich skákající roje v devíti městských úrovních.
- Prožijte příběh s akcí nabitým video obsahem.
- Dokončete epické mise a upgradujte více než 45 úrovní schopností a speciálních pohybů.
- Sestavte si vlastní bojový stroj a zvyšujte jeho sílu v jedinečném dvojrozměrném prostředí.
- Vyberte si svůj boj a zápaste v režimu bitvy o 75 medailí, které můžete sbírat a doplňovat.

Jsme Hero Factory, chráníme galaxii před všemi hrozbami. Přidejte se do týmu!
 
„Invaze z hlubin“ Hero Factory zahrnuje zpoplatněný měnový systém, kde lze všechny nákupy získat pomocí samotného hraní hry. Nákup „Bodů hrdinů“ vám umožní odemknout oblíbené bojové stroje nebo je utratit na schopnosti pro snadnější začátek.

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW PO
Description:
"Hero Factory, mówi Evo, ewakuuję się z maszyny wieżowej. Napastnicy wychodzą spod ziemi. Hero Factory, będziemy potrzebować czegoś większego. Maszyn bojowych!"
 
Wyślij do boju drużynę Alfa, dołącz do walki w jednej z dziewięciu niezwykłych maszyn bojowych i połóż kres 'inwazji spod ziemi'.
 
- Pokonaj pięć olbrzymich bestii i roje ich pomocników na dziewięciu poziomach miasta
- Poznaj fabułę wzbogaconą o wypełnione akcją materiały wideo
- Wykonuj rozbudowane misje i ulepszaj ponad 45 poziomów umiejętności i manewrów specjalnych
- Zbuduj własną maszynę bojową i wspomagacz w unikalnym środowisku o dwukrotnie większej skali
- Dołącz do batalii i zawalcz w trybie bitwy - do zdobycia czeka aż 75 odznak

Jesteśmy Hero Factory i chronimy galaktykę. Dołącz do naszej drużyny!
 
W grze Hero Factory 'Inwazja spod ziemi' obowiązuje system waluty, w którym wszystkie elementy do kupienia można również uzyskać za darmo w trakcie rozgrywki. Zakup 'punktów bohaterstwa' umożliwia odblokowanie ulubionych maszyn bojowych lub zdobycie umiejętności. Do nabycia dostępne są różne pakiety od 100 do 1000 punktów.

Name: LEGO® Hero Factory Brain Attack
Description:
Enjoy the latest, all-action LEGO® Hero Factory game, featuring awesome 3D graphics, incredible weapons and an army of evil brains. Makuhero City is under attack and only you can save the day! 

- Defend Makuhero City and stop the waves of brains attacking the Hero Factory 
- Customise your hero with fantastic weapons and armour 
- Select Furno, Bulk, Breez or Rocka to fight as your sidekick 
- Earn game points to upgrade your firepower and defences 
- NEW! Stadium level and 6 high powered weapons 

The Hero Factory needs your help. Can you be its greatest defender?

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW FI
Description:
"Hero Factory, täällä Evo. Joudun poistumaan tykkitornikoneesta. Päällekarkaajat tuntuvat nousevan maasta. Hero Factory -- täällä tarvitaan jotakin minua isompaa. Tarvitsemme taistelukoneita! 

Lähde kentälle alfajoukkueen kanssa ja hyökkää suoraan toimintaan jollakin yhdeksästä uskomattomasta taistelukoneesta, kun yrität torjua hyökkäyksen maan alta.

– Nujerra viisi jättimäistä hirviötä ja niiden hyppijälaumat yhdeksässä kaupunkikahinakentässä. 
– Koe tarina toiminnantäyteisen videosisällön kautta. 
– Läpäise eeppisiä tehtäviä, jotta pääset päivittämään yli 45 tasoa kykyjä ja erikoisliikkeitä. 
– Kehitä taistelukonettasi ja hanki lisävoimia ainutlaatuisessa kahden mittakaavan ympäristössä. 
– Valikoi taistelusi ja kohtaa vastustajia taistelutilassa, jossa voi kerätä 75 ansiomerkkiä. 

Me olemme Hero Factory: suojelemme galaksia kaikkia uhkia vastaan. Liity tiimiin saman tien! 

Hero Factory "Hyökkäys maan alta" -pelissä on rahajärjestelmä, jossa kaikki ostokohteet voi hankkia pelkästään peliä pelaamalla. Sankaripisteitä ostamalla voi avata omia lempitaistelukoneita tai ne voi käyttää ominaisuuksiin, joilla saa etumatkaa muihin pelaajiin.

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW HU
Description:
"Hero Factory, itt Evo. Most lépek meg a tornyos gépezetből. Úgy tűnik, a támadók a föld alól jönnek. Hero Factory, ide valami nagyobb kell, mint én. Harci gépekre van szükségünk!"

Indulj el az Alpha csapattal, és ugorj be a legmélyebb vízbe a kilenc csodálatos harci gép egyikével, hogy legyőzd a 'lentről jövő inváziót'.

- Győzd le az öt hatalmas szörnyet és ugráló hordáikat a kilenc várospusztító pályán
- Ismerd meg a történetet az akciódús videotartalommal
- Teljesítsd az epikus küldetéseket, és fejleszd képességeidet és különleges mozdulataidat a 45. szint fölé
- Építsd fel harci géped, és fejleszd fel a különleges, kettős méretű környezetben
- Válaszd ki a harci módot, és érj fel a többiekhez a harci módban, melyben 75 kitüntetést kell összegyűjtened

Mi vagyunk a Hero Factory, megvédjük a galaxist minden veszélytől. Csatlakozz a csapathoz most!

A Hero Factory 'Invasion from Below' tartalmaz egy pénzrendszert, melyben minden vásárlás elvégezhető csupán a játékkal való játszással. A 'hőspontok' megvásárlásával lehetővé válik kedvenc harci géped feloldása, vagy elköltheted őket különböző képességekre, hogy kezdeti előnyre tegyél szert

Name: LEGO® HERO FACTORY INVASION FROM BELOW RU
Description:
"Прием, Hero Factory, это Evo. Я катапультируюсь с машины Turret. Нападающие, кажется, идут из-под земли. Hero Factory, внимание: может понадобиться кто-то, крупнее меня. Нам нужны боевые машины!" 

Отправляйтесь в бой с командой Альфа и прыгайте в неизвестность на одной из девяти великолепных боевых машин, чтобы остановить "Нашествие снизу". 

- Победите пять гигантских чудовищ и их прыгающие орды на девяти уровнях в рушащемся городе 
- Вас ждет динамичная история с многочисленными видео-вставками 
- Проходите эпические миссии и повышайте уровень своих способностей и специальных приемов с 1го до до 45-го 
- Создайте свою боевую машину и получайте бонусы за бои в уникальной среде с двумя разными масштабами 
- Выбирайте бои и соревнуйтесь с другими в режиме боя, где можно собрать полную коллекцию из 75 значков 

Мы — Hero Factory, и мы защитим галактику от любых угроз! Присоединяйтесь к нашей команде! 

В игре Hero Factory "Нашествие снизу" действует специальная система игровой валюты, где доступ ко всем покупкам можно получить только играя в игру. На купленные "геройские очки" можно открыть доступ к любимым боевым машинам или потратить их на способности, чтобы расти быстрее.

Name: Philippine Constitution

Name: Hide8
Description:
The application, Hide8 aims to give privacy and security to user’s important files. This can encrypt and secure files in a hidden vault within the user’s computer. The application will disguise as a simple functional calculator application. To launch the main application, the user/s needs to enter the activation key and press the equal button. The activation key is the series of numbers used to launch the main app the default activation key is 0000. The PIN is the key used for user verification in the main app, the default PIN is 0000. Both pin and activation key can be changed in the app settings. Hide8 also provides a photo viewer, music player, and video player, file and document launcher.

Features:

	File encryption and decryption functionality.
	Encrypted files are hidden to other applications.
	Users can change the vault’s location.
	App disguised behind a fully functional Calculator app.
	User friendly User’s interface.
	Application’s theme selection.
	Wide range of supported file types.
	Real-time encryption/ decryption and hide/un-hide.
	Activation key and Pin protected.
	Browse encrypted files.

•	Briefly defines the different properties of the chemicals
•	Briefly defines the different element groups
•	Includes a guide that shows the components of the periodic table

Name: Mario vs. Bowser

Bowser has 5 lives, and player has to tap him 5 times to give Bowser a damage so to defeat Bowser, player will have to tap on Bowser 25 times. Player wins if  Bowser dies before Mario dies.

Name: Super Mario Memory
Description: This game is memory matching game. From the main menu, tap on the number of cards that you want to play with, and when the game starts, match two of the same cards by flipping the cards. Name: Mario Adventure
Description: Tap on the screen to start the game. When you start the game, Mario will fall straight down so make sure there is a white platform right under him. If you tap on the screen while Mario is on the platform, Mario will jump, so continue to do so in order to keep Mario on the platform. If Mario falls from moving platforms, Mario will lose life, and if Mario loses 3 lives, the game is over.

Name: Luigi Adventure

Name: Fruit Puzzle

By swiping the bottom of the screen and touching on the setting, th player can turn the music on and off.

Name: Pokemon Alkaloid

The player has 5 lives and 1 life will be lost if the player misses the ball with the bar.

Name: Poke-Catch

Name: Super Mario Kart

Name: Google Index Search
Description:
Google Index Search provides a way to search the Google's Indexes to find the file you want. 
 
Google periodically indexes files of almost all types, including Mp3s, PDFs, and MKVs.  And these indexes are one of the easiest places to quickly find an endless quantity of freely downloadable files.  This is app helps you search those indexes. All you need to do is enter the file name you are looking for and its file type.

Uses of the app:
- Quickly find the freely downloadable movies, music and other cool stuff.
- Narrow your results by providing the appropriate file type.

Name: Tomb Hunter
Description: Who can forget the unlimited hours spent trying to navigate through the maze? Tomb Hunter is optimized for Windows Phone 7, but its exhilaration and addictiveness are still there! Tomb Hunter,  using the standard flick-to-change-directions method, features amazing graphics, well designed mazes and delicate animations.  Steer your hunter through a world full of evil ghosts and splendid jewels. Outsmart the ghosts to eat all the dots for advancing to the next level. Try to complete the map in a minimum amount of time. The game promises action filled 80 stages that would keep you countless fun! Once you start playing, you won't be able to stop!

Name: Tetris 8
Description: Tetris 8 is a tribute to the classic with award-winning gameplay. This is "the must have puzzle game" of the marketplace. Survive as long as possible by sorting falling blocks in lines. The more lines you create, the more points you get! If the line reaches the top the game is over. Increasing the difficulty level provides entertainment for everyone. Compete with your friends in the online leaderboards, and get the highest score you can. Immerse yourself in a game of colored blocks and relax listening to groovy music! Test your wits and reflexes!

Description:
To jest gra kółko i krzyżyk. Dostępnych jest do wyboru kilku graczy komputerowych (domyślny jest gracz losowy) oraz możliwość gry człowieka z człowiekiem lub komputera z komputerem.
Historię gry można opublikować z aplikacji. W ustawieniach można regulować czy gracze komputerowi zawsze będą się tak samo zachowywać.

Name: Symulator bukmacherski
Description:
Ta aplikacja to program, który symuluje stawianie zakładów u bukmachera. Gra polega na obstawianiu poszczególnych wyników losowań (o szacowanym prawdopodobieństwie).

Możesz udostępniać aktualną historię gry do innych aplikacji (np. aby wysłać je mailem) lub zrobić z nimi cokolwiek zechcesz. W ustawieniach możesz regulować parametry gry.
Możesz przeszukiwać swoją historię gry.

Zaprezentowany jest przykładowy system gry u bukmachera polegający na stawianiu kolejnych liczb zmodyfikowanego ciągu Fibonacciego, aż dojdzie do wygranej.

Name: Tabela pierwiastków
Description:
Ta aplikacja to układ okresowy.
Aplikacja umożliwia wyszukiwanie pierwiastka.
W polu 'Pokazywana informacja' możesz wybrać, jaki szczegół danego pierwiastka ma być wyświetlany w tabeli (np. czy chcesz oglądać masę pierwiastka, czy jego konfigurację elektronową). Przy wybraniu niektórych szczegółów ikony pierwiastków zostaną pokolorowane, możesz wyłączyć tę opcję w ustawieniach.
W ustawieniach możesz też regulować, czy chcesz widzieć grupy w postaci 1, 2, ... czy IA, IIA, ...
Możesz publikować widziane przez siebie informacje do innych aplikacji, np. gdy widzisz szczegóły danego pierwiastka, możesz je udostępnić np. żeby wysłać je mailem.

Name: Nauka obliczeń
Description:
Ta aplikacja pomaga trenować podstawowe operacje matematyczne: dodawanie, odejmowanie, mnożenie, dzielenie. W ustawieniach można regulować którą.
Można publikować historię gry z tej aplikacji do innej oraz można przeszukiwać historię gry.

Name: Bloki
Description: Gra bloki polega na układaniu spadających bloków. Można regulować szybkość spadania klocków w ustawieniach.

Name: Gra memo
Description: Gra logiczna memo, ćwiczy pamięć.

Name: Stoper czasowy
Description:
Ta aplikacja to stoper, który posiada opcje zapisu kolejnych okrążeń.
Posiada opcje regulacji rozdzielczości wyświetlania czasu, co może zaoszczędzić baterii, bez wpływu na dokładność zapisu okrążeń. 
Możesz udostępniać aktualnie zmierzony czas i czasy poszczególnych okrążeń do innych aplikacji (np. aby wysłać je mailem) lub zrobić z nimi cokolwiek zechcesz. W ustawieniach możesz regulować czy chcesz udostępniać aktualnie zmierzony czas i czasy okrążeń, czy tylko zmierzony czas. Oraz czy tekst ma być sformatowany (ładny), czy prosty.
Możesz wyszukać czas określonego okrążenia, np. gdy chcesz znaleść czas 8 okrążenia wpisujesz w wyszukiwaniu #8, możesz także wprowadzać do wyszukiwania czas i zostanie znalezione okrążenie. Wyszukianie możesz rozpocząć naciskając dowolny klawisz.

Name: Gra układanka
Description:
To jest aplikacja układanka. Możesz w niej układać różne obrazki. W opcjach jest możliwość regulacji rozmiaru planszy, oraz tego jak bardzo obrazek będzie pomieszany.
Możesz opublikować osiągnięty wynik do innych aplikacji.
Jest opcja ładowania obrazków z dysku, znajduje się ona po prawej w pasku aplikacji (appbar).

Name: Gra saper
Description:
Ta aplikacja to gra saper, polegająca na odnajdywaniu min.
Jest możliwość zmiany ustawień gry (wielkość planszy, ilość min). Możesz opublikować aktualny stan mapy do innych aplikacji.
Aby przybliżyć mapę korzystając z kółka myszki należy przy tym przycisnąć Ctrl.

Name: Memo List
Description:
Memo List is a client for a popular task management service - Remember The Milk. Memo List helps you to keep track on your tasks, either personal or working.  Achieve your goals and get things done with Memo List!
Simply define your tasks and easily manage them using the dashboard. Be ready to finish all your tasks by their due date!
All tasks are colored according to their priority, so that you can recognize in the blink of an eye.

Name: Windows 8 お役立ち記事リンク

Name: Globus Sommelier
Description: Nyní si nemusíte na nákup do prodejen Globus brát s sebou sommeliera. Máte jej přímo ve Vašem telefonu či tabletu. Aplikace Globus Sommelier je pomocníkem při výběru vína a při volbě správného pokrmu nebo sýru k němu. Vybrali jsme 130 vín z naší stálé nabídky i z nabídky Vinotéky Globus, která degustoval a hodnotil špičkový sommelier a jeho hodnocení ke každému z vín naleznete právě v této aplikaci. Protože víno a pokrmy k sobě patří, ke každému vínu připravil šéfkuchař na doporučení sommeliera recept na pokrm, který se chuťově s daným vínem snoubí. Sommeliér navíc vybral ka každému vínu vhodný sýr nebo typ sýra pokud nehodláte zrovna vařit. U každého z vín naleznete také návod na jeho servis. Vína, pokrmy a sýry v aplikaci budeme v průběhu roku aktualizovat a můžete se tak těšit na další chuťové zážitky.

Name: Flappy Bird
Description:
--NO.1 Flappy Bird FOR WINDOWS 8--
Extremely addictive and challenging game that will take you for a spin with your patience and focus. It will not rest until all your fingers are tired of tapping. 

Challenge yourself for how much you can score. 

Choose from multiple themes.

Play across the scrolling landscape to score the highest score possible. Try to beat your own score.

Name: Shuffle Party
Description: Shuffle Party is back for Windows 8!  Compete in various shuffleboard games using your Xbox Avatar!  Featuring Bowling, the standard bowling game played on a shuffleboard table; League Bowling, where players bowl in weekly tournaments against other Xbox Live users; Challenge Mode, get the best score possible while faced with obstacles such as bumpers, ramps, gates, and portals; Shuffleboard, the classic table game - try to get as close to the score zones without falling off the table; and Pass & Play, a two-player version of shuffleboard where you and a friend take turns by passing the device.  Earn cash in all game modes to buy new Pro Shop items, such as pucks, pins, tables, and table frames!  Earn Xbox achievements, and get bragging rights when you earn the top spot on leaderboards.

Name: La Gestión de la Actitud
Description:
En este libro de gestión en español, centrado principalmente en el ámbito laboral, aunque perfectamente extrapolable a las relaciones sociales y familiares, Manuel Giraudier, experto consultor en relaciones humanas, expone de forma clara y práctica, cómo podemos guiar y gestionar grupos humanos. A través de su explicación y con sus diversos  ejemplos, el autor nos muestra el papel fundamental de la motivación en el trabajo, la necesidad de recompensar las acciones de nuestros colaboradores o el papel de la Inteligencia Emocional en nuestros actos. Todo ello con el fin de mejorar la comunicación y el clima laboral.

Este libro contiene los siguientes temas.

- A título de introducción
- Liderando
- En virtud de un refuerzo
- Confirmar y reafirmar cambios
- Pensamiento creativo
- Conclusiones
- Apéndice: Guía de auto valoración

El éxito de las empresas está basado en las características intrínsecas de nuestros colaboradores. Gestionando su actitud y potenciando esas características, obtendremos nuevos y renovados resultados, aumentando nuestros beneficios.

En este ebook de desarrollo profesional, Manuel Giraudier nos presenta las claves para gestionar nuestra actitud con el fin de generar equipo con las personas que nos rodean y crear un clima de confianza, consiguiendo así una gestión más eficaz.

Name: Persuasión
Description: El señor de Kellynch Hall en Somersetshire, Sir Walter Elliot, era un hombre que no hallaba entretención en la lectura salvo que se tratase de la Crónica de los baronets. Con ese libro hacía llevaderas sus horas de ocio y se sentía consolado en las de abatimiento. Su alma desbordaba admiración y respeto al detenerse en lo poco que quedaba de los antiguos privilegios, y cualquier sensación desagradable surgida de las trivialidades de la vida doméstica se le convertía en lástima y desprecio. Así, recorría la lista casi interminable de los títulos concedidos en el último siglo, y allí, aunque no le interesaran demasiado las otras páginas, podía leer con ilusión siempre viva su propia historia. La página en la que invariablemente estaba abierto su libro decía...
