Cualquier información enviarla al correo electrónico que encontraran dentro de la Aplicación

Name: Seguro Social
Description: Aplicación sencilla y rápida para visualizar la Cuenta Individual y la Pensión en el Seguro Social de Venezuela

Name: El Blog Guillermo Taylor
Description: Este es un Blog destinado a comunicar aspectos de tecnología Microsoft para la región Andina, en general.  Usualmente compartiré con ustedes temas relacionados con tecnología, algunos temas de carácter humorístico y noticias relacionadas con comunidades de IT Pros en nuestra región.

Name: Guillermo Taylor Blog
Description: Este es un Blog destinado a comunicar aspectos de tecnología Microsoft para la región Andina, en general.  Usualmente compartiré con ustedes temas relacionados con tecnología, algunos temas de carácter humorístico y noticias relacionadas con comunidades de IT Pros en nuestra región.

Name: Bibliotecas ULA
Description:
Es una aplicación ideada para ser una de las principales herramientas del estudiante de la Universidad de Los Andes a la hora de ayudarlo a encontrar sus principales libros, revistas o tesis, en la cual te presenta la ficha de todos los libros que puedas buscar con su respectivo autor, editorial, cota y el nombre de las bibliotecas donde se encuentre disponible.
                                
Motivado a que gran parte de los estudiantes de la Universidad de Los Andes provienen de diferentes partes del país, Bibliotecas ULA, incorpora la versatilidad de poder encontrar la biblioteca que desees y la muestre en un mapa gracias a las funcionalidades del GPS, así como también, incorpora un mapa con todas las principales bibliotecas de la ULA.

Esta aplicación también te ofrece la comodidad de tener varios tipos de búsqueda, bien sea que tengas el autor del libro o solamente el título, y si no tienes nada de esto también los puedes buscar por materia como calculo, física o filosofía, tan simple como esto

Name: Directorio UJGH
Description: Universidad Dr. Jose Gregorio Hernández muestra un directorio informativo sobre esta universidad, sus objetivos, misión, visión, Carreras de pre-grado y diplomados, en ella conocerás todo lo necesario para unirte a esta casa de estudio.

Name: I.U.P "Santiago Mariño"
Description: Esta es una Aplicación diseñada con el Fin de Brindar información a los Estudiante del Politécnico Santiago Mariño de Cabimas, información como, numero de cuentas, carreras, ubicación geográfica entre otros

Name: Mi Evaluación
Description: La aplicación que te ayuda a calcular mejor tus notas, saber cuanto necesitas y cuanto llevas, para asi tener un control completo sobre todas tus asignatuas

Name: Python para todos
Description: Python para todos es el libro en español mas versátil, sencillo y rápido para aprender a programar en el robusto lenguaje de programación interpretado Python. El libro escrito por Raúl González Duque abarca desde las herramientas disponibles para programar usando Python hasta el empaquetado de las mismas aplicaciones. Sumergete en el mundo de la programación en Python y descubre lo versátil y fácil de usar este lenguaje.

Name: Tiempo Global
Description:
Tiempo Global es una aplicación que te ayudará a llevar seguimiento de diferentes tiempos en todo el mundo, incluyendo el tiempo universal UTC, tu hora local, la de tu sistema ¡y cualquier otra zona horaria que tu quieras!
Para tener una hora más precisa, Tiempo Global se conecta con un servicio de tiempo por Internet de una manera confiable y constante. Si en un momento dado no cuentas con Internet no hay problema, tus relojes se muestran a partir de cálculos basados en la hora de tu sistema, dependerá de tu configuración de hora pero igualmente te dará una idea cercana a la hora del país que quieras ver.
Además, Tiempo Global cuenta con un calculador de tiempo, donde podrás anticiparte si quieres anotar reuniones o eventos que están en otro horario, puedes tomar esa hora, y sumarle o restarle la diferencia de horarios UTC y obtendrás la hora en tu país por ejemplo, además que también puedes saber cuánta distancia de tiempo hay de una hora a otra.

Name: Registro Electoral
Description: Aplicación que permite la busqueda por medio de la Cedula de Identidad en la Base Datos del Registro Electoral (CNE) de Venezuela, es sencilla y facil de entender.

Name: Quiero un taxi
Description: Esta aplicación tiene como finalidad obtener tu posición actual para hacer el calculo correspondiente y luego de esto informarle al usuario la línea de taxi mas cercana, así como también ofrecerte un listado de líneas de taxis disponibles a nivel del estado Tachira-Venezuela

Name: Pagos Al Dia
Description:
Es una aplicación que te permite tener todos tus pagos de manera organizada en un solo lugar. Es sencillo, agrega tus pagos y no volveras a tener que buscar en varios papeles o cuentas donde se encuentra cada uno de ellos.

Pagos al dia tambien permite conectarte a internet con el fin de que puedas ir a la pagina donde manejas el pago que seleccionaste en un instante.

Name: Calculadora de Salario
Description: Calculadora que te permite obtener el monto a cobrar por los días trabajados.

Name: Traductor Morse
Description: El Código Morse es un medio de comunicación basado en la transmisión y recepción de mensajes empleando sonidos o rayos de luz, por un alfabeto alfanumérico compuesto de puntos y rayas... la APP traductor morse se basa en esto para facilitarte la forma de traducir texto normal a este alfabeto y viceversa, con ella podrás aprender y descubrir, nunca esta demás el conocimiento, el saber cosas que en cuanto a sobrevivencia serian fundamentales para poder enviar mensajes en ambientes hostiles.

Name: Study Assistant
Description: Study Assistant es una aplicación que te ayudará en tus estudios llevando el promedio de tus notas separadas por las materias que tú selecciones. También cuenta con una agenda donde podrás anotar las próximas evaluaciones que tengas pendientes y te avisará el día anterior con notificaciones para que puedas estudiar y prepararte a tiempo. Cuando la evaluación pendiente ya la hayas presentado y tengas tu nota puedes fácilmente marcarla como hecha y seleccionar la nota recibida y la materia a la que pertenece ¡Así de fácil!

Name: Guia Cubo Rubik's
Description:
¿No sabes como jugar? ¿Cómo armar un cubo rubik? pues ya no le cambies 
las pegatinas al cubo ya que  esta es la aplicación indicada, te mostraremos 
como hacerlo a través de esta guia dinámica y podrás armar el cubo y consta 
de solo 7 pasos básicos, es el juego de rompecabezas más vendido del mundo.

Name: John Katzenbach Bio
Description: John Katzenbach Bio es una aplicación diseñada para dar a conocer la vida y obra del autor norteamericano John Katzenbach. Su vida, sus obras, las adaptaciones que ha llevado al cine y mucho más te encontraras en esta fascinante aplicación con el único propósito de engancharte con este fenomenal autor de novela policiaca.

Name: Banderas Estatales de Venezuela
Description: Aplicación sencilla que detalla y muestra cada una de las Banderas de Venezuela y te dice el significado de ella.

Name: Pohádky
Description: V pohádkové aplikaci od Streamu čekají na vás a vaše nejmenší oblíbené příběhy večerníčkových hrdinů, ukolébavky v podání známých osobností nebo třeba Vychytávečky, tvořivá dílnička podporující dětskou kreativitu. Vše si můžete stáhnout a dívat se i bez připojení k internetu. Pohádková dobrodružství se neokoukají, protože jejich nabídku pravidelně obměňujeme.

Name: Seznam.cz Hledání
Description: Seznam.cz search application for Windows 8. Easy and fast. Try it!

Name: Stream.cz
Description:
Originální pořady internetové televize Stream.cz si teď pustíte, ať jste kdekoli.

Oblíbené pořady si můžete stáhnout a pak je sledovat i bez připojení k internetu. 
Pořady, které označíte jako oblíbené, máte vždy po ruce v jedné záložce. 
Můžete si také zapnout titulky a podle rychlosti internetu volit kvalitu přehrávaných videí.

Name: ČT24
Description:
Aplikace nabízí neustálý přehled aktuálních článků portálu ČT24 a živé vysílání zpravodajské stanice ČT24 pro Váš telefon.

Aplikace nabízí:
- Živé vysílání zpravodajského ČT24
- Okamžitý přehled článků
- Články řazené do tématických kategorií
- Možnost odeslání článku emailem.

Obsah poskytuje portál www.ct24.cz.

Aplikaci pro ČT vyvinul Mobildrive.cz

Name: Evropa 2
Description:
Rádio Evropa 2 nabízí nejlepší hudební mix poskládaný z těch nejaktuálnějších hitů světových i domácích hitparád novinek. Evropa 2 je moderní rádio (nejen) pro mladé a dynamické lidi, kteří mají rádi muziku, sport, filmy, módu… Zkrátka vše, co souvisí a moderním a aktivním životním stylem. 

Program rádia nabízí mj. bezkonkurenční Ranní show, kterou každý všední den moderují Leoš Mareš, Patrik Hezucký a Lucie Šilhánová, po které následuje Afterparty Libora Boučka, ve které se setkáte například i s fenomenální rubrikou Mrázek ústředna.

Evropa 2 neukládá žádné informace, které v době běhu stahuje z internetu z adres www.evropa2.cz.

Name: Jetpack Joyride
Description:
Suit up with a selection of the coolest jetpacks ever made and take to the skies as Barry Steakfries, the lovable hero on a one-way trip to adventure! Join Barry as he breaks in to a secret laboratory to commandeer the experimental jetpacks from the clutches of science evildoers. Rain bullets, bubbles, rainbows and lasers downwards as you fly towards higher and higher scores!

Along the way you’ll collect coins, vehicles, powerups and more, all of which can be upgraded and customized in the Stash. Want to dress up like a ninja? Paint your Profit Bird gold? Grab your robot pal Flash to come along for the ride? The choice is yours! 

Stay alive, get funky and lose yourself in Jetpack Joyride. There's so much to see and do, all the time in the world and more than enough jetpacks! As always, Barry Steakfries will provide!

****

IMPORTANT NOTICE TO PARENTS

This game may contain:

- The ability to make optional in-app purchases using real money.
- Links to external social networking sites intended for users over the age of 13.
- Direct links to the internet which may open the default web browser on your device.

Privacy Policy: http://www.halfbrick.com/pp
Terms of Service: http://www.halfbrick.com/tos

Name: Toca Life: School
Description:
Grab your backpack— it’s time for Toca Life: School! Teach a class, pick a locker and have a food fight in the cafeteria! With five locations and 34 characters, you can create your very own school adventures!

INTRODUCING TOCA LIFE
Thanks to the outpouring of ideas from kids all over the world we created Toca Life — a series of apps that gives you an even bigger world of everyday fun. Toca Life: Town and Toca Life: City are our first apps in the series; now we’re excited to introduce Toca Life: School!

EXPLORE
Toca Life: School has five unique locations for telling stories about life at school. Head out to the playground and coach a basketball team, conduct a science experiment in the classroom and jam with your band in the youth club! All characters, and anything they are holding, can easily be moved between locations.

HIDDEN TREASURES
Wear funny costumes and throw a party. Mix colorful liquids in the chem lab, climb a tree and play hide-and-seek. Looking for some after-school fun? The youth club is always open for fun activities like pool, ping-pong or playing instruments.

LIFE WEEKLY
There are treasures hidden everywhere in Toca Life: School, and with our free in-app content channel it’s easy to find out about them! Located in the top right corner of the start screen, Life Weekly updates every Thursday and gives you fun insights into the whole world of Toca Life!

RECORD
Use the in-app recording feature to record your story! Exclusive to the Toca Life series, the recording feature will help you share the stories you create. By recording sound and screen you’ll be able to save an up to two minutes long video to your camera roll!

We received a ton of requests from you and decide to make a school for Toca Life! We want to keep hearing your thoughts so don’t be shy and keep on suggesting! What do you want to see next? Share your ideas with @tocaboca on Instagram & YouTube!

Name: Toca Life: City
Description:
Welcome to Toca Life: City, a metropolis filled with everyday fun! Customize characters, explore exciting locations and find hidden treasures — there’s something in every corner! 


INTRODUCING TOCA LIFE
Thanks to the great response to Toca Town, we're bringing you Toca Life — a series of apps that gives you an even bigger world of everyday fun. First out in the series is Toca Life: Town and Toca Life: City!

CREATE
Try, experiment and customize. It’s time to get creative in Toca Life: City! Change outfits, dye your hair any color and switch hairstyles in the Hair 3000! There are millions of ways to personalize the characters — we dare you to create them all.

EXPLORE 
Say hi to 6 locations and 34 characters! Go shopping at the mall, grab a bite to eat at the food park or invite friends over to your loft. Characters, and anything they are holding, can easily be transported between locations. 

DISCOVER
There are treasures hidden everywhere in the City, and with Life Weekly it’s easy to find out about them. Located in the top right corner on the start screen, this feature gives you fun insights in the world of Toca Life: City!

RECORD
Record and play with the new recording feature! Create stories and record, save the video to your camera roll before sharing with your friends. What are your friends in Toca Life: City doing today? You decide!

WE LISTEN
Toca Life: City was uniquely created for you by you. We received over 10,000 feature requests after Toca Town was released, which we added directly into this app. We want to keep hearing from you so don’t be shy and keep on suggesting! What do you want to see next? Share your ideas with @tocaboca on Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest and Instagram!

Name: Toca Life: Vacation
Description:
Make every day a vacation adventure! Feel the excitement of going through the airport to catch your flight. Jumping on a hotel bed. Digging for treasure on the beach. Create all the vacation fun you want with Toca Life: Vacation!

EXPLORE
With four locations to explore in Toca Life: Vacation, you’ll never run out of ideas for your stories. Want to start your adventure at the airport? Have fun with the X-ray machine, board the plane and visit the cockpit. Then get a snack and enjoy your flight! At your destination, you have many choices for activities: shopping and sightseeing on the boardwalk, playing at the beach and surfing in the ocean and exploring the hotel.

DISCOVER
You’ll find lots of surprises throughout Toca Life: Vacation. Find out who inhabits the seafloor, open a secret compartment, uncover buried treasures and investigate a very mysterious-looking statue.

RECORD YOUR STORY
Use the in-app recording feature to create an original video! This feature records your voice as you’re telling the story, along with your characters’ movements. Create vacation videos up two minutes long and save them to your camera roll to share later!

GET THE INSIDE SCOOP
Don’t miss Life Weekly! This is your source for hilarious videos, insider tips and awesome fan art. Located in the top right corner of the start screen, this free feature updates every week to give you fun insights into the whole world of Toca Life!

WE LISTEN
You wanted a vacation app, you got it! We loved your suggestions for a hotel, beach and airport, so keep those ideas coming! What do you want to see next in the Toca Life series? Share your suggestions by submitting a review, or share them with @tocaboca on Instagram & YouTube!

Name: Toca Kitchen 2
Description:
The wildly popular Toca Kitchen is back! With new guests to cook for, more tools to play with and new food combinations to test out, Toca Kitchen 2 invites all chefs to get messy and start playing!

GET CREATIVE
Who said dishes have to be pretty and tasty? In Toca Kitchen 2 you can cook however you want! Juice tomatoes, boil the salad or make a burger. Come up with your very own recipes and treat your guests to something special.

MAKE A MESS
With six different kitchen tools to choose from, you have the perfect setup for preparing fun foods! Load up with your favorite ingredients, add a squeeze of messiness and finish off with a pinch of weirdness. Time to let your guest have a bite! Was it a winner?

WATCH THEIR REACTIONS
Discover your guests’ preferences by watching their reactions. Oven-baked fish head with fried leftovers and lettuce juice coming right up! Oh, they didn’t like it? Try adding some salt. It’s fun to get the “ew”!

We added a whole lot of fun stuff! You can now enjoy cooking:

New foods!
- Chicken
- Prawn
- Pineapple
- Corn
- Peach
- Strawberry
- Watermelon 
- Onion
- Octupus leg
- Spaghetti
- Rice

New condiments!
- Ketchup
- Dressing
- Soy

Watch the characters react on burning hot sauce, sour lemon and laugh at loud burps.

At last but not least, we added more levels of grossness to the characters. Have fun!

Name: Crossy Road
Description:
Join over 100 MILLION players worldwide and experience Hipster Whale's massive viral #1 hit!

“A smorgasbord of vibrant, rewarding moments” - Gamezebo 
“You can play it for two minutes or two hours and love every second of it” - Time 
"Just pure love and frustration, in equal doses" - Polygon

Why did the Chicken cross the road?
Why did the Pigeon leave THAT there?
Why did Specimen 115 abduct that cow?
Why did Unihorse eat all that candy?

FEATURES:
 - Collect retro-styled, pop art inspired characters 
 - Cross roads, train tracks, and rivers – endlessly hop forever 
- Simple, pure, innovative gameplay 
 - Free to play

Crossy Road is completely free to play but some in-game items such as characters, can be purchased with hard currency. Characters are priced between $0.99 and $3.99. 

Have any problems or suggestions? You can reach us at gpsupport@yodo1.com.

Name: Pork N Wings
Description: Help Porky through the obstacles to get the highest points possible.  Don't hit the bacon or the mud or you'll get hammed!!!

Name: Top 10 Chinese Recipes
Description: Top 10 Chinese recipes gives you a selection of mouthwatering dishes to make in your own home at your leisure.

Name: Top 10 French Recipes
Description: French cuisine is renowned around the world. However there are two sides to it, the haute cuisine of the fancy restaurants and the tasty yet simple rural French cuisine. Our top 10 is a mix of the two, with simple, easy to follow recipes.

Name: Top 10 Dessert Recipes
Description: Everyone loves desserts, especially those we remember from our schooldays, here are a top 10 selection some with an added twist.

Name: Top 10 Russian Recipes
Description: Top 10 Russian Recipes includes delights such as Blinis and Beef Stroganoff, each with a simple to follow recipe.

Name: Top 10 Chicken Recipes
Description: Everyone loves chicken, from spicy curries to southern fried. Here are our 10 favourite recipes for chicken, with easy to follow instructions.

Name: Top 10 Crockpot Recipes
Description: The crockpot is a great time saver and a great way to make good food easily, here are the top 10 recipes, great for throwing in the pot before you leave for work.

Name: Top 10 Middle Eastern Recipes
Description: Middle Eastern cuisine has been a source of innovation for other cultures for hundreds of years. If you have never had the opportunity to sample the delights of a Persian restaurant, try some of these easy to follow recipes and give your taste buds a treat.

Name: Top 10 Pork Recipes
Description: From around the world the top 10 pork based recipes with easy to follow instructions.

Name: Top 10 Pasta Recipes
Description: While primarily Western, pasta is enjoyed around the world, easy to prepare and cook, it is fast, simple and tasty, while dishes are scalable to any size of occasion

Name: Top 10 African Recipes
Description: Our top 10 African recipes is a real sampler of the food from Africa. Each recipe carefully checked and easy to make at home.

Name: Kidz Cooking
Description: Healthy eating is important for kids, and so is making great food for them to eat. Kidz Cooking brings you the top 10 most requested meals from our nurseries, with recipes for you to make at home. Look out for regular updates and additions.

Name: Top 10 Swedish Recipes
Description: Swedish cuisine has been made famous by IKEA, but good though they are, there is more to Sweden than meatballs. Here are the 10 best Swedish recipes with simple to follow instructions (and yes we did include meatballs)

Name: Top 10 Korean Recipes
Description: When someone says Korean food, do you instantly think of Kimchi? Well, we have a recipe for that, and a whole bunch of other easy to make dishes.

Name: Top 10 Great British Recipes
Description: British cooking is filled with deep flavours and uses a many different styles, here are 10 of the best traditional recipes

Name: Top 10 Dutch Recipes
Description: Dutch food is a cosmopolitan melting pot, perhaps more so than other country in Europe. The food is tasty, and would almost qualify as true comfort food.

Name: Top 10 Moroccan Recipes
Description: Moroccan cuisine has been refined over hundreds of years and has even developed some of it's own special cookware - notably the tagine. Here are 10 easy to follow great tasting Moroccan recipes for you to try at home.

Name: Top 10 Thai Recipes
Description: Thai food is renowned around the world for its spicy flavours. Our top 10 recipes are no exception, with green, red and yellow curries as well as Pad Thai and Spicy FishCakes

Name: Top 10 South American Recipes
Description: South American food varies widely with many different styles to Europe and North America. Here are 10 recipes to introduce you to South American Cuisine, that are simple to make and tasty to eat.

Name: Top 10 Tray Bake Recipes
Description: Traybakes are like normal cakes, only bigger Easier to cut and portion. The top 10 traybakes shown here are easy to cook, tasty to eat and hard to share!

Name: Top 10 Burger Recipes
Description: Burgers are eaten all over the world, and come in all sizes shapes and flavours, here are 10 of the best for to cook and try

Name: Top 10 Lamb Recipes
Description: Lamb is tasty and tender, traditionally eaten in the springtime, here are 10 great recipes that will make you want to extend that window of eating.

Name: Top 10 Italian Recipes
Description: Wonderfully tasty and wonderfully simple to cook, Italian food is some of the best in the World and these are 10 of the best recipes.

Name: Top 10 Cookie Recipes
Description: 10 of the top cookie recipes, complete with step by step instructions. Also contains US ingredient additions

Name: Top 10 Polish Recipes
Description: The Top 10 Polish Recipes, with easy to follow instructions. Whether you are tracing your heritage or simply want to try something new and tasty, this is for you.

Name: Top 10 Fish Recipes
Description:
With water covering two thirds of the planet there is little wonder that so much fish is eaten and that there are so many great recipes.

Here are 10 of favourites, all with easy to follow instructions.

Name: Top 10 Vegetarian Recipes
Description: Vegetarian food, needn't be bland and tasteless, this top 10 brings you mouthwatering meals that are healthy and tasty

Name: Top 10 Japanese Recipes
Description: Japanese cuisine is often understated, the subtle flavours and textures make a delightful change. The recipes in this app are simple to make and as always tasty.

Name: Top 10 Cake Recipes
Description: Cakes, lemon, chocolate, carrot, all your favourites with easy to follow recipes

Name: Top 10 Swiss Recipes
Description: Switzerland is famous for dairy products and in particular it's cheese and chocolate. Our top 10 Swiss Recipes feature these 2 ingredients heavily, and as always are simple to cook and enjoy.

Name: Top 10 Greek Recipes
Description: The top 10 recipes for cooking Greek style with easy to follow instructions

Name: Top 10 German Recipes
Description: German food is like most Northern European cuisine, hearty and full of flavor. These recipes will give an introduction to the tastes of Germany.

Name: Top 10 Comfort Food Recipes
Description: Comfort food - not necessarily the most healthy, but certainly the tastiest. Memories of bygone days, good wholesome food, here are 10 of the best recipes, quick and simple to make and in some cases messy!

Name: Top 10 Indian Recipes
Description: Indian food is a staple of the takeaway market in the UK, here is your chance to have a go at making your own food - be in control of the spice level.

Name: Top 10 Spanish Recipes
Description: Spanish cooking is renowned for it's flavor and exciting use of spices. Here is a combination of main dishes and tapas to make your mouth water

Name: Top 10 Beef Recipes
Description: Most European and American countries eat beef, here our top 10 favourite beef recipes, simple to cook and oh so tasty.

Name: Top 10 Soup Recipes
Description: Great recipes, for great soups, from the classic French Onion and Gazpacho to the comfort food hero - chicken noodle

Name: Top 10 American Recipes
Description: American food is a mixing pot of different cultures and tastes, here are 10 favourite American recipes.

Name: Z?DDLES
Description: Z?DDLES is an intense mind game created to completely work out your logical side. Answer riddles accompanied by pictures and finish the game.

Name: Atom Add
Description:
Atom Add is a game about the periodic table of elements. This game is created to aid people in memorizing the atomic number of the elements as well as the elements in the periodic table. It includes element 1 to element 109.

Developer: Jonas Jude C. Antonio
Designer: Joanna Rizza W. Bernardino

Name: RoadFloodPH
Description: RoadFloodPH is a visual monitoring app for flooded roads in the Philippines. With the help of monitoring sensors and devices implemented on roads and the its owner made data available for public viewing, the user may view the current road flood status on that certain location. The representative vehicles, a picture of human body, and the official MMDA road flood gauge are used as visual-aids for road flood monitoring.

Name: NutriLoco
Description:
Do you think you already know
all of the nutrient content of your food?
Put that knowledge to the test with 
this challenging quiz app.

Name: Mr. Stache
Description: "As the most macho man in the city, you must defend it at all costs! Punch, kick, and uppercut falling objects! Defend the city as long as you can!"

Name: Enigma
Description:
Enigma is a 3D action educational RPG which lets the players assume the role of Baconawa Agbayani as he tries to unravel the baffling events on his homeland and the mystery surrounding the magical grimoire, Enigma. Battle it out with the popular and classic monsters from Philippines lower mythology!

Game Controls:
W - move forward
A - rotate counter-clockwise
S - move backward
D - rotate-clockwise
Tab - attack stance
Q - normal stance
Mouse1 - attack
Spacebar - dodge
Esc - pause
I - inventory
C - compendium
E - interact to NPC/portal/save


Limitation: app doesn't fully support touch features but fully support keyboard and mouse features only.

Best played in full view.

Developed by:
Rejev Edward Mediodia
John Jethro Ganzon
Arvin Joseph Bernardo
Lito Labor Jr.

Name: Garden Wizard
Description:
Garden Wizard is a 5 question trivia quiz about plants.

Developers Name: James Bernard Gabriel, Juanito Calayag Jr.

Name: Calorie Tracker
Description: Many people are conscious of their figures. To keep track of daily calorie intake is one of the ways to help maintain body figure. Through Calorie Tracker, move one step forward toward your desired figure!

Name: Galaxy Adventure (GA)
Description: Survival Space Shooter Game.

Name: Cooking with a Heart: Italy
Description: Taste the delicious foods of Italy. An Italian dish brings out the flavor cook then arranges the food so that its shapes and colors are combined in the most attractive way possible.

Name: Game Analyzer
Description:
An app designed for sports enthusiast. Sports like basketball, volleyball etc. and today’s generation where e-sport is getting big, this app is the right for you. In this app, you can observe your team’s current standings and performance and can compare with other teams and to further improve in other aspects.  

How To:

All controls is access in the app bar(right click to show).

First app control is for you to choose a shape (Diamond  with 4 factors, Pentagon with 5 factors, hexagon with 6 factors).

Add control is to add a team into the pool collection.

Name: Todays Cartoon
Description:
This game was developed to learn/familiarize some of the cartoon characters.
Have fun identifying the words.

How to Play
Start a New Game
Wait for the Words to Load
Click on one of the four Words
You will get points if you clicked the correct word

Name: Movie Quiz Game
Description:
This game was developed to learn/familiarize the recent popular movies.
Have fun identifying the words.

Name: BroShooter
Description:
BroShooter, a game where Broccolis tries to take over the kitchen. Be the Blender who saves the day, shoot shurikens to stop the evil broccolis.
Save the kitchen, Save the world!

A game where you can relax your mind and have fun at the same time.

Be addicted to BroShooter!

Name: BlackRockShooter
Description:
Black Rock Shooter is a clicking game that test your eye and hand coordination. 

Support Email: idropforyou@live.com

Developer's name: James Bernard S. Gabriel

Name: Fitness Quiz
Description: This app about health physically and mentally by testing your broad knowledge in body building.

Name: Hunger Games Quiz
Description: This app is a quiz game about hunger game based from the book and film: The hunger games, mockingjay, and catching fire.

Name: mindHub
Description:
mindHub is an idea collaborator application aims to hear the thoughts of Windows 8/8.1 and Windows Phone consumers.

Indietro nella vostra cucina... you make a meal that your friends and family will be talking about (in a good way) for at least the next few generations. And what would a .B-APP be without stunning photos? .B-APPs founder and world renowned food photographer Günter Beer has taken over 500 gorgeous photos just for this app. These photos allow you the user to be in the kitchen learning the secrets of Italian cooking, step by step and up close and personal. He made numerous recordings of complete operas and individual arias, gaining worldwide fame for the brilliance and beauty of his tone—especially into the upper register—and eventually established himself as one of the finest tenors of the 20th century. As one of The Three Tenors, Pavarotti became well known for his televised concerts and media appearances. From the beginning of his professional career as a tenor in 1961 in Italy to his final performance of "Nessun dorma" at the 2006 Winter Olympics in Turin,[3] Luciano Pavarotti was at his best in bel canto operas, pre-Aida Verdi roles and Puccini works such as La bohème, Tosca, and Madama Butterfly. Pavarotti was also noted for his charity work on behalf of refugees and the Red Cross, amongst others. He died from pancreatic cancer on 6 September 2007.

Name: Kids Summer Camp Party Dress up
Description:
These Sweet Baby Girls are going to Summer Camp, Make it one that they remember!

Join Emma, Olivia, and, Sophia, calling themselves the baby girls, on their grand adventures at the summer camp! Be a part of their fun as they go through the daily various camp related activities throughout the day with each other. 

Begin the day by getting the girls ready for the day by playing an interactive dress up game, then you have to make the girls a cold, chilled drink to cool off from the HOT summer sun, and then end the day with a nice s'more topped with some delicious ice cream to give the girls a wonderful night to remember for the whole of the summer camp! 

These sweet baby girls just want to have a lot of fun when enjoying the summer camp together. Help them make the most of their trip by helping them prepare cool drinks with tons of fruits to choose from, dress them up in a big wardrobe full of clothes and accessories, and help them end the day by making a tasty campfire snack! 

The summer camp is full of fun and memorable adventures for the girls to have fun together! 

As the sweet baby girls get ready to have a fun in the sun, they need your help to make sure they have the most fun when going swimming, hiking, and doing many other adventures together as friends!

Name: Cute Baby Panda Doctor Game
Description:
The Baby Panda Doctor is in and he needs your help! 

In a hospital full of many doctors, there is only one animal doctor. Meet the Baby Panda Doctor, he is the only ENT in the hospital who who takes care of the other animals in the hospital.

Name: Super Flight Attendant Girls - Fun Airplane Food Serving Game
Description:
These Air Hostesses Need YOUR Help To Keep The Passengers Entertained! 

Be the best Flight Attendant Girls in the skies! Get these air hostesses ready in only the finest clothes to serve the eager flyers for their next flight. There are plenty of challenges waiting for you, so be ready for a challenge. 

These Sky Girls need to look their absolute best as an air hostess, and they need YOUR help to get there. The airline needs your help in designing the new costumes for the hostesses, and time is very short! 

In order to get these girls ready for the skies and serving customers, you have to make a uniform for them and make sure that it looks amazing! 

As Flight Attendants, you will have to work tirelessly as the proud members of Sky Girls to only deliver quality service to your customers on the plane! 

As an air hostess, you have to dress good and take good care of the airplane and everyone on it during the lengthy flight, you have to serve them drinks, make food, and distribute it to them too, but your job as the attendant too also doesn’t get easier! 

Play interactive games where you have to serve your customers in real-time during flights by giving them food that they ask for. You have many passengers who need your attention, and FAST! 

You have to tap and jump to the next passenger as soon as you are done with the first one, as they will get impatient very quickly! You have to be quick in giving the customers what they want! 

You have to constantly race against the clock to keep the people on the plane happy, as unhappy customers will not be pleased and will easily complain about the poor service. 

You have to work with the other flight attendants on the plane you are on to quickly serve all the passengers who need to be served and fast! To uphold the name of the Sky Girls, you have to be fast on your feet. 

No one ever said that being an air hostess would be an easy job, which is why you will need to do the job of one with a lot of great responsibility. 

As an air hostess you get to travel various parts of the world and enjoying it as your reward for a job well done! 

What are you waiting for? Get on the plane and start your amazing adventure!

Name: Super Rockstar Makeover
Description:
Being a Rockstar isn’t just about having a band, you need to look the part too! 

They have the music, the talent, and even a tour planned, but now they need a stylist girl to help them complete their look! 

The girls have formed their own band, but they are tired of doing small gigs and now want to get on the road and perform for bigger audiences, but they need a stylist to help them get there. 

A fun game for makeup, accessorising, and more! 

-> YOU need to give the whole band a true Rockstar Makeover that will show they are serious about their music! 

-> A fun and interactive girls game that will let you use a number of makeup options such as blush, lipstick, and more to help make your Rockstar look like she belongs! 

-> After you are done with their makeup, you need to give them a proper makeover and get them in the proper wardrobe too as the band's official stylist. 

-> You need to pay special attention to every member of the band, from the singer, to the guitarist, the drummer, and every one in the band! They ALL need a proper makeover to make them look the part. 

-> Give the band the look that you think would fit them! This is a fun girls game that will keep you coming back and trying new looks for your performers. 

Rockstar Makeover is a game that will give you a challenge when it comes to making the girls look good. As their official stylist, the last thing we need is our rock diva’s having too much blush on their face! 

Don’t take the challenge lightly just because this is a game for anyone who wants to be a stylist girl, because every member of the band is counting on you on giving them a killer look!

Name: Kitchen Clean up Deluxe - Clean The House, Dishes & Get Rid Of The Mess
Description:
The Kitchen is a horrible MESS after the party! 😟 Help clean it up the right way. 👈🏻

Taking care of the house is a serious responsibility and helping in the kitchen is even more rewarding. What do you do when there is a big party at your house and you are all alone in fixing the dirtiest part of the house all by yourself? 😰

The entire house is a BIG mess after the party last night. 😫 We need your help to clean up the house  and make it look beautiful again. You will have to give all of your attention to the Kitchen, which is the messiest from the party.  

In Kitchen Clean up, you will have to clean the dishes, fix the walls, and much more! You have to be ready for a LOT of work. 🕐 As you clean the kitchen, you will make a lot of friends who will help you too, so you will have help on your mission. 🙍🏼🙍🏻🙍🏽🙍🏾🙌🏻

You will need a lot of tools to help make cleaning the kitchen easier, and the game will provide you with everything you will need to make your job easier for you. Learn about the important tools and what they do, make sure you don’t overuse anything otherwise you might end up in trouble!🙆🏼🙅🏼

Do your best to prove how responsible you are by cleaning the whole kitchen by yourself. You have to use the right tool for the right job or you might have a bigger problem on your hands! 💆🏻 Successfully handling all of your chores will get you many rewards and let you enjoy the experience of being responsible!

Name: Ex Boyfriend Returns - Cute Fun Dating Game
Description:
Jessica has gone through a tough breakup with her boyfriend, Jason. She is taking it really rough. It has been a long time since she has properly taken care of her looks, and is now a bad mess! 

Help Jessica become beautiful again by giving her a full makeover. She NEEDS to get rid of those ugly clothes and get rid of all those ugly marks on her face from staying indoors for all those months. 

Once you have given her a spa treatment and given her a thorough makeover, you will have to make sure she also looks her best! 

-> Give Jessica a beautiful facial and get rid of those UGLY pimples! 
-> Make her beautiful again, by giving her a full spa treatment. 
-> End the beauty session by dressing her up in the best 

Give her makeup, dress her up and make her feel amazing about herself again. 

The ex boyfriend returns to apologize to Jessica so you have to make sure that she looks ready to take him back.

Name: Cute Movie Date Night
Description:
OMG! Jack just asked Rose out on a second date! He asked her out to the movies this time to live out the best high school love story. Rose has to keep the date a secret though, because all of her party friends don't know she is dating again.

Jack and Rose share a common love for fashion, and thus they call their relationship, a fashion love story! Help dress Jack and Rose in gorgeous clothes for their movie date, but make sure you don't get noticed by Rose's party friends. 

Follow the high school adventures of Jack and Rose, and watch their summer romance begin to blossom as they try to keep the daring secret of their relationship from all their party friends. 

The fashion love story between them is true love after all, so you need to help make sure that the lovely couple get to see their love reach a happily ever after. 

Jack also wants to have an ideal high school love story to remember, so make sure that you give these high school love birds a romantic story to remember! Just as long as the secret of their love doesn't get outed. 

Keep in mind that Jack has also got his party friends to watch out for, so make sure you don't bump into them too at the movie theatre, as he also has to keep this relationship a secret. 

Help Jack live out the fashion love story by giving him the best fashion make over for him and Rose too. 

The couple need to enjoy a memorable night, you will need to make sure that: 

Rose and Jack first have to meet at the meeting point, make sure that you capture the right backdrop for them. 

Help them to get a ticket by making sure they are given the right ticket with a good seat too for their date night and also serve the other couples their tickets too. 

Jack buys his girlfriend a cute souvenir toy from the gift shop. 

Do an interactive seat cleaning game to help get the movie theatre ready for the show. 

Lastly, help Rose with her make up and dress up her boyfriend for the occasion.

Name: Beard Salon - The Barber Shop Game
Description:
Who says only ladies need to get groomed for special occasions. With Valentine Day fast approaching, it is time for the gentlemen to get the best makeover.

Our very own gentleman is confused over how to get ready for the special day. His biggest problem is his beard. He has not been able to take care of it much for some time now. With so less time left, he does not know where to go and get it groomed and look good.

Well, we have the perfect solution. Because we are going to take this gentleman to the Valentine's crazy salon. The salon that deals with all kinds of crazy men and their crazy beard demands.

Here, we will give our gentleman the best makeover for the upcoming special day. We begin the makeover with a refreshing spa. Next, we will trim or cut the beard so it looks all neat and clean. Lastly, we will style it to complete the look of the gentleman.

Now comes the real action. Meet the crazy barber who knows how to deal with any crazy demand, even shave. The barber shop also comes equipped with a variety of tools; all meant to give the best makeover ever. We have a razor blade, electric shavers and clippers to trim any kind of beard.

The barber also helps you select the hairstyle that goes best with your style. Just the choose the style of your liking and the barber will do his magic with the clippers.

Is that all?

Nope. The crazy beard salon has got so much more. Our gentleman needs to spend the special day with date in style. So, we will get him the best outfit and amazing accessories.

Head to the wardrobe, and find the outfit that looks best. Choose from sharp suits to sleek ties to the casuals if that is what the man requires. From the accessories section, find the trendiest sunglasses and hats as well.

When our gentleman is finally ready, it is time to share the makeover we applied. Take screenshots and share with your friends to boast your makeover skills.

The gentleman is finally ready to show up for a date on Valentine's Day.

Name: Deluxe Hijab Make up Salon - Headscarf Beauty Make over Game
Description:
Wearing a hijab can be tough, but looking good in one can be just as challenging. 

Let out your creativity in helping give these girls a look that will help show that beauty isn’t just skin deep, with the help of plenty of choices in cosmetics and other materials, you can help make each girl look their best! 💇🏻  🙆🏼  💆🏻

Help give girls who wear hijab a new look by giving them a variety of makeover options that will bring new life to their face and the hijab that they wear! 🙎🏻

You run a very successful make up salon where many girls count on you to give them a new look, everyday. Players will be able to choose from a variety of options, letting you customise make up and other ways to help make the girl look beautiful. 

Choose from a number of options such as eye colour, eye shade, a range of broaches to choose from, colourful turbans, and many other accessories to help give a touch of beauty to your clients. 
 
You can share your creations with the world and saving your works to the gallery. 

The game will help show the beauty of wearing a hijab and how one can still look good wearing the veil.

The newest bakery in town want you to try their delicious new donuts and cakes! 

Albert and Maria have been trying their hand at baking delicious sweets after being their own cooking chef for many years now, now they want to change from cooking fancy meals to now making tasty sweets for their customers!

Go on fantastic shopping adventures with them as they try their hand at being new baking chef.

You can choose to make delicious cakes with Albert. Start by going with him and helping him buy the ingredients. 

You then have to help the once famous Cooking Chef prepare delicious a cake by helping him bake make the batter, baking it in the oven, and giving it the finishing touches. 

Players will be able to choose a number of features for decorating: 

Choosing a beautiful topper
Selecting the Flavor
Use Plenty of decoration options
Adding a fitting topper

Name: Street Foods
Description: Street food is ready-to-eat food or drink sold in a street or other public place, such as a market or fair, by a hawker or vendor, often from a portable stall. While some street foods are regional, many are not, having spread beyond their region of origin. Even before the arrival of the statue, Bartholdi himself had traveled to the United States to discuss the location of the statue with president Ulysses S. Grant. Today the island is known as Liberty Island.The Statue of Liberty is 46,5 meters (151ft) tall and together with the pedestal it reaches a height of 93 meters (305ft). He established that all species of life have descended over time from common ancestors, and in a joint publication with Alfred Russel Wallace introduced his scientific theory that this branching pattern of evolution resulted from a process that he called natural selection, in which the struggle for existence has a similar effect to the artificial selection involved in selective breeding.

Description: Lata Mangeshkar is an Indian singer, and occasional music-composer. She is one of the best-known and most respected playback singers in India. Mangeshkar's career started in 1942 and has spanned over seven decades. She has recorded songs for over a thousand Hindi films and has sung songs in over thirty-six regional Indian languages and foreign languages, though primarily in Marathi and Hindi. Lata Mangeshkar has won several awards and honors, including Bharat Ratna (India's Highest Civilian Award), Padma Bhushan (1969), Padma Vibhushan (1999), Dada Saheb Phalke Award (1989), Maharashtra Bhushan Award (1997),NTR National Award (1999), Bharat Ratna (2001), ANR National Award (2009), three National Film Awards, and 12 Bengal Film Journalists' Association Awards. Name: Mumbai The Best
Description: Mumbai  also known as Bombay, is the capital city of the Indian state of Maharashtra,India . It is the most populous city in India, and the fourth most populous city in the world, with a total metropolitan area population of approximately 20.5 million. Along with the neighbouring urban areas, including the cities of Navi Mumbai and Thane, it is one of the most populous urban regions in the world.Mumbai lies on the west coast of India and has a deep natural harbour. In 2009, Mumbai was named an Alpha world city. It is also the wealthiest city in India, and has the highest GDP of any city in South, West or Central Asia.Mumbai is the commercial and entertainment capital of India, it is also one of the world's top 10 centres of commerce in terms of global financial flow, generating 5% of India's GDP,and accounting for 25% of industrial output, 70% of maritime trade in India (Mumbai Port Trust & JNPT), and 70% of capital transactions to India's economy. The city houses important financial institutions such as the Reserve Bank of India, the Bombay Stock Exchange, the National Stock Exchange of India, the SEBI and the corporate headquarters of numerous Indian companies and multinational corporations. It is also home to some of India's premier scientific and nuclear institutes like BARC, NPCL, IREL, TIFR, AERB, AECI, and the Department of Atomic Energy. The city also houses India's Hindi (Bollywood) and Marathi film and television industry. Mumbai's business opportunities, as well as its potential to offer a higher standard of living, attract migrants from all over India and, in turn, make the city a melting pot of many communities and cultures.This app gives a brief description about Mumbai.

Name: Sir Winston Chrchill
Description: Sir Winston Leonard Spencer-Churchill (30 November 1874 – 24 January 1965) was a British politician who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1940 to 1945 (that is, for most of the Second World War) and again from 1951 to 1955. Widely regarded as one of the greatest wartime leaders of the 20th century, Churchill was also an officer in the British Army, a historian, a writer, and an artist. He is the only British Prime Minister to have received the Nobel Prize in Literature, and was the first person to be made an honorary citizen of the United States.After the Conservative Party lost the 1945 election, he became Leader of the Opposition to the Labour (Attlee) government. After winning the 1951 election, he again became Prime Minister, before retiring in 1955.Churchill also received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1953 for his numerous published works, especially his six-volume set The Second World War.Upon his death, Elizabeth II granted him the honour of a state funeral, which saw one of the largest assemblies of world statesmen in history.Named the Greatest Briton of all time in a 2002 poll, Churchill is widely regarded as being among the most influential people in British history, consistently ranking well in opinion polls of Prime Ministers of the United Kingdom.

Description:
The Rivals (by Richard Brinsley Sheridan) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Romantic havoc ensues in the town of Bath when Sir Anthony arrives to arrange the marriage of his son Captain Jack Absolute to the wealthy Lydia Languish. Jack and Lydia are already in love, but because of Lydia’s obsession with romantic novels, Jack has disguised himself as a poor officer named Ensign Beverly – and he is only one of Lydia’s many suitors. The Rivals was Sheridan’s first play, and this charming comedy of manners continues to be widely performed today.

Includes an interview with Linda Kelly, a Fellow of the Royal Society of Literature and the author of Richard Brinsley Sheridan: A Life.

One of Shaw’s most enduring works, Pygmalion is an insightful comedy of class relations and perceptions, as played out between a Cockney flower girl and the irascible speech professor who has taken her on as a pet project. Described by critics as “a play of great vitality and charm,” Pygmalion inspired the award-winning stage and film productions of Lerner and Loewe’s musical, My Fair Lady.

As a psychiatrist, herself a lapsed Catholic, and the Mother Superior struggle over Agnes’ fate, the play plunges deeply into the mystery of faith and the consequence of truth.

This fierce rivalry between rising legislator Abraham Lincoln and incumbent Senator Stephen A. Douglas tackled some of the day’s most passionate and controversial issues—above all those of slavery and the American concept of freedom. As seen through the eyes of Douglas’ young wife Adele, the play illuminates two of the most charismatic politicians of any era.

The breathless pace and convincing details make it clear why the 1938 broadcast of an “eyewitness report” of an invasion from Mars caused a nationwide panic. Originally directed by Orson Welles and performed by his Mercury Theatre of the Air, The War of the Worlds is an adaptation of H. G. Wells’ novel of the same name.

The War of the Worlds is truly the mother of all space invasions, offering a rare combination of chills, thrills and great literature.

Name: Becket, or The Honor of God (Jean Anouilh)
Description:
Becket, or The Honor of God (by Jean Anouilh) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Waiting to be punished for his part in Becket’s murder, King Henry II re-lives his deeply felt relationship with the saint, once his dearest friend and partner in unbridled decadence. His catastrophic mistake? To appoint Becket Archbishop—for Becket finds his allegiance shifting from king and country to God and Church.

Jean Anouilh’s Becket; or the Honor of God tells the troubled story of the relationship between Thomas à Becket and Henry Plantagenet, known to history as King Henry II of England. This relationship begins as friendship and ends with the murder of Becket by Henry’s henchmen at the Cathedral of Canterbury. Anouilh sets Becket in England during the twelfth century, a time of political and religious upheaval. In Anouilh’s interpretation of this history, the Saxon peasants have not yet acquiesced to their Norman conquerors, nor has the throne firmly established its supremacy over the Catholic Church.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Asher Book, Kevin Daniels, Ken Danziger, Jean Gilpin, Alan Mandell, Charlie Matthes, Tim Monsion, Denis O’ Hare, Jennifer Rau-Ramirez, Simon Templeman, John Vickery, Douglas Westen and Greg Woodell.

DURATION: About a 2 hour performance.

Lost in Yonkers (Neil Simon)
Description:
Lost in Yonkers (by Neil Simon) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Set in Yonkers, New York in 1942, two boys, aged 13 and 16, must spend one year with their austere and demanding grandmother. While the war rages in Europe, Jay and Arty learn the ropes from Uncle Louie and assorted relatives, all peculiar characters.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Barbara Bain, Gia Carides, Dan Castellaneta, Ben Diskin, Arye Gross, Roxanne Hart and Kenneth Schmidt.

Four couples arrive, in turn, from London, Philadelphia, Chicago and New York and separately inhabit a Beverly Hills hotel suite, bringing along their problems, anxieties, and comical marital dilemmas. Beverly Hills will never be the same.

Description:
Desire Under the Elms (by Eugene O’Neill) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Eugene O’Neill’s tale of Ephraim Cabot, greedy and hard like the stone walls that surround his farm, the family patriarch brings home his new young bride, Abbie. His grown sons disapprove; one leaves but the other stays to fight for the family fortune. What follows is a tragedy of epic proportions.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Paul Adelstein, Orson Bean, Amy Brenneman, Dwier Brown, Maurice Chasse and Charlie Kimball.

Name: True West (Sam Shepard)
Description:
True West (by Sam Shepard) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Pulitzer-Prize winner Sam Shepard’s classic comedy is a story of estranged brothers Austin and Lee. Shepard compares and contrasts the reality of the two brothers by forcing them to come to terms with each other, with themselves, and with family. 

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Dean Cameron, Alfred Molina, Charlotte Rae and Francis Guinan.

Name: All My Sons (Arthur Miller)
Description:
All My Sons (by Arthur Miller) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

World War II is over and a family, mourning a son missing in action, plants a memorial tree and tries to go on with their lives. A storm blows down the tree and a devastating family secret is uprooted, setting the characters on a terrifying journey towards truth. Based upon a true story, All My Son is a classic drama by one of America’s greatest playwrights. At the heart of All My Sons lies a scathing criticism of the American Dream. After its publication Arthur Miller was called to appear before the House Un-American Activities Committee, where he famously refused to give evidence against others. A Tony Award Winner for Best Author (1947).

Includes an interview with historian Bill Yenne, author of “The American Aircraft Factory in World War Two”, one of his many works that chronicle the history of wartime aviation and manufacturing.

Name: Headstrong (Patrick Link)
Description:
Headstrong (by Patrick Link) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

In the wake of increasing concern over brain trauma in professional athletes, Patrick Link has crafted a story about a retired NFL linebacker who must deal with a family tragedy and his own suffering because of the violence of his chosen sport.

Includes an interview about brain injuries and sports with Dr. Robert Cantu, the Senior Advisor to the NFL Head, Neck, and Spine Committee.

Name: The House of Blue Leaves (John Guare)
Description:
The House of Blue Leaves (by John Guare) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

John Guare poignant Obie Award-winning comedy unfolds in New York City on the day the Pope is expected to visit. Hearts are palpitating in the sleepy borough of Queens, but not entirely on account of His Holiness. Bunny Flingus, a femme-fatale from Flushing (or thereabouts) is stirring things up in the quiet, unfulfilled life of aspiring songwriter Artie Shaughnessy. Artie longs to leave his unhappy marriage, elope with Bunny, and write a hit song that will top the charts. 

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Mary Teresa Fortuna, Sharon Gless, Deb Gottesman, Christopher Lane, Ron Leibman, Cam Magee, Jennifer Mendenhall, Jessica Walter and Michael Willis.

DURATION: About a 1.5 hour performance.

Name: The Caine Mutiny Court-Martial (Herman Wouk)
Description:
The Caine Mutiny Court-Martial (by Herman Wouk) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

This acclaimed WWII psychological court room drama was the sensation of 1954. The play portrays a mutiny of naval officers aboard the U.S.S. Caine. Their suspicions concerning their captain’s sanity lead to their rebellion and a subsequent court-martial.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring James Avery, Chuma Hunter-Gault, Ian Lithgow, Scott Lowell, Frank Muller, Michael Rivkin, David Selby and Grant Shaud.

Name: The Physicists (Friedrich Dürrenmatt)
Description:
The Physicists (by Friedrich Dürrenmatt) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Johann Mobius, the world’s greatest physicist, is locked away in a madhouse along with two other scientists. Why? Because he is haunted by recurring visions of King Solomon, and the other two are convinced they are Einstein and Newton. But are these three actually mad? Or are they playing a murdererous game with the world at stake? This darkly comic satire probes the cost of sanity among men of science and whether it is the mad who are the truly sane.

Includes an interview with Richard Rhodes, America's preeminent historian of the nuclear age. He is the author of the Pulitzer Prize-winning book The Making of the Atomic Bomb, and its companion book, Dark Sun: The Making of the Hydrogen Bomb. In addition to editing or authoring more than twenty other books, Rhodes has been a visiting scholar at Harvard and MIT, and has testified before the U.S. Senate on nuclear energy.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Anne Gee Byrd, Matthew Patrick Davis, Bruce Davison, John de Lancie, Matt Gaydos, Harry Groener, Christopher Guilmet, Melinda Page Hamilton, Gregory Itzin, Roma Maffia and Missy Yager.

This play is part of L.A. Theatre Works’ Relativity Series featuring science-themed plays. Major funding for the Relativity Series is provided by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation to enhance public understanding of science and technology in the modern world.

Name: Moving Bodies (Arthur Giron)
Description:
Moving Bodies (by Arthur Giron) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Moving Bodies is a chronicle of the brilliant life of Nobel Prize-winning scientist Richard Feynman. From his role in the development of the atomic bomb to his controversial testimony at the investigation of the Challenger disaster, Feynman casts a long shadow across the worlds of physics and mathematics. Through playwright Arthur Giron’s eyes, we see how Feynman became one of the most important scientists of our time.

Includes a bonus feature with Ralph Leighton, the co-author of Richard Feynman’s “Surely You’re Joking, Mister Feynman!”, a best-selling collection of autobiographical stories and reminiscences.

The Lost World is a rollicking adventure that follows a scientific expedition deep into the Amazon jungle right back into the time of dinosaurs and cavemen. Before Jurassic Park, before Indiana Jones – there was Sir Arthur Conan Doyle’s The Lost World!

Name: Proof (David Auburn)
Description:
Proof (by David Aubum) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

An enigmatic young woman. A manipulative sister. Their brilliant father. An unexpected suitor. One life-altering question. The search for the truth behind a mysterious mathematical proof is the perplexing problem in David Auburn’s dynamic play. Starring Anne Heche and Jeremy Sisto, Proof is a winner of the 2001 Tony award for Best Play as well as the 2001 Pulitzer Prize for drama. 

Includes an interview with Dr. Carrie Bearden, a Clinical Neuropsychologist and Assistant Professor-in-Residence in the Department of Psychiatry and Biobehavioral Sciences at the University of California-Los Angeles. Dr. Bearden is working to identify brain-based traits that may provide clues as to the underlying causes of psychosis and bipolar disorder. She joined us to talk about the role of heredity in mental illness and the links between genius and madness.

Also includes an interview with Steven Strogatz, a professor at the Cornell University School of Theoretical and Applied Mathematics. Dr. Strogatz is the author of three books, including Sync and The Calculus of Friendship, and has authored a column on mathematics for the New York Times. Dr. Strogatz joined us to talk about popular stereotypes of mathematicians, math as a “young man’s game,” and the question of gender bias in the field.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring:
Anne Heche as Catherine
Jeremy Sisto as Hal
Robert Foxworth as Robert
Kaitlin Hopkins as Claire

Directed by Jenny Sullivan. Recorded before a live audience at the Skirball Cultural Center, Los Angeles.

This play is part of L.A. Theatre Works’ Relativity Series featuring science-themed plays.  Major funding for the Relativity Series is provided by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation to enhance public understanding of science and technology in the modern world.

Description:
COPENHAGEN (by Michael Frayn) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

How different would the world have looked had the Nazis been the first to build an atomic bomb? Werner Heisenberg, one of Hitler's lead nuclear scientists, famously and mysteriously met in Copenhagen with his colleague and mentor, Niels Bohr, one of the founders of the Manhattan Project. Michael Frayn's Tony Award-winning drama imagines their reunion. Joined by Niels' wife, Margrethe, these three brilliant minds converge for an encounter of atomic proportions.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring:
Alfred Molina as Niels Bohr
Shannon Cochran as Margrethe Bohr
David Krumholtz as Werner Heisenberg

Directed by Martin Jarvis. Recorded before a live audience at the James Bridges Theater at UCLA School of Theater, Film and Television in November, 2011.

This play is part of L.A. Theatre Works’ Relativity Series featuring science-themed plays.  Major funding for the Relativity Series is provided by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation to enhance public understanding of science and technology in the modern world.

Name: Broadway Bound (Neil Simon)
Description:
Broadway Bound (by Neil Simon) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Neil Simon’s Broadway Blues is the third and final play of Neil Simon’s semi-autobiographical Brighton Beach trilogy. Eugene Jerome (based on Simon) and his brother Stanley cope with their parents’ crumbling marriage as they start careers as comedy writers.

Name: Three Sisters (Anton Chekhov)
Description:
Three Sisters (by Anton Chekhov) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

A full-cast performance of Chekhov’s masterpiece starring Jennifer Westfeldt, Tessa Thompson, Sarah Zimmerman and Jon Hamm.

Meet Olga, Masha, and Irina, warm and cultured young sisters who were reared in the exciting hubbub of Moscow, but have been living in the dull, gossipy backwaters of Russia for far too long. With their father’s passing, and the ordinary grip of day-to-day life slowly suffocating them, the urge to return to the city with its rich and exciting life rises to a fever pitch. First performed in 1901, Three Sisters beautifully mixes humor and heartbreak and is a perennial favorite of actors and audiences alike.

The great Russian playwright Anton Chekhov is one of the most influential figures in modern literature, whose classic works include Three Sisters and The Cherry Orchard (also available from L.A. Theatre Works).

Name: Arcadia (Tom Stoppard)
Description:
Arcadia (by Tom Stoppard) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Tom Stoppard’s Arcadia merges science with human concerns and ideals, examining the universe’s influence in our everyday lives and ultimate fates through relationship between past and present, order and disorder and the certainty of knowledge. Set in an English country house in the year 1809-1812 and 1989, the play examines the lives of two modern scholars and the house's current residents with the lives of those who lived there 180 years earlier. 

The New York Times calls Arcadia: “Tom Stoppard’s richest, most ravishing comedy to date. A play of wit, intellect, language, brio and emotion,” and The Royal Institution of Great Britain calls it: “the best science book ever written.”

Includes an interview with Steven Strogatz, the author of Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos and professor at the Cornell University School of Theoretical and Applied Mathematics.

Name: David Mamet Shorts
Description:
David Mamet Shorts is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

• “Bobby Gould in Hell”: David Mamet’s sequel to his classic “Speed the Plow” finds unethical movie producer Bobby Gould trying to talk his way out of eternal damnation.                                                                                                                                                                          

• “Reunion”: A father and daughter reunite after a 20 year estrangement. In a series of short scenes, we learn about their lives and how the father has come to terms with his alcoholism. A funny and poignant minor gem from David Mamet.                                                                                 

• “The Shaw”: An eerie look at the world of seances and confidence men as only David Mamet could imagine them. A shyster psychic reluctantly tries to bilk a troubled woman out of inheritance money, while fighting his lover and powers he can’t control.  

DURATION: About a 2 hour performance.

Name: The Odd Couple (Neil Simon)
Description:
The Odd Couple (by Neil Simon) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

In Neil Simon’s The Odd Couple, poker buddies Felix Ungar and Oscar Madison suddenly find themselves bachelors again and innocently decide to share an apartment. In this classic comedy by America’s most prolific and successful playwright, these two legendarily mismatched roommates bring down the house when they try to live together in one eight-room New York City apartment.

Felix Ungar, a neurotic, neat freak newswriter, is thrown out by his wife, and moves in with his friend Oscar Madison, a messy sportswriter. Despite Oscar’s problems – careless spending, excessive gambling, a poorly kept house filled with spoiled food – he seems to enjoy life. Felix, however, seems utterly incapable of enjoying anything and only finds purpose in pointing out his own and other people’s mistakes and foibles. Even when he tries to do so in a gentle and constructive way, his corrections and suggestions prove extremely annoying to those around him. Oscar, his closest friend, feels compelled to throw him out after only a brief time together, though he quickly realizes that Felix has had a positive effect on him.

This L.A. Theatre Works full-cast production features Dan Castellaneta, Stanley DeSantis, Steven Hack, Jamie Hanes, Nathan Lane, David Paymer, Linda Purl, and Yeardley Smith.

DURATION: About a 1.5 hour performance.

Name: Dinner with Friends (Donald Margulies)
Description:
Dinner with Friends (by Donald Margulies) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Winner of the 2000 Pulitzer Prize for drama, Dinner with Friends examines the lives of two couples and the repercussions of divorce on their friendships. With wit, compassion and consummate skill, playwright Donald Margulies weighs the cost of breaking up — and of staying together.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Matthew Arkin, Lisa Emery, Kevin Kilner and Deirdre O'Connell.

This poignant and poetic Pulitzer Prize winning play captures 1929 Florida at a time when cigars are still rolled by hand and “lectors” are employed to educate and entertain the workers. The arrival of a new lector is a cause for celebration. But when he reads aloud from “Anna Karenina”, he unwittingly becomes a catalyst in the lives of his avid listeners, for whom Tolstoy, the tropics, and The American Dream prove a volatile combination.

Includes an interview with Jimmy Smits.

Name: Plaza Suite (Neil Simon)
Description:
Plaza Suite (by Neil Simon) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Neil Simon’s hilarious comedy follows three brief encounters in the same suite at the famed Plaza Hotel in New York City.

Plaza Suite has had a long and successful career on stage and in film. Opening in 1968 in New York for 1,097 performances, the comedy starred George C. Scott and Maureen Stapleton in all three tales.

We open with a bubbly wife setting the scene for the perfect anniversary by a returning to the site of their honeymoon—and then watch her bubbles burst with the entry of a tired, disinterested husband. Act Two opens with a Hollywood producer awaiting the arrival of his old love interest—now a suburban housewife. He plans to spark a tryst; her plans are very different. The final act has a mother and father ready to celebrate their daughter’s wedding day—if only she’d come out of the bathroom.

A BBC co-production, this L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance features Edward Asner, Michelle Costa, Richard Dreyfuss, Hector Elizondo, Amy Irving, Marsha Mason, Alfred Molina, Kerry Shale, Joe Spano and JoBeth Williams.

DURATION: About a 1.5 hour performance.

The Playboy of the Western World (by J.M. Synge) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Michael Hollinger based his probing work on the real-life giant tortoise named “Lonesome George”, and the efforts to preserve his species that threatened the livelihood of the native fishermen on the Galàpagos Islands.

This play is part of L.A. Theatre Works’ Relativity Series featuring science-themed plays. Major funding for the Relativity Series is provided by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, to enhance public understanding of science and technology in the modern world.

Name: Mrs. Warren's Profession (George Bernard Shaw)
Description:
Mrs. Warren’s Profession (by George Bernard Shaw) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

Modern parallels abound in the plight of Cambridge-educated mathematics wiz Vivie Warren, who discovers that her comfortable upbringing was financed in unspeakable ways. Shaw pits a clever heroine against a memorable gallery of rogues in this superbly intelligent—and still shocking—comedy, banned for eight years from the English stage.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Paul Gutrecht, Kaitlin Hopkins, Shirley Knight, Basil Langton, Dakin Matthews and Robin Sachs.

DURATION: About a 1.75 hour performance.

Name: Misalliance (George Bernard Shaw)
Description:
Misalliance (by George Bernard Shaw) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring Tom Beyer, Joy Gregory, Roger Rees, Serena Scott Thomas, W. Morgan Sheppard, Eric Stoltz, Victoria Tennant, Tegan West and Douglas Weston.

DURATION: About a 1.75 hour performance.

Description:
William Shakespeare's “Romeo and Juliet” is presented as a full-cast audio performance by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

“Romeo and Juliet” is the most iconic love story of all time, and is one of Shakespeare’s most beloved plays. With it, Shakespeare created the first tragic love story; before “Romeo and Juliet”, romance was not viewed as a worthy topic for tragedy. Today, romance is used as a theme in virtually every tragic or dramatic movie, play, book, and television show that is written, due greatly in part to “Romeo and Juliet”.

Name: Antigone (Jean Anouilh)
Description:
ANTIGONE (by Jean Anouilh) is presented by L.A. Theatre Works. This standalone audiobook app combines a professional audio recording with supplemental features for download-once, grab-and-go anywhere enjoyment.

The body of Polynices, Antigone's brother, has been ordered to remain unburied by Creon, the new king of Thebes. Antigone's faithfulness to her dead brother and his proper burial, and her defiance of the dictator Creon, seals her fate. Originally produced in Paris during the Nazi occupation, Anouilh's Antigone was seen by the French as theatre of the resistance and by the Germans as an affirmation of authority.

Includes an interview with translator Christopher Nixon and director Brendon Fox.

Also includes an interview with Ned Chaillet, a playwright, radio producer and director for the BBC. Chaillet is the former Deputy Drama Critic for the Times of London and the London theatre critic for the Wall Street Journal-Europe. He spoke with us about Antigone in the context of World War Two, the differences bewtween the original myth of Sophocles and the Anouilh version, and Anouilh’s influence on later playwrights.

An L.A. Theatre Works full-cast performance featuring:
Jordan Bridges as Haemon and Guard
Dominic Fumusa as Guard
Francis Guinan as Creon        
John Hansen as Guard and Messenger
Alan Mandell as Chorus
Elizabeth Marvel as Antigone        
Alley Mills as Nanny
Mandy Siegfried as Ismene

Directed by Brendon Fox. Recorded before a live audience at the Skirball Cultural Center, Los Angeles.

DURATION: About 2 hours.
